One bone is on screen at one time and when collected, another bone appears in a different place. Also on screen are Dinogophers and these must be avoided and if you touch one you lose a life, and when all your lives are gone then you go to the next game.

Dinner: A single-screen side-view game where you have to catch your favourite food, Flying Dinogophers by climbing up and down a beanstalk throwing rocks. Three Donogophers fly down the screen on your left and the further away then the more points you score for hitting them. It is game over once you use up your limited amount of rocks and off you go to the next game.

Wife Rescue: A single-screen maze game viewed from an elevated angle has you battling a Caveape who has taken your wife and is holding her at the top of the screen. You start at the bottom of the screen and you must collect a certain amount of TNT while avoiding rocks rolled by the Caveape. Once you lose all your lives then you go to the next game.

Forest Fire: A maze game where the screen scrolls downwards as you move your man through the gaps in the fire while avoiding Pteranodons flying around the screen. You must avoid the birds and the fire and it is game over when you are hit too many times and you play the next game.

Searching for Gems: A caveman's favourite thing is diamonds and in this side-view horizontal-scrolling game where the screen scrolls constantly from right to left, you must move up and down the screen to collect the diamonds from Liberian Bats which you also have to avoid. Every time you hit a bat you lose a life and when they are all gone you go to the last game.

A Mammoth Prehistoric Traffic Jam: A single-screen game shown at an elevated angle where you try to get to your cave while avoiding a huge herd of mammoths. Starting on the left of the screen you must move through the gaps of mammoths who are moving up and down the screen in five columns. Mammoths also move across the screen and all must be avoided or it's a loss of life and it is game over when they are all gone.
title: Prehistoric Man

description: Protector is a horizontal side-view scrolling shooter where the screen scrolls constantly left or right as you control a ship trying to stop an alien invasion force. You were just flying a few solons above your home planet when you were attacked and it is your job to destroy as many of the invasion force as you can to save your planet. As you fly left or right, the aliens appear and you keep blasting them avoiding the aliens and their bullets. if you touch an alien or it's bullets then you lose one of three lives. Before you start the game you can select the skill level (1-9).
title: Protector

description: Protium is a side-view horizontal scrolling shooter where the screen scrolls constantly from left to right as you control spacecraft blasting and avoiding aliens over various levels. Earth have been threatened with hyperspace by the aliens and because their base is so far away, an attack isn't plausible. The only solution is to activate the Galactic Shield but this requires large amounts of Protium and there isn't any on Earth. To get some, Protium, a ship laden with it has to be stolen and brought back to Earth to save the planet. The aliens attack in formations and if you touch any or are shot then you lose one of six lives. Icons occasionally appear and when one is touched then you receive a power-up and these are extra fire-power, extra speed, reverse fire, laser, plasma bomb and shield. Half-way through each level, a Mothership appears and must be destroyed to progress through the level.
title: Protium

description: After a heavy night of drinking in your local pub it is time to pay the bill but you have no money on you and the landlord wants his money. The only location you know that has some money is in the sewers, but with many dangers and you not quite sober, you need to search and find the right equipment to go into the sewers for the money. To make matters worse, you have a certain time (choice of one, two and three hours) to pay your bill or the debt collectors will arrive. Pub Quest is a text adventure where there is text on the screen describing your location and you type in commands with the keyboard to interact with your surroundings.
title: Pub Quest

description: Quadro - Power is a single screen game with simple mazes for one to four players and the aim is to collect all the dots and get the highest score you can over various screens. Each screen has pathways connected by discs with certain gaps in the discs, and each path is full of dots. You move Mr Quadro around the maze avoiding Spirit's and other creatures as you go dot collecting. There are also hearts and diamonds on the paths with the hearts giving bonus points and the diamonds giving set points. To change path you need to go into the disc and spin it 90 degrees to the right to move the gap but moving the disc one place loses you set points. The more set points you have the more you can turn the discs, but if you go into minus set points then you lose one of five lives. Touching a creature or running out of time also loses you a life and it is then the next players turn.
title: Quadro - Power

description: Quak Attak is a side-view single screen game inspired by the arcade game Joust where you have to defeat three of your foes on various levels. Riding on your Osturkey and armed with your Laser-Lance, you must unseat your foes from their flying steads before shooting them on the ground. To unseat a foe your lance must be higher than theirs when you ride into them making them parachute to the ground. They will then run to the side of the screen by foot and you can shoot them for bonus points but you lose fifty points if they escape. If you are hit by a foe then you are unseated and you lose one of three lives. Occasionally a dragon flies across the screen and cannot be shot or touched or it is a loss of life.

sample_screenshots.caption: A dragon flying across the screen
A foe running away on foot

title: Quak Attak

description: You can't take it much longer locked up in this cell on Her Majesties Pleasure and you have vowed to escape not just the cell but the actual prison. Your first task is to get out of the locked cell before trying to leave the prison without getting caught and using equipment to aid you in your escape. Prison Blues is a text adventure where the screen has text describing your location and you type in commands with the keyboard to interact with your surroundings.
title: Prison Blues

description: You are an avid adventure game player but things are starting to get boring and stale and you really would love to do something different. At the Birmingham Adventure Players Society you discuss this with your friend Lizzie and have decided that a REAL adventure is what the doctor ordered. Lizzie has agreed this is a great idea and has found the perfect location for your new adventure. Her aunt owns an old house outside Birmingham and is away for a couple of weeks on holiday so Lizzie has now dared you to get to the house next week and try to complete her adventure. Starting in your home a week later, you have received no address of the house, just a clue and so the start of a different kind of adventure for yourself. I Dare You is a text adventure where the screen has text describing your location and you type in commands withe the keyboard to interact with your surroundings.

sample_screenshots.caption: Exploring a small room under the stairs

title: I Dare You

description:
You are Og, a noble adventurer who has fought many a battle and won with your determination, skill and some luck. You are known across the land with great wealth and fame.....then you wake up and it's all a dream. You have started out as an adventurer as an unknown with no money, so you have decided that this adventure will be huge. You are going to find and rob Death himself, seeing as he is able to put two coins on the eyes of every dead person he encounters. As you set off, you realise that a couple of things are needed....

Og the Great is a text adventure where the screen has text describing your location and you type in commands with the keyboard to interact with your surroundings.

sample_screenshots.caption: Entered a shop and received a potion

title: Og the Great

description: You are Merlin, a high magician in the realm of King Arthur and with all the Knights of the Round Table away in a tournament, it has been left for you to complete an important quest. king Arthur's wife, Guinevere has been kidnapped and taken to Boscastle. Using your magic you must search the surrounding areas finding additional spells and equipment to aid you in your quest. Merlin is a two-part text adventure where the screen has text describing your location and you type in commands with the keyboard to interact with your surroundings.

sample_screenshots.caption: Giving your clothes to a beggar

title: Merlin

description: You don't how it happened but you are a normal person who has somehow been transported to a strange place. You have two choices, wander this abnormal place forever or try to escape back to your normal world. As you explore you realise how strange things are and how the laws of physics don't apply. Total Reality Delusion is a text adventure where the screen has text describing your location and you type in commands with the keyboard to interact with your surroundings.

sample_screenshots.caption: Listening to music with dancing trees

title: Total Reality Delusion

description: The owner of a large mansion outside the village has died and left it in his will to various owners. The owners visited their inheritance to check it out but on entering the mansion, strange noises are heard as well as a piano playing. With no response to calling out and seeing no one playing the piano, the chimes of the Grandfather clock is the last straw and the new owners leave in a hurry vowing never to return. Andy, one of the new owners is enjoying a drink with you in the local pub, The Fox and Hounds, and the conversation turns to the haunted mansion full of Shadows of the Night. After listening to his story, you accept his dare to spend the night in the mansion for eight hours trying to discover clues to what causes the Shadows of the Night. Shadows in the Night is a text adventure with the screen having text describing your location with various sound effects to give the game atmosphere. You type in commands with the keyboard to interact with your surroundings and there is also on screen a clock counting down.
title: Shadows in the Night

description: You have been dumped on Misty Island, in a semi-conscious state by spies for knowing too much, and left too die with no food. As the spies leave, they whisper something about 'hiding the evidence', but your main problem is surviving. You have to try to escape the island back to civilisation, but first you need to find equipment to be able to get food to stop you starving to death, while surviving the island looking for the evidence. Misty Island is a text adventure where the screen has text describing your location and you type in commands with the keyboard to interact with your surroundings.

sample_screenshots.caption: Inside a hollow of a tree

title: Misty Island

description: Five rings stolen from your guardian have been taken and held in Westbury House but while you are searching the house looking for them you are kidnapped and held in the cellar. This isn't the best place to be held captive as there are rumours of strange things going on with a cult and frightening rituals being carried out. With experiments being carried out on people, you need to escape as soon as possible with the five rings before you become the next victim. The Westbury Mystery is a text adventure where the screen has text describing your location and you type in commands with the keyboard to interact with your surroundings.

sample_screenshots.caption: Found a headless body in the library
In the wine cellar full of rats

title: The Westbury Mystery

description: Quasar Zone is a single-screen shooter where you move a spacecraft, left or right on the bottom of the screen blasting aliens that appear at the top of the screen in various patterns over various levels. You are blasting aliens in a part of the Universe where mega races battle each other for supreme power with spacecrafts that have surpassed the laws of physics. As you blast, most of the aliens have a random attack pattern and can be avoided but certain aliens keep moving across the screen getting lower and these need to be destroyed as they will move across the bottom of the screen and kill you. if you are hit by an alien or its weapon then you lose one of three lives. To move to the next level you need to score 5000 points.
title: Quasar Zone

description:
Quinx is a top-view single-screen game where you play the role of Arthur Crown, stressing about his final exams in Food Economy at the London School of Economics. The stress has led to Arthur dreaming at night about Ink Worms and a large piece of paper that he is standing on and has to be protected from the worms. The worms appear at the side of the paper and start to move across leaving behind an ink trail. Arthur has to run around the paper and swat the worms to kill them trying to stop any from reaching the other side of the paper. Any ink trail left behind can be erased by a limited use of Tippex.

If a worm does reach the other side then they turn into a paper eating monster and eats part of the paper and when it reaches an edge then it explodes. As the worms move across the paper then a Quinx bottle is emptying and when it empties then the part of the paper Arthur is standing on changes colour and if the size is below 25% of the last colour change then it is game over. Fruit appears occasionally on the side of the screen and needs to be collected or points are lost but the more fruit collected then Arthur has to touch a toothbrush or a dentist makes an appearance. A ringing telephone can be answered as well but it could either be good or bad news.

sample_screenshots.caption: Swat the Ink Worms before they reach the edge of the paper
A paper eating monster having a feast

title: Quinx

description: The Rat is a top-view single-screen game where you are a rat spending the night in a cheese warehouse to eat all the cheese on various floors. On each floor are six cheeses with letters spelling THE RAT and all have to be eaten to open the entrance to the next floor. After you eat the first cheese then the others start moving around the screen. As you chase and eat cheese there are spiders and snakes that also move around the screen and must be avoided or shot to paralyse them for a short time. Touching a spider only paralyses you a short time but touching a snake loses you one of three lives. When there is one cheese left then an object appears and moves around the screen and cannot be touched or a life is lost. Eating a cheese with the letter E makes the lights go out, letter A opens up more passages, and the letter R removes some creatures.
title: The Rat

description: Rattler is a top-view single-screen version of the game Snake where you must direct a constantly moving snake around the screen at 90 degree angles. The aim is to eat so many eggs that appear one at a time on the screen to move to the next level through a gap in the wall at the top of the screen. You must eat an egg within a time-limit or another egg is added to your total to eat, and the more eggs you eat then the longer you grow. If you touch yourself, hit the walls on the outside of the screen, or on later levels hit walls within the screen then you lose one of three lives. before you start the game you can select your skill level (0-4) and also how many balls bounce on the screen (0-4) and if a ball hits your head then you lose a life.

sample_screenshots.caption: A wall in the middle of the screen

title: Rattler

description: Kangaroo is an adaptation of an early 80's game released on Atari and Arcade platforms. The story and the gameplay remain unchanged. By guiding the kangaroo mother, the player must reach the top of the board to rescue an imprisoned kangaroo child. Numerous monkeys will try to interrupt the mission by throwing or dropping apples and knocking the kangaroo off the platforms. The kangaroo mother has the boxing gloves, which allow knocking out the monkeys with a single punch for a short period of time.
title: Kangaroo

description: Omnibus is an adaptation of a Hangman game. Being trapped in a locked room the player must find a password before the time runs out. With time expiring, each mistakenly indicated letter causes the lowering of the ceiling quicker. Guessing the password opens the door to the next level. The player can choose both consonants and vowels.
title: Omnibus

description: Pole Minowe is a board game requiring the crossing of a playfield from the left to right border without stepping on a mine before the time runs out. The player is equipped with a sound mine detector. Being close-up near the mines is signaled by an audible signal. Selecting the right direction is the main challenge during gameplay. The game features ten unique boards, that get repeated all over again with various mine relocations.
title: Pole Minowe

description: Super-Penetrator is a side-scrolling shooter. Using missiles and bombs, the player must destroy air and ground objects on the way to the main base of the enemy. The fuel may be supplemented by hitting the ground containers. Released bombs falling on the gravity parabola, the missiles in exchange are moving along a straight line. Controlled fighter may be moved in any direction.
title: Super-Penetrator

description: Polowanie na Litery is a simple game, where the player must press the letters on their keyboard corresponding to the ones being dropped by an aircraft that is flying around before the letters hit the city buildings. Each level lasts for a certain indicated time and introduces an additional letter falling from the aircraft. The collapse of the letter on the city means the destruction of 25% of city facilities. Four hits end the game.

sample_screenshots.caption: Grey stripe indicates hitting the town
Aircraft drops more letters with each level

title: Polowanie na Litery

description: 15 Piętnastka is a simple puzzle-solving game. The game is controlled with cursor keys or a joystick. The task requires putting the number blocks in the correct order (from 1 to 15) as soon as possible by shifting blocks to the free space. The game has no time or moves limit.
title: 15 Piętnastka

description:
In Build-It: Das Bauhaus, the player takes the role of Joey, the construction worker. He won in the lottery, is rich and wants to fulfill his wish for his own house. However, he does not use his money to hire help, but does everything himself.

This is a tile matching puzzle game. In every one-screen level, there is a number of squares which are divided into two differently-colored triangles. Joey needs to pick those squares up and create a new square of the same color in order to make the four blocks disappear. He can also turn a block on the spot. The goal of each level is to create a certain number of those same-colored squares.

Of course there are a number of difficulties: walls may restrict Joey's movements, new blocks appear in fixed intervals and tools roam around the levels and kill Joey by touch. Helpful are three extras which give advantages when collected: a temporary protective shield, a level skip and all stones transform to joker stones (can be combined with any color). In multiplayer, two players alternate without interaction.

The Amiga version has different levels and an optional time limit.
title: Build-It: Das Bauhaus

description: Snowball Sunday is a side-view single-screen game where you play the role of William Warmstart who is having a snowball fight with his friends. There is no aim or end game, the idea is just to have fun trying to knock people on their bums while avoiding being hit yourself. Once a snowball has been thrown then you have to bend over and pick up more snow to throw another snowball. You can run left or right along the screen while your opponents do the same.
title: Snowball Sunday

description: Velocipede is a side-view scrolling game where the screen scrolls from left to right constantly as you play the role of Mr Megafat who loves going to the beach to swim in the summer months, but it is half a mile away and he doesn't like walking. To get there, Mr Megafat has invented a bicycle, called a Velocipede S.T.A. (Simple to Assemble), but the problem is the road to the beach is full of creatures travelling the opposite way which cannot be touched. Luckily the bicycle has a plasma cannon and can also jump into the air to shoot or avoid the creatures like birds that drop fire and giant snails. If a creature is touched then the bike breaks and a life is lost but it can be rebuilt to keep going to the beach. In the middle of the screen is a counter which shows the distance to the beach and once the beach is reached then it has to be travelled to again with more creatures to attend to. Before the game is played there are various options that can be selected and they are speed (1-3), lives (1-9) and starting level (1-3).
title: Velocipede

description:
Triada is a compilation of the three following titles: Ashido* is a puzzle solving game, where the player must place stones with symbols in an appropriate manner on the board. Laying stones correspond to the appropriate rules. The game features 70 levels, all with individual password.

  • Bombi is a side scrolling clone of Dyna Blaster or Bomberman for two players. The goal is to eliminate the opponent by detonating an explosive when an enemy is in its range. Getting close to the opposite player requires avoiding various creatures and removing walls and other obstacles inside the maze. Some of the destroyed parts of the maze may hide very useful power-ups, such as additional bombs or extra protectors.
  • Timtris is a clone of classic Tetris. The player gets a point for each completed line. The game finishes when the blocks cease to be housed in the well.
title: Triada

description: Monstrum is a classic platformer, where the player must defeat a deadly creature hiding in the maze. Reaching the monster level requires finding numerous items and using them in an appropriate place, facing hordes of deadly enemies, such as mummies, knights or bats, several types of traps, including ground and rotating spikes. Appropriate use of the jumping skills, accurate knife throwing and timed stick hitting is the key to the success of the mission.
title: Monstrum

description:
An unofficial port of an unofficial sequel: Bruce Lee II was first released for Windows and Linux in 2013, as a fan-made tribute to the original platforming classic, complete with a selectable "C64" graphical style. Another programmer then picked up the gauntlet, resulting in this native Commodore 64 conversion. The game keeps faithful to the original, as far as hardware limitations allow, but also introduces a new, easier difficulty setting (which demands less pixel-perfect platforming skills and starts out with ten lives, instead of five).

As Bruce Lee ventures into the depth of Tao-Bao's palace to rescue his captive sister, he is beset by a gang of mercenaries that follow him from room to room, challenging his considerable martial arts skills with their own. En route towards the final confrontation with Tao-Bao himself, the Dragon's path will take him from the palace garden, through underground pools (Bruce can now swim and dive), temples, pagodas and even a brief imprisonment in the dungeons.

Along the way, passages will have to be opened up by engaging in the familiar pastime of collecting hanging lanterns; devious and dynamic traps make things difficult for our hero, but environmental aids like traveling platforms, poles, vines, conveyor belts, and the idiosyncratic moving tapestries can be deftly exploited to avoid the hazards.
title: Bruce Lee II

description:
R-Nest is a single-screen game based on the arcade game Q*Bert where you play the role of R-Nest who has to paint the tops of all the cubes making up a pyramid over various levels. R-Nest moves around the screen in a diagonal direction and has he touches the top of each cube it changes colour. On later levels, the cubes have to be touched several times to change its colour and once all cubes have been painted then its on to the next level. Also on screen are balls that bounce from the top to the bottom of the pyramid and these have to be avoided or you lose one of four lives.

Gangal the snake also moves around the pyramid chasing you, and his friend Zouszous makes an occasional appearance to change the cubes back to their original colour. Falling off the edge of the pyramid also loses a life and you start on the last cube you touched. Green pills can be collected to paralyse the other creatures, and two elevators either side of the pyramid can be used once per level to get back to the top of the pyramid.

sample_screenshots.caption: Still a few cubes to paint

title: R-Nest

description:
Sam's Jam is a side-view single-screen game where for reasons unknown, you play the role of Sam who is in a Jam factory eating drops of jam, taking bites out of strawberries, and avoiding a giant rat over various levels. Above Sam's head is a vat of jam below a conveyor belt that drips jam out at regular intervals, and each drop can be eaten by lifting his head upwards. Occasionally a strawberry moves along the conveyor belt before falling off the edge and down the screen where Sam can take a bite. As Sam eats then he puts on weight which starts off as 10 stone and cannot get heavier than 16 stone or Sam explodes. To the right of the screen is a sauna and standing in there has Sam losing weight.

Below the floor Sam stands on is a giant rat that moves left and right across the screen, and any jam or strawberry that is missed allows the rat to eat his share. Once the rat has eaten enough then he appears on Sam's floor and the only way to avoid the rat is to stand on a lift on the left of the screen to squash the rat. Once the vat of jam is empty then Sam goes into the sauna to complete the level. On later levels, more obstacles are introduced that need avoiding like Bouncing Bill, acid rain and barrels that need jumping over. If Sam touches the rat, obstacles, or explodes then he loses one of three lives and has to start the level again.

sample_screenshots.caption: Next level and Bouncing Bill has joined the party

title: Sam's Jam

description:
Mario Bros II is a fan-made game based on the Mario Bros. Game & Watch LCD device.

The Mario Bros are working in a bottling factory and have to move crates with bottles and place them on conveyor belts. The player can use two joysticks to move the two brothers up and down, making sure they catch all crates as they are about to fall off a belt. When a crate is caught it is placed on a higher-up belt. Miss a crate and it will fall and break, and the brothers are yelled at by their bosses.

With each passing through the machine in the middle, the crates go up and at the end of the line the crate is filled and sealed. At the final point it is thrown into the truck, ready to be shipped off. When the van is filled with 8 crates it rides off and the bros get a short break, after which the game continues with increased difficulty.

sample_screenshots.caption: When the crates reach the top left, they are thrown into the THS truck
The game starts, crates are filled with bottles
Dropped a crate that just appear from the bottom right
Van was filled up, just resting a bit before the next level starts.

title: Mario Bros II

description:
Fortuna kołem się toczy a game loosely based on the TV show Wheel of Fortune. The players take turns guessing letters to form a word or a saying. The game can be played with up to three human players. During their turn the players can spin the wheel, guess a consonant, buy a vowel or guess the password.

The game features around 1000 passwords.
title: Fortuna kołem się toczy

description:
Droid is a single board shooter. The game takes place on the planet Xeviou, taken over by bandits. As the land is full of natural resources the Highest Intergalactic Council decides to send scientifically advanced robot to neutralize the central computer. Unfortunately, robot was not equipped with defense mechanisms therefore protector is needed to complete the task. Droid moves constantly according to the programmed sequence on each board. The player moves viewfinder and must kill all bandits appearing in various places before they dispose the robot. After passing each board Droid receives the full amount of energy.

The game is divided into five stages, each containing five levels.
title: Droid

description: Drip is a side-scrolling platform game. The player's task is to collect all the coins that spilled out of the car carrying them to the bank. The game features 42 levels full of coins and hostile creatures. The creatures may be neutralized by throwing the ball, however contact with them takes one life. After collecting all the coins Drip must reach the end of the board before the time runs out. The remaining time is recalculated for extra points. The game consists two level passwords, acquired after finishing level 10 and 20.
title: Drip

description: Tamer is a vertically scrolling action game. The player flies a jet armed with an unlimited ammo cannon on the surface of Jupiter in order to reach and destroy the Communists rebel base. The planet is heavily guarded by rebellion fighters, tanks and other unidentified flying objects. Apart from hostile units the player must avoid collisions with rocks, space junk and other obstacles.
title: Tamer

alternate_titles.title: Kacze Opowieści czyli Tabliczka Mnożenia dla Najmłodszych

description: Kacze Opowieści czyli...Tabliczka Mnożenia na Wesoło is an educational game based on the Duck Tales franchise for multiplication tablet teaching. The action takes place in the castle of cruel Count Mat, who imprisoned sister of Huey, Dewey, and Louie. Moving between the chambers requires solving mathematical tasks. A bad answer takes one life. At the end of each level the player will find an elevator that will transport him on the floor above. A white key activates the elevator. Ten collected items is awarded with an extra life.
title: Kacze Opowieści czyli...Tabliczka Mnożenia na Wesoło

description:
This compilation includes the following titles:

  • Peter Beardsley's International Football
  • Frank Bruno's Boxing
  • Ian Botham's Test Match
  • Daley Thompson's Olympic Challenge
title: Sporting Heroes

description:
Zauberschloß (subtitle "An adventure game with perils") is a German language adventure game.

The player enters a heavily guarded castle with many dangers. The task is to snatch the crown of a magician, and thus end his reign over the people. The quest is completed once the crown has been safely brought out of the castle.

To solve the task, the player can enter commands with the keyboard which the computer will execute, provided they're understood. These commands usually consist of two words, which must be separated by a space, the following work:

NIMM (take), VERLIERE (drop), LIES (read), OEFFNE (open), VERJAGE (chase away), DREH (turn), BENUTZE (use), TRINK (drink), DRUECKE (press)

For directions, only the first letter has to be entered: N = Nord (north), S = Süd (south), W = West (west), O = Ost (east), H = Hoch (up), R = Runter (down)

The LIST command lists all things that the player is carrying, up to four at once. With SAVE the game can be saved.

On the C64, the graphics mainly consist of the default C64 character set, only a few items and opponents have been rendered as sprites, which then immediately stand out from the other graphics. Below the graphics the objects in the room are listed. Below this the possible walk-directions are displayed. The last line is the command line, in which the two-word commands can be entered.
title: Zauberschloß

description: Tamer Part Two is a slightly modified version of the first part, allowing two players to play simultaneously. The gameplay remains unchanged, except an additional fighter can support in the fight against the aliens. The levels look very similar, differing mainly in a sequence of surroundings objects (space debris, stars, asteroids) and emerging enemies (fighters, tanks, rockets).
title: Tamer Part Two

description: Dungeon Crawl is a simplified maze RPG game similar to rogue-like RPGs, except that in Dungeon Crawl the dungeon is always the same and not randomly generated. To make progress through the dungeon and reach the next dungeon levels, the player has to find keys to unlock doors and find buttons which opens up formerly inaccessible sections. Typical fantasy monsters roam the dungeon, often blocking your path. Killing them gives XP, which is needed to further improve your characters attack and defense values.
title: Dungeon Crawl

description: Rollerboard is a skateboarding game. The game is side scrolling and plays similar to the Kikstart series albeit with skateboards instead of motorbikes. The objective is simply to make it through the game's levels without crashing at any of the obstacles. Three skateboards are available from the start and for every crash one is lost. When all out of skateboards the game is over. The skater is controlled entirely with joystick. To speed up the button is pressed while pulling left is used to approach a hill and pulling up is used to jump. If it goes too fast pulling down causes the skater to brake. There are also tricks (flips and turns) that can be done for bonus points.

sample_screenshots.caption: Flashing letters make hard to read screenshots

title: Rollerboard

description: Oisac is an action game where the player moves a crosshair over single screen levels and has to shoot down enemies, who are soldiers of an empire called Oisac. The enemies, which come in different abstract shapes, appear in the middle of the screen and will start moving towards the edges. It's necessary to shoot them down before they do so because if they leave the screen some of the player's shield will be depleted. When the shield, which is not rechargeable, is completely destroyed the game ends. To complete a level twenty enemies have to be shot down. In addition to regular enemies there are also ghost ships which are extra important to shoot since if they leave the screen all of the remaining shield will be destroyed.

sample_screenshots.caption: Ghost ship appearing to the left

title: Oisac

description: The story begins when the princess of Oms land named Cecil gets sick. As foretold she can be saved only thanks to a magic medicine. Chwat Romek sets off on a mission. Chwat is a typical for its times action adventure game, demanding finding items and using them in the right place, avoiding enemies and obstacles. Romek may carry only up to two items at a time, talk to encountered characters and use switches. The items can be left in any location and collected at a different time. Contact with enemies, water and obstacles takes some energy points. The loss of life takes the player to the initial location.
title: Chwat

description: Kulfon w krainie złego demona is a platform adventure game. Kulfon's fiancée was kidnapped and imprisoned in the castle. The player must find a way to rescue by using proper objects scattered in the surroundings, in the castle and the underground level. Kulfon may carry up to two items and interact with encountered characters. Fall from a height or swimming without diving equipment means the loss of life.
title: Kulfon w krainie złego demona

description:
2 Players control 8 little aliens each to battle in several single screen arenas. There is no plot to the game, it just is quick 2 player action. Gameplay is simple, each player has 8 aliens, but only one is controlled at any given time. Which one is controlled can be switched by pressing the joystick button. Then the aliens are cycled through one by one. The movement is on a fixed grid and 4-directional. Adjacent aliens either hurt each other or heal each other, depending on whether they are enemies or friends. Slain aliens leave corpses for a while. The hurt/heal effect is 8-directional, so you have to keep your diagonals protected as well.

Whoever kills all enemy aliens first wins. There are 7 different arenas to choose from and the game also has an AI mode for when no human opponent is available.
title: Not Even Human: Inhumane Edition

description: Color Mania is a computer adaptation of the eponymous board game. The objective of the game is to guess a combination of five tokens within ten trials. After each trial computer shows how many tokens were indicated right (white X) and how many appears in combination, but in a different position (grey X).

sample_screenshots.caption: Grey X means a good color

title: Color Mania

description: Klepkomania is a variant of Arkanoid, using well known cartoon graphics as a hidden background. Standard gameplay is diversified by indelible or appearing again block, disturbing birds moving in an irregular manner and various bonuses. The game has no sounds and music.
title: Klepkomania

description: Memomania is a simple puzzle-solving game. The goal requires finding all the covered pairs of pictures on the board. Discovered pairs disappear from the board. There is no time, counter on the top left corner indicates how many mistakes may be done.
title: Memomania

description: Caren and the Tangled Tentacles is a modern Point-and-Click adventure game. You take full control of Caren's actions and find out what is really going on in her little town by exploring different locations and interact with NPCs. The game features English and German language which can be toggled in-game.
title: Caren and the Tangled Tentacles

description: In this Pac-Man clone, your task is to navigate a maze eating dots while avoiding Zippy, Stilty, Gippy, and Chris, four ghosts who also move around the maze. Contact with any of these ghosts results in a loss of life. However, eating power pellets allows you to eat the ghosts who respawn near the center of the maze. Fruit can also be collected for bonus points, and eating all the dots in the maze advances you to the next maze.

sample_screenshots.caption: Eaten all the dots in the maze

title: Spriteman 64

description: Koło fortuny is a game loosely based on the TV show Wheel of Fortune. The players take turns guessing letters to form a word or a saying. The game can be played with up to three human players. During their turn the players can spin the wheel, guess a consonant, buy a vowel or guess the password.
title: Koło fortuny

description:
Wizard's Doom is a timed action strategy game with gameplay similar to Soko-Ban. The evil Wizard has imprisoned You in a deep dungeon. Escaping from each of 50 levels requires pushing the movable directional (left, right, up, down, all ways) blocks through the removable walls in order to crush the bricks and get access to all 5 keys. After collecting 5 rusted keys a Magic Key will appear, allowing to pass next level passage doors. All of this within just 3 minutes. The points are awarded for crushing wall bricks, collecting keys and completing levels. Completing 5 levels is awarded with one extra life.

The game is very similar to the PC title Wizard's Doom and shares graphics. It is however done by a different developer and it is not clear if one was a licensed or unlicensed port of the other. Most likely the DOS version was released first.
title: Wizard's Doom: Fifty Levels of Exquisite Torture

description: Koło Fortuny is a game loosely based on the TV show Wheel of Fortune. The players take turns guessing letters to form a word or a saying. The game can be played with up to three human players. During their turn the players can spin the wheel, guess a consonant, buy a vowel or guess the password.
title: Koło Fortuny

description:
Koło Fortuny II is a game loosely based on the TV show Wheel of Fortune. The players take turns guessing letters to form a word or a saying. The game can be played with up to three players. Computer players can be defined by two difficulty levels. During their turn the players can spin the wheel, guess a consonant, buy a vowel or guess the password.

The game features text based graphics with no sound or music.
title: Koło Fortuny II

description:
Orto Puzzle is an educational game for kids. The player's task is to choose the correct spelling. The correct spelling needs to be selected from two different letters. The game highlights a part of the word the player needs to decide on. If correct, the word is replaced by a part of the picture, if not, it remains on the board and deduct one life. All twelve words must be solved with up to three errors.

The game features built in spelling rules and allows to choose specified orthographic set of words.
title: Orto Puzzle

description: Logger is a Frogger variant that as the title makes clear swaps the frog hero for a logger. Aside from the theme, it works like any version of the arcade game with the player starting out at the bottom of the screen and having to first move across a busy logging trail full of vehicles and then a river full of logs and barges. The aim is to reach one of the unoccupied cabins that are located at the top of the screen. A life is lost when hit by a vehicles, jumping into the river or moving outside the screen. Sometimes bears will appear on the grass strip in the middle and these too have to be avoided. Above the playing field is a sun moving from left to right and each level has to be completed before it sets. The player starts with three lives and gets an extra one when all five cabins are occupied.
title: Logger

description:
Stellar Triumph is a shoot 'em up game that is exclusively made for multiplayer battles between two players. Each player controls a space ship that is viewed from a top down perspective and has controls similar to Asteroids with the player being able to rotate the ship and use thrust to move it forward or backward. The objective is simply to shoot down the opponent while avoiding any of the environmental dangers that can be added to the game. Each player has a limited amount of fuel and shots which when depleted prevents the player from shooting or moving.

The game is highly customizable with a large number of options. For example the abilities of the ships and weapons can be modified. This include having inertia or not, the power of thrust and amount of fuel. Weapon options include velocity, rate of fire, amount of missiles and if it should fire single shots or have rapid fire. It is also possible to change how the space should behave and what objects should exist. One can choose to have a sun, a black hole or neither, how the gravity should work (negative, positive or none) and how strong it should be. Objects that can be added include asteroids, monoliths (which can be horizontal or vertical) and an alien ship. Another option is the screen setup where the player can choose wraparound (like in Asteroids), bounce back or Moebius universe.

sample_screenshots.caption: A simple game with a single asteroid
Another kind of alien passes by

title: Stellar Triumph

description: Lingos is a puzzle solving game, clone of Master Mind, where the player must guess a word within just five trials. After each trial computer shows how many letters were indicated right (white color) and how many appears in word, but in a different position (glowing color). The final number of trials determines awarded points.

sample_screenshots.caption: Glowing color means presence in other place

title: Lingos

description: This puzzle-board game requires laying 15 letters on a 4x4 grid board according to the alphabetical order indicated on the left side of the screen. Arranging the letters take place through appropriate use of one empty spot. Empty spot is used as a temporary storage area for adjacent letters.Each round differs in the initial arrangement of letters and the starting amount of points. Each move deducts points, reaching zero ends the game.
title: Puzzle

description: Kolor is a simple game where the player must remember the color shown in the very short moment. Before quessing the color the player must place a bet. Correct answer doubles the bet amount, the negative answer means losing raised money. The loss of all funds ends the game.
title: Kolor

description: As Polly, your task is to turn over a series of cards until it matches the one the game asks for. To turn a card over, you must highlight the card by walking underneath the bottom of it, and pressing the fire button. Depending on the number of screens you specify at the start of the game, a total of 52 cards can be in play. Some cards can reveal jokers that chase Polly around the screen, and these jokers must be avoided. If a joker catches Polly, then she goes back to the start of the current screen. Three levels, which can also be specified at the start, determine how difficult the game becomes. If neither the number of screens or the level is selected, a self-running demo shows you what you have to do, and this demo runs until Polly comes into contact with a joker.

sample_screenshots.caption: We are looking for the six of diamonds
Finally found the card Polly was looking for

title: Patience Polly

description: Burmistrz III is a management game, where the player as a city mayor must carry out activities resulting in a settlement of 10,000 residents. The game starts having $ 2.5 million, 100 people, 2 houses and a shop. One house can accommodate up to 50 residents. The game features following infrastructure: House, Shop, Bazaar, Factory, Glass, Stadium, Police, Circus, Zoo, Casino, Sex Shop. Each object attracts residents and generates revenues. At the end of the turn, the player receives information about the number of deaths, revenues, expenses and new citizens.
title: Burmistrz III

description:
Nibbly '92 is a worm/nibble/snake game, where the player controls a growing snake while eating dots in an enclosed maze.

The maze is contained on a single screen, and the snake must eat all the dots without being blocked by its own body, in order to get to the next screen with a new maze.

When sixteen levels have been played, the game repeats the mazes with more difficulty for the player by increasing the snake growth, until eventually the maze becomes impossible to solve.

This game is the predecessor to Super Nibbly.
title: Nibbly '92

description:
Koło fortuny is a game loosely based on the TV show Wheel of Fortune. The players take turns guessing letters to form a word or a saying. The game can be played with up to three human players. During their turn the players can spin the wheel, guess a consonant, buy a vowel or guess the password. The game is divided into 5 stages, passwords belong to one of nine categories.

The game features built-in passwords editor.
title: Koło Fortuny

description: Twierdza is a platform game, where the player must clear the stronghold from radioactive items by placing them in a special container. Radiation mutated all living creatures, therefore precise jumping and accurate shooting is required to complete the mission.Extra lives and the additional ammo power ups are scattered through the labyrinth. Some of the locations are inaccessible, reaching them requires finding of special keys.
title: Twierdza

description: Dr. Mad vs. the Topsy Turvy Moon Men of Mars is a platform game, where the player as a scientist must defeat the aliens from Mars who invaded the city. The aliens are hidden in the form of animals. Contact with them means a certain death, same as touching the obstacles or obtaining a bullet hit. Scientist can throw the purple vials. Numerous platforms can be run with the help of levers. The game features a few very extended levels.
title: Dr. Mad vs. the Topsy Turvy Moon Men of Mars

description: Eoroid is a text-moded puzzle solving game, played on a 20x15 board. The main goal requires removing all the blocks from the board within limited numbers of moves. By clicking on a single spot, the player affects all the fields around by their reversal, including the chosen one - filled block disappears and a blank spot is replaced with filled block. Basically, each taken action reverses simultaneously 9 fields, one in the middle, and 8 around (3x3 square).
title: Eoroid

description: Scarper! is a side scrolling shoot 'em up where the player's task is to protect ten computer programmers who have escaped from a prison on the planet Tubark. The programmers walk across a scrolling landscape that the player flies over and they have to walk many miles to reach the rescue ship located at the far right of the playing field. As they do so they will be under attack by the crudilites whom the player has to shoot before they can do any harm to the group of wanderers. The player's ship has an energy gauge that depletes when making contact with the enemies or the ground or when firing excessively. When it reaches zero a life is lost but it can be replenished by not firing.
title: Scarper!

description: Krisp is a variant of the arcade game Nibbler. The game takes place in a series of mazes (60 in total) each full of eggs and other objects. The player controls a snake and has to eat all the eggs to complete a level. As eggs are eaten the size of the snake grows which makes navigation through the maze harder since there is less left space. The snake can make contact with the walls but not with its own body since that leads to a life being lost and the stage has to be restarted. Lives are also lost when a level is not completed before time runs out. The player starts out with five lives with an additional one given upon reaching 50,000 points.

sample_screenshots.caption: Snake grows as eggs are eaten

title: Krisp

alternate_titles.description: Shortened title used in some ads
alternate_titles.title: Merry Christmas

description:
Merry Christmas from Melbourne House is a short graphical text adventure for kids. It's Christmas Eve and there is trouble at the North Pole. Can you help Santa to finish getting ready and deliver the presents on time? Players will have to solve a few simple puzzles while exploring the North Pole to help Santa on his way.

The game was released for 95p as mail-away for readers of Commodore User magazine in December 1984. The game includes ads for other Melbourne House software products available for sale for Christmas 1984.
title: Merry Christmas from Melbourne House

alternate_titles.title: Face Ache: The Man of a Million Faces

description: Face Ache is a game where the player gets to create different faces. There are six parts of the face that be modified: left hair, right hair, eyes, nose, mouth and chin. By pressing the corresponding keys the game cycles through the available features. When starting out the player can freely play around with the face or start an automatic demonstration. When initiating a game the player gets to see a face for five seconds and after that gets one minute to recreate the face. When finished ten points are awarded for each correct part of the face.

sample_screenshots.caption: Pressing the highlighted keys cycles through the parts

title: Face Ache

description:
Unbelievable!" Ultimate is a compilation containing the following four Commodore 64 games by Ultimate Play The Game:

  • Entombed
  • Staff of Karnath
  • Blackwyche
  • Imhotep
title: Unbelievable! Ultimate

description: 64Luff is a gomoku game. It's played on a 23 by 23 grid by one player against an AI opponent. The players take turns placing their o's and x's on the grid with the aim of getting five in a row. There are two game modes: normal and training. The training mode differs in that it's possible to undo a move and to ask the computer for the ideal next move. The game also has a save and recall option which allows the player to move back to an earlier stage in a game.
title: 64Luff

description:
Kalah is an adaptation of the board game with the same, which is part of the Mancala family of games. The game is played by one player against an AI opponent. Each player has six round pits and a Kalah, which is a longer pit. When starting out stones are evenly distributed to the round pits (3-6 in each depending on game options chosen) and the aim of the game is to collect more than half of the stones in the player's Kalah.

In each round the player takes all stones from one pit and distribute them anti clockwise around the board with one in each pit. If the last stone lands in the player's own Kalah he must make one more move. If the last stone ends in a pit on the player's side and the pit on the other side is empty, all stones in that pit will be captured. The game stops if no more moves can be made by the player and the opponent then gets to count his remaining stones to his total or when one player has more than half of the stones.
title: Kalah

description: Aliens have overtaken your home world and have limited trade in between the cities. You as the player, take on the role of a Corsair, a rebel trader risking life and limb to make some cash. As usual in this genre of games, you can buy and sell various types of merchandise, and buy upgrades for your ship. The player can also visit the local club, to gossip and also take their chances at the Gemini card game.

sample_screenshots.caption: Choose your next port of call
Playing the Gemini card game at a club
Flying in between cities - watch out for alien craft!

title: Corsair

description: This issue of Softdisk’s monthly disk magazine for the Commodore 64 is comprised of the usual assortment of games, music, utilities and graphics. Corsair and Magnetron are two entertainment titles included on this issue.

sample_screenshots.caption: The menu... Looking at this month's Funware games.
Reading the instructions for Magnetron with the menu.

title: Loadstar #70

description: Arcade Game Construction Kit (AGCK) is a game creation utility that allows creation of different types of arcade games (such as platform, maze games, etc). Everything is totally controlled by a joystick driven menu system, so no programming is required. The kit comes complete with six sample games showing off some of the various types of games that can be created with the kit.

sample_screenshots.caption: Musashi - One of the sample games - Level 2
AGCK Tutorial Game - One of the sample games - a simple Galaxian type game
Musashi - One of the sample games - Level 1
Space Worries - One of the sample games - Level 1
Isle Quest - One of the sample games

title: Arcade Game Construction Kit

description:
Stairways takes place at a bar, and the objective is to collect 7 pieces of the legendary amulet of the great budgie WONGA. Along the way, you shoot down hallucinations and avoid knocking over the other patrons' drinks.

The player character has three attributes; energy, hunger and how drunk he is. The hallucinations zap your energy and if he throws over a glass, the doorman comes over and kicks him out, resulting in a loss of a life.

If sobering up, it gets harder to keep the hallucinations at bay, by projecting thought bubbles at them. In order to maintain intoxication, the player can visit the bar to get more drunk, and hunger can be quenched at the burger kiosk to stave off starvation.

If you have collected all the pieces when a timer goes to zero, you move to the next level

sample_screenshots.caption: Getting kicked through the air because i ran into something

title: Stairways

description:
Odd things are going on at the Throne Group Science Complex. Kim, a lowly security guard, wakes up on a makeshift operating table - dimly recalling a sudden attack that had plunged the place into chaos. Apparently, shadowy experiments in robotics and nanotech have backfired horribly as the megalomaniac scientists' creations turned on them. She emerges, only to see a survivor being gunned down by a rogue drone; in his last words, he manages to impart enough information for her to go seek out the others still in hiding, and attempt to find out what's going on.

Hessian is a side-scrolling action/adventure game in the same mold as the author's Metal Warrior series. As Kim investigates the vast science complex, she'll need all her combat skills to take on her enemies, both machine and human. As part of the emergency procedure that saved Kim's life, her system had been boosted by a nanobot injection: in addition to enhancing her physical capabilities, this lets her regenerate her health - however, the tiny biomachines need a constant supply of battery power to remain functional. Various objects, weapons and nanotech upgrades may be found, picked up and used; progress is gained through exploration, communication with NPCs, and poking through the computer logs and other clues scattered throughout the compound.

There are four skill levels to choose from (which determine how much damage is sustained in combat), and five save slots to retain your progress. Should you die in action, there's also the "retry" option which starts you off from the last room entered.

sample_screenshots.caption: Rummaging through my inventory for a suitable weapon

title: Hessian

description: A variant of the arcade game QIX, in Rollerball the objective is to trap the ball the game is named after by filling 75% or more of the playfield using your 'space scriber'. If the ball comes in contact with you or your trail before you finish closing off the section, you lose a life. The primary difference between Rollerball and the original is a pair of 'Squeezer' enemies that move along the outlines of areas you have filled in.
title: Rollerball

description: In this single screen arcade game you have to use your Stunt Bike to navigate across the nine hazardous obstacle courses, from one end of the screen to the other. You control your bike by accelerating to jump between platforms and collect flags along the way. You jump by doing a wheely and hit a ramp. A fuel meter acts as a timer for the level. Once all flags are collected a portcullis opens and the level can be completed.
title: Stunt Bike

description:
Moonspire is a flip-screen exploratory sci-fi shmup. The game features over 260 screens to fight through and elaborate firing mechanics. The title is set on Arcturus 7, and involves an alien race called the Draxx that the player has to infiltrate. The Draxx had invaded and then called back their forces to the far side of the planet's only moon - taking with them the control orbs from the now rapidly cooling thermal-boosters.

This halts the terraforming process and is reverting the planet back to an inhabitable and desolate ice world. The player has to infiltrate the Draxx Moonspire, cause as much devastation as possible and reclaim the stolen orbs.
title: Moonspire

description:
In this puzzle game, the player is presented with the game field on which a specific region is marked. From the top Tetris-like blocks are randomly falling down (arrows indicate the place where they fall). The shape and texture of the block that is supposed to fall down is presented in the top right window.

The aim of the player is to arrange fallen blocks in the Cyberblocks shape so they can be destroyed. If they are destroyed in a specific region, the picture behind is uncovered and stage can be completed.

Unlike "Tetris", the player does not control the falling blocks but only those that are on the ground - moving them left or right to make space for new blocks. If two blocks of the same texture touch themselves, they will be inseparately linked - thus the block to move will be bigger. The game can be over when the player is out of Cyberblocks, or the tower with blocks is too high and they can not be placed in the well.

Before each stage, the player can choose a difficulty level among two different specific region shapes. Completion of the more difficult one will grant you a bigger bonus.

sample_screenshots.caption: Before each level the player is choosing the shape of a specific region that he needs to destroy.
The blocks are falling from the top and the player needs to make a space for them so they could destroy others and uncover the picture behind a specific region.
When the blocks uncover the whole specific region, the full picture is presented meaning the stage was completed.
... or when the tower is too high, the game is over.

title: CyberBlocks

description:
Alioth is a sci-fi platform game set on the planet of the same name. After an unsuccessful scientific experiment, a robot & operators are sent in to destroy everything. The robot is equipped with a gun, but some of the mutants have created a protective system against the bullets.

The amount of bullets is limited, but some of the killed mutants may leave an extra ammo. The player's task is to find out 10 parts of nuclear bomb and bring them to the start location in order to destroy the base.
title: Alioth

description: Moebius is a side scrolling shoot 'em up. It's set on a far away planet where the player takes control of Moebius, a space mercenary that has to battle the forces of The Controller, the ruler of the empire. The player can move Moebius left and right while shooting the various creatures and robots that appear before they crash into him. Each level is a different planet and the aim is to reach a transporter that takes Moebius to the next planet. Every planet has its own inhabitants that has to be fought. After a few levels the player will get access to a jetpack and later a hovercar. Using these cost fuel and when fuel is out they will explode. Fuel is automatically recharged when walking on the ground.

sample_screenshots.caption: The various buildings can be used for protection, since enemies tend to just crash into them

title: Moebius

description:
Arc Doors is an action game with some puzzle elements. The player controls a prince who has been turned into a frog by an evil wizard and thrown into a marsh filled with dangers. On each of the 50 levels the player must find the key and reach the exit. The game is shown in a top-down perspective, with the player able to move from tile to tile. As the wizard has taken away the prince's ability to swim, falling into water ends with immediate death. Getting across the water often requires leaping across lily pads, which regularly sink and resurface in a synchronized pattern.

The marsh is populated by a variety of creatures with different behavior patterns, most of which kill the player instantly upon contact. The monsters can be killed by shooting at them. However, the prince has a limited amount of energy, which is depleted each time the player moves or shoots. Running out of energy results in death, but powerups can be found to replenish it. The player can also come across heart pickups which give a bonus life.

sample_screenshots.caption: Beginning of Level 2. A flashing heart pickup is visible to the right

title: Arc Doors

description:
Genloc is a platform game similar to Hawkeye. The scientist Dr. Klein has created a "genmanipulated dragon" which has escaped from his lab. The hero, Shimon, must now destroy the dragon eggs to stop the beast from breeding.

The game consists of three levels. On each level the player must travel back and forth, in order to find and destroy eggs that appear one at a time. On his way, Shimon is menaced by undending hordes of respawning enemies of various kinds. The creatures can be avoided or shot with Shimon's gun. Shimon's energy, represented by a hourglass meter, gets depleted when he comes in close contact with the monsters, but it slowly regenerates on its own after a while. There is also a time limit, which is replenished once the player finds an egg. Running out of energy or time, or falling off the bottom of the screen, means losing a life.

After a specified number of eggs is found, the monsters disappear and a dragon boss appears, which must be killed to complete the level.

sample_screenshots.caption: A giant dragonfly... well, guess it's fitting in a game about dragons
Some sort of a large lizard
Running away from killer rabbits on level 2

title: Genloc

description:
This compilation includes:

  • Rockford: The Arcade Game
  • Back to Reality
title: Rockford: The Arcade Game + Back to Reality

description: A remake of the original Apple II version of the influential cinematic platformer Prince of Persia for the Commodore 64. The protagonist must avoid deadly traps and enemies in order to rescue the Sultan's lovely daughter.
title: Prince of Persia

description: This is a remake based on the Atari 7800 version of the classic Donkey Kong Junior arcade game by Nintendo with remade graphics and enhanced sound. In this game the tables have been turned, Donkey Kong Junior must rescue his father from the antagonist Mario, avoiding deadly snap-jaw traps, swooping birds and electric sparks along the way.
title: Donkey Kong Junior

description:
Time Archaeologist is a notable Hungarian text adventure game.

In the year 2546, the Time Archeology Association was founded, and you are an agent of it. You are commissioned to acquire one from the fabulous griffon bird's eggs, so you are sent back to the medieval times. You are not helped by modern technology.

The game features images about your current surroundings, a health meter, a progress indicator, and a compass showing the possible exits, plus some occasional musical cues. Save-load feature present. Hungarian characters set is supported by the parser.
title: Időrégész

description:
New Wild West is a Hungarian-specific text adventure game.

The human race has settled on the moon. The circumstances are like the Wild West. The Moon Mafia wants to take your property, and so the adventure begins.

The text descriptions about your surroundings are also visualized with simple images. A save-load feature is present. There are some occasional musical cues. The Hungarian character set is supported by the parser.
title: Új vadnyugat

description:
New Wild West 2 is a Hungarian specific text adventure game.

The adventures of the first game continue. The newly populated Moon is much like the Wild West, and the Moon Mafia wants your property. Last time, you have escaped from them with via a space liferaft that crashed back into the Moon.

The text descriptions about your surroundings are also visualized with simple images - plus there are some occasional musical cues. A save-load feature is present. The Hungarian character set is supported by the parser.
title: Új vadnyugat 2

description:
The Revenge is a Hungarian specific text adventure game.

This time you are in an Asian setting. A clan massacred your home village, and you go to seek revenge.

The descriptions are supported with images depicting your surroundings, and occasional musical cues. A save-load feature is present. The Hungarian character set is supported by the parser.
title: A bosszú

description:
Fazekas is a Hungarian text adventure game. You play as a student of the Fazekas Mihály high school. Your mission is to replace your lackluster physics test with a better one, before the original gets corrected by the teacher. You also have to manage your classes of the day, or skip them.

Your surroundings are depicted with a few simple images made of ASCII characters. Progress can be saved. A few Hungarian characters are supported, but only those that are present in the Swedish alphabet too.
title: Fazekas

description:
Iketa is a one-on-one fighting game. It offers both a two-player mode, and a one-player mode with several difficulty levels.

In the one-player mode, the player faces a progression of enemies, all of whom are ninjas wearing variously colored outfits. The player must win two rounds in each fight to move on to the next opponent. There are a number of moves available, such as a high kick or a jumping kick. Each battle lasts a maximum of 80 seconds; if the timer runs out, the game is over.

sample_screenshots.caption: An old man introduces each opponent, declares the winner, and announces a game over

title: Iketa

description:
This retail compilation contains four wargames:

  • Battle for Normandy
  • Combat Leader
  • Knights of the Desert
  • The Battle of the Bulge: Tigers in the Snow
title: War Game Greats

description:
Fred's Back is a platform game where the player controls Fred, a waddling head-shaped creature. On each level Fred must collect all the diamonds and then exit the level by walking off the right edge of the map. Fred loses a life if his energy, which is constantly depleting, falls down to zero; it must be replenished by collecting food. Other ways to die include touching one of the monsters that keep randomly walking onto the screen, and falling into a bottomless pit.

The levels contain brick platforms which can be broken by hitting them with Fred's head, as well as brown tiles which sometimes reveal bonus items when hit. The items include bonus diamonds, bonus lives, potions that fully replenish energy, and a weapon that allows Fred to shoot the monsters.

sample_screenshots.caption: Fred's about to run out of energy...

title: Fred's Back

description:
Five Brilliant Sport Action Games is a compilation that contains the following five games:

  • Adidas Championship Football
  • Beach Volley
  • Basket Master
  • Pro Tennis Tour
  • Run the Gauntlet
title: Five Brilliant Sport Action Games

description: Stellar Wars is a space based shooting game played from a first-person perspective. The player is being attacked by a squadron of stellar fighters and has 100 seconds to shoot as many as possible. The game is played with a joystick which is used to move around a firing sight and to fire the ship's twin lasers as an enemy gets within the sight. If an enemy fighter gets too close the player loses control of the ship and is unable to move or shoot for a few seconds. Firing too much leads to overheating and a temporary inability to fire. Points are scored for each fighter shot down with far away enemies being worth more. Reaching 1,000 and then 3,500 points leads to the player being given 50 extra seconds. The game ends when the time runs out.

sample_screenshots.caption: Getting bonus points and extra time

title: Stellar Wars

description: Turn It 2: Future Edition is a Shanghai variant. The player has to remove the tiles with the same marks from the board until all the board is completely empty. The elimination of tiles is allowed if these tiles are projected on the same line with no other tiles in their projection path. There are a certain number of same items on each level. The player can mark the tiles, or cancel the action to change the decision. The dead-ends exist if the strategy of tiles elimination was incorrect. Games are time-limited and a certain number of 'next move' suggestions are available during gameplay.
title: Turn It 2: Future Edition

description: Rescuing Orc is a jump-and-run game where you control a goblin and are armed with a sword. The mission is to find out what happened to your Orc friend. There are five different areas to explore.
title: Rescuing Orc

description: 1,000 Kung-Fu Maniacs! is a beat-em-up that takes place in the city of Blapsville. Your quest is to find a stolen toy robot. You fight your way from right to left by beating many Ninjas, Mimes and other enemies. The game features power-ups and a boss battle.
title: 1,000 Kung-Fu Maniacs!

description: Z-Zone is a vertically scrolling shoot'em up. The graphics are very much inspired by Andrew Braybrook's "Alleykat", but the gameplay is much different. Your ship is flying very slow while you can pick up the letter "P" and shoot the jumping dots for points. Sometimes enemy ship formations fly down the screen which you can shoot with your weapon. Hitting anything is your instant death: enemy ships, obstacles or jumping dots. After flying some time the ship suddenly flies a bit faster, but you cannot control the speed yourself.
title: Z-Zone

description: Zyx is a puzzle game. The game starts with two fixed points on a board. Arrows move slowly from the top, bottom, left or right onto the board. You can turn the direction of the arrow and move it up/down or left/right. If the arrow does not stop on one of the board fields the game is over. When the arrows are placed in the correct formation they will disappear.

sample_screenshots.caption: A new blue arrows move onto the board

title: Zyx

description: Argus is a role playing adventure. Your aim is to find the captured Starchild. The game has 1500 locations to explore and you will fight many monsters on your journey. Extra weapons, keys and other items can be found to help you. An animated introduction and end sequences have been created and there is a game save and loading function. The graphics and overall presentation are heavily inspired by the 1991 Psygnosis game Obitus.
title: Argus

description:
Scramble 64 is an unofficial Scramble variant. Besides the graphical differences, the biggest change is that the bombs fall in a horizontal line instead of an angle.

Scramble 64 is a side scrolling shooter. Piloting a plane through varied (and mountainous) terrain, your goal is to infiltrate an enemy base and destroy it. Missiles, tanks, UFOs, and other enemy artillery can all be found and will try to stop you. Colliding with any of these enemies, enemy fire, or the landscape will cause you to lose one of your planes. To fight back, your plane is equipped with both bombs and guns which can destroy most of the enemies you'll encounter. Your plane has a limited amount of fuel, and you'll crash if you run out. To replenish the fuel supply, you must bomb the fuel depots which will appear on the ground occasionally.
title: Scramble 64

description: Agent 0013 is a german adventure game with graphics. Instead of using a parser, this game uses different multiple choice options in every location. The story is short: you made it to Dr. Yes island and got into his fortress. Now you have to search for the plans of his world sabotage machine.
title: Agent 0013

description: This is an arcade adventure similar to Dizzy series and set in medieval fantasy world. The goal of the game is to find the pearl of dawn and to do so you'll have to explore many screens, including the castle and it's surroundings. The basic gameplay is a typical action game without platform jumping elements, however besides slaughtering or avoiding all types of enemies you also need to solve "puzzles" - pick up objects lying on the ground and then find where to use them to proceed further. Pearl of Dawn features many interconnected screens that can be freely traversed back and forth. The game features 2.5D-like-graphics - think Golden Axe, but characters can only move in two planes.
title: The Pearl of Dawn

description:
Mr. Dillworth sees his end coming and so he decides to make his will. But which of the possible charity organisations should get it all? Of course the one who can solve his riddles! As the last of the candidates, the player receives three hints and searches Dillworth's premises...

Riddle of the Redstone is closer to a choose-your-own-adventure than a traditional text adventure. While the player still enters the commands into a parser, there are only two or three available at a time. If the first try does not fit the options, the game explicitly lists the available choices. After entering a command, a text describes what is happening and leads to the next decision point. For example, after starting a game the player needs to choose which of three hints to follow first which locks the path the game follows next.

Depending on the choices made, the player may die or lose the game. Then it is necessary to either load an old save or start all over. Occasionally the player finds bags which show the progress of the current puzzle: the green bag means good, the yellow caution and the red failure. While the majority of the game is text-only, sometimes a picture is shown to illustrate the text.
title: Riddle of the Redstone

description:
This compilation contains two games: Eoroid* is a puzzle game played on a 19x9 board. The main goal is to remove all the blocks from the board within limited numbers of moves. By clicking on a single spot, the player affects all the fields around by their reversal, including the chosen one. The filled block disappears and a blank spot is replaced with the filled block. Basically, each taken action reverses simultaneously 9 fields, one in the middle, and 8 around (3x3 square). The game features 60 levels altogether.

  • Acid Runner is a Lode Runner variant. The game is all about timing and proper usage of ladders and ropes while avoiding all the enemies and obstacles. The protagonist needs to collect all items scattered out over the levels and reach the escape doors before the time runs out. The task is complicated by numerous enemies roaming around which should be avoided and various electrical discharges. The only way to get rid of a guard is to make a hole in the ground, which may be used as temporary prison. After a certain amount of time a hole is filled up and the guard regains freedom. The game features 30 levels.
title: Eoroid / Acid Runner

description:
This compilation includes one educational game and three programs:* Ortotris is a Tetris variant. The game takes place in the same manner except that the player does not stack bricks but words. The player's task is to choose the correct spelling. The correct spelling indicated at the bottom of the screen needs to be selected from different choices by using the left or right cursor keys. The game highlights a part of the word the player needs to decide on. If correct, the selection is deleted, if not, it remains. On the right side of the screen displays the percentage of correctness of the answers. The game ends with the degree of exposure.The game has a mode of practice and theory of all types of polish spelling.

  • Historia
  • Geografia
  • Chemia
title: Edukacja

description: 10 Pin is a simple bowling game. By pressing a single key you choose if the ball is thrown straight, left or right and then you choose the starting point of the ball throw. Depending on your choices the ball will throw over pins and the next round begins. Two players can play alternate in throwing balls.
title: 10 Pin

description: The game contains four 4x4 plates on top of each other and the intention is to get four in a row instead of three in a row as in traditional Tic Tac Toe. You can play only play against the computer.

sample_screenshots.caption: Title Screen/Who will make the first move? (French)

title: 3D Tic Tac Toe

description: 9 to 5 Typing is an educational game for learning 10 finger typing on the C64. In one of the typing games, a woman is running away from a man. When you take too long time to type the random words, the man will catch her. If you type fast enough she will successfully run away from him. In another typing game a woman will swing a lasso. When you type fast enough she will throw the lasso around the neck of the man standing opposite of her.
title: 9 to 5 Typing

description: A Bee C's is an educational game for little children. It teaches the alphabet by using a hardware speech module addon (Magic Voice) for the C64. You can either learn the letters or play a game where you have to find the correct letters.
