sample_screenshots.caption: The bee presents all the letters

title: A Bee C's

description: ABC is a simple puzzle game. The game shows you the alphabet on the left side. On the right side the alphabet will be mixed up and you have to put it in the correct order again. You can only move one letter into the empty box. This way you have to swap all the letters until the puzzle is solved.
title: ABC

description: In Abhor your aim is to avoid getting hit by the bubbles that move in a front from left to right. You can move your craft left and right a bit and up and down. There is a small gap between the bubbles which you have to maneuver through.
title: Abhor

description: Advanced Space Battle is a turn based space strategy game for 1 to 4 players. Your aim is to build the largest empire without getting killed by your opponents or the natives. The game features two game modes. Classic mode is similar to the public domain game Space Battle Deluxe. Advanced mode features more complex rules and planetary management, which is done by the AI in classic mode.
title: Advanced Space Battle

description: The Adventures of Jim Slim in Dragonland (Jim Slim) is a jump and run game. You play as Jim the ball whos aim is to retrieve a magical skull which was stolen by a demon. The game features 15 worlds with 3 levels each.
title: The Adventures of Jim Slim in Dragonland

description: Wyspa is an adventure game, where the player has to find a way to leave an island. To reach the goal the player must use various items in the right places or give them to appropriate NPCs. There is no inventory limit or possibility to use item inappropriately. The game screen is divided into two parts - location view and informative part (inventory, object, description, conversation).
title: Wyspa

description: Island is a strategy game, where the player must perform appropriate actions to survive and get out of a deserted island. In each turn only one type of action may be taken: collecting water, looking for a food, sending a message, gathering planks, resting. Selected activities involve danger and specific consequences. The key to success is gathering stocks, appropriate distribution forces and avoiding hazards. Escape is possible after building a raft or finding a letter in a bottle by a ship.
title: Island

description: Speed Runner is a 'Light Cycle' game for two human players. The game consist of 10 duels. Each player drives around the board leaving a solid trail behind. The collision with the trail or the board edge means a loss of the duel. The winner of more duels wins the game.
title: Speed Runner

description: Brave is a sci-fi platform game set on the alien planet. While traveling back to home planet the ship has crashed. The player has to repair the ship by finding 2 parts on each of 4 bases while avoiding or eliminating numerous enemies. The amount of bullets is limited, but some of the killed mutants may leave an extra ammo.
title: Brave

description: Ballz I is a Tetris and Galaxian fusion, where the player must hit falling circles before they reach the bottom of the board. The task requires hitting a circle with a ball to push it back for a specified time. Reaching the designated time allow access the next level.
title: Ballz I

description: Nocturno is a puzzle solving game, featuring 99 levels. Each level requires reaching the end spot by jumping on proper tiles before the time runs out. There are several types of tiles, differing in the way and direction of the ball's rebound. Jumping off from the tile causes immediate disappearance of it. Falling from a tile means a loss of life.
title: Nocturno

description: Pluff is a platform game, where the player must search for the coin of power in order to leave the maze. The main character has to go around the place and collect various objects. Three items can be carried simultaneously. Pluff will meet many unfriendly creatures and unpleasant surprises, but he will also find keys for opening doors, wires for making traps and other useful items. Pluff is weaponless, therefore the only way to avoid enemies is proper use of jumping skill. The player has to collect a sufficient number of weights, that after placing them in spots marked with arrows, will rise up a stone giving access to the remaining part of the maze, concealing the coin of power.
title: Pluff

description:
Upside Down is a classic puzzle game, where the player must arrange a picture on 5x5 board before the time runs out. The game starts from showing a picture. After mixing puzzles the player has designated time to rearrange them back. The indicated puzzle can be moved only on the black spot.

The game features 8 pictures.
title: Upside Down

description:
Upside Down v2 is a classic puzzle game, where the player must arrange a picture on 5x5 board before the time runs out. The game starts from showing a picture. After mixing puzzles the player has designated time to rearrange them back. The indicated puzzle can be moved only on the black spot.

The game features 14 pictures.
title: Upside Down v2

description: Triss is a platform game, where the player must stop Hephyr from taking over the world. The main task requires recovering 20 magical stones of Thefrog, scattered around Hephyr mansion. Triss will meet many unfriendly creatures and unpleasant obstacles, but he will also several useful items. Eight items can be carried simultaneously. Triss is weaponless, therefore the only way to avoid enemies is proper use of jumping skill.
title: Triss

description: Gwiezdny Manager is a turn based space strategy. The player takes on the character of the administrator of one of a planet. The task is to ensure the development of infrastructure, production, mining, agriculture and combat fleet, population growth and trade relations. Starting from one planet the player may discover and colonize or conquer the entire star system. The materials are divided into two groups - food and minerals. Minerals are required for production and buildings a weaponry. The player may trade via financial and commodity exchanges. The materials may be acquired by harvest, trade or facility's production. Population development requires the construction of hospitals, police, schools, cinemas, housing estates, steelworks, power plants, banks or military forces. Growing requires the purchase of grain and land, employment of workers, sowing and harvesting of crops. Each round ends with a summary of changes, information about needs and random events.
title: Gwiezdny Manager

description: 5x5 is a puzzle-board game for two players, based on the TV show called "5 on the 5". The player's task is to guess a five letter password in five attempts. After typing each password the game shows the result. Correctly guess a letter is highlighted with blue color, the letter appearing in the password in a different position is highlighted with yellow color. Number of performed trials decides who won the turn and who will start the next one.
title: 5x5

description: Deadly Crystals is an arcade game, where the player must acquire all the diamonds scattered around the maze before the time runs out. The labyrinth is inhabited by numerous creatures moving along the same paths. Each contact with them means a loss of life. There is no weapon available, perfect timing is the key to scavenge all the diamonds without getting killed. There is an unlimited number of levels.
title: Deadly Crystals

description: GirlTRIS is a classic Tetris game with some adult elements. Each level requires completing designated number of puzzles rows. Filling the task discovers a new image of a girl. The game features five difficulty levels, differing with number of rows necessary to complete the task and speed of falling bricks.
title: GirlTRIS

description: Fugitive is another simplified single screen Space Invaders alike title. As a space fighter pilot player must defeat the alien fleet, occurring in the orbit of the planet. The aircraft may be moved in all directions: left, right, top and bottom. Each contact with an enemy unit takes some amount of energy level.
title: Fugitive

description: Familiada is a puzzle-board game for two players, loosely based on the TV show. The player's task is to guess four answers to a question, with the possibility of making two mistakes. Third mistake passes the question to the other player. Every correct answer is scored. The winner of more points wins the turn. The round starts with a duel who first presses the button and gives a correct answer.
title: Familiada

description: Komputerowy Teleturniej Gra is a puzzle-solving game with arcade elements for two players. Victory requires gaining 9 points. Correct stoppage on the opponent's field and correct answer to a question are rewarded with one point. Opponent player receives a point and takes over the game when stoppage error is occurred. Same rules apply with incorrect answers.
title: Komputerowy Teleturniej Gra

description: Miliard w Rozumie is a puzzle-board game for two, loosely based on the TV show. The task of the player requires answers to 15 questions, sorted in 12 possible categories, each containing 3 subcategories. Each question allows to select one of four answers. The correct answer is rewarded with 1 point, bad one gives a point to computer. The final screen shows the result of answers and points rewarded.
title: Miliard w Rozumie

description: Magic Ball is a simple arcade game, where the player must catch as many objects with dollar sign as possible, avoiding any other items falling to the bottom of the well. Catching dollar gives is rewarded with points, connecting with red item means a loss of life. Each set of objects consists of three elements.
title: Magic Ball

description: Puzzlacki is a classic puzzle game with 8 available pictures. The player may setup difficulty level and timer or select any of the pictures. The game screen is divided into three parts: table with mixed puzzles, timer, picture frame.
title: Puzzlacki

description: Jump Ball is a timed arcade game, where the player must collect all the keys scattered around the maze before the time runs out. The player controls the bouncing ball and must avoid all obstacles. Contact with any of them means a loss of life. Sequence of key collection is the key to passing the level. Wrong choice at this point ends with a lack of time.
title: Jump Ball

description: Star Lifter is a horizontal space shooter, set in 2150. The player is a long range penetration unit, on a one man mission behind enemy lines. His task requires disrupting enemy activities by destroying alien space convoys. At each level there is a specified number of craft to destroy. The ship may be shifted in every direction, although the screen is moving constantly to the right.
title: Star Lifter

description: Cosmic Biznes is a space planetary arrangement of the classic board game Monopoly for up to five human players. The game features all of the official rules of the original board game, reproducing most aspects of the gameplay. The primary difference is the theme of the game. The player buys planets on a various galaxies. The game screen consists of a top-down view of the board. Events, comments and descriptions appear on a separate screen in text form. Each uninhabitable planet may be enhanced by building 4 bases and colony. Each modernization increases the penalty paid by the enemy for intrusion into the foreign territory. The board contains also neutral, special, and random encounter fields.
title: Cosmic Biznes

description: Sea Route to India is a text based game with graphic elements, where the player must sail from Lisbon to India. Task completion requires food (whale fishing) and water (rain, river) replenishment, avoiding dangerous random events (pirates, natives) and taking care about crew spirit (ship races). Proper planing and deciding will allow reach the coast of India before Vasco da Gama.
title: Sea Route to India

description: Arthema is a single screen arcade game, where the player must collect all the items on the board, while avoiding any contact with hostile creatures. There is no weapon available, therefore performing the task requires proper using of jumping skill and facilities present on the board, temporarily affecting the character - such as a higher jump arrow.
title: Arthema

description: Black Knight takes place in 1980, when an evil sorcerer appeared in the Dunkan's kingdom, settled the abandoned castle and began to rob the local inhabitants. Kidnapping a daughter of the king named Reja forced him to hire a black knight, whose task is to defeat Mephistopheles and rebound from his hands the successor of the throne. As a knight the player must go through the castle, defeat numerous enemies and avoid magical traps. Reaching the next levels requires finding a key that will open the closed bars. Numerous magical items scattered around the castle can be as helpful as a faithful knight's companion - a sword.
title: Black Knight

description: Knoorkie is a platform game, where the player - as a pig named Knoorkie - must find a solution to defeat a dragon, harassing local residents. The task requires solving many puzzles, finding useful objects, performing tasks ordered by the inhabitants. The action takes place in the castle and its surroundings, such as forest, coal mine, abandoned village, undergrounds. Defeating the dragon requires the acquisition of 20 horseshoes scattered throughout the area (depriving him of immortality) and a silver sword to lop off his head.
title: Knoorkie

description: Manganoid is an Arkanoid variant for up to two players. Regardless of the number of players there are two palettes available - one the top and left side. Removing cubes from the board reveals a manga style picture. All other Arkanoid rules apply, especially bonuses facilitating (two balls) or hindering (smaller pads) the task.
title: Manganoid

description: Under the Ground is a simple single screen arcade game. As a wagon operator, the player has to catch all the pieces of coal falling from above. The wagon can only be moved to the right and to the left side. Every failed attempt ends with a loss of life.
title: Under the Ground

description: The Underground is a simple single screen arcade game. As a wagon operator, the player has to catch all the diamonds falling from above. The wagon can only be moved to the right and to the left side. Every failed attempt ends with a loss of life.
title: The Underground

description:
Bomberman C64 is a clone of Bomber Man. The player's task is to kill all the hostile creatures on the board. The player may use bombs, although the bombs must be used with extra caution, as the explosion blast moves 3 fields in each direction.

The game features 8 levels all together.
title: Bomberman C64

description: Deadly Messengers is a simple single screen space shooter for two players. Both players' space fighters are deployed on opposite sides of the orbit. Their task is to defeat the enemy by proper use as shields constantly moving horizontally asteroids. Space ships may be moved only right and left side.
title: Deadly Messengers

description: James Fly is a side-scrolling arcade game. As a James, the fly, the player must scavenge the castle in search for gold coins and other useful items. The screen is divided into two parts - gameplay and informational ones. The bottom part shows acquired points, number of lives and draws a map of a known patch area. James has no weapon, therefore jumping with appropriate run speed adjustment is the only way to avoid contact with numerous hostile creatures.
title: James Fly

description: Mine Sweeper 9000 is a clone of classic Minesweeper. It allows to select difficulty level, customize board size, define controls, choose a background tune and save/load state of the game. All the other rules remain unchanged, including marking cells and mistake consequences.
title: Mine Sweeper 9000

description: Saper is a text based Minesweeper, a conversion of ZX Spectrun game of the same title. The gameplay rules remain unchanged. Selected dot shows the number of bombs in the neighborhood. The detected mine may be marked with green color.
title: Saper

description: Saper 2 is a clone of classic Minesweeper, a conversion of ZX Spectrun game of the same title. The gameplay rules remain unchanged. Selected spot shows the number of bombs in the neighborhood. The detected mine may be marked with green color.
title: Saper 2

description: Saper 3 is a clone of classic Minesweeper, a conversion of ZX Spectrun game of the same title. The gameplay rules remain unchanged. Selected spot shows the number of bombs in the neighborhood. The detected mine may be marked with green color. The game allows to define board size (max 40x24) and number of bombs (max 960).
title: Saper 3

description: Saper is a clone of classic Minesweeper. The gameplay rules remain unchanged. Selected spot shows the number of bombs in the neighborhood. The detected mine may be marked. The game allows to select one of three available difficulty levels.
title: Saper

description: Minefield is a clone of classic Minesweeper. The gameplay rules remain unchanged. Selected spot shows the number of bombs in the neighborhood. There is no possibility to select any gameplay aspects. The player has limited time to finish the board - 1000 seconds.
title: Minefield

description: Coldiarus is a clone of classic Minesweeper, featuring colorful graphics. The gameplay rules remain unchanged. Selected spot shows the number of bombs in the neighborhood. The game allows to define the number of mines from 10 up to 50.
title: Coldiarus

description: Super Saper is a clone of classic Minesweeper, featuring simple grey graphics. The gameplay rules remain unchanged. Selected spot shows the number of bombs in the neighborhood. The game has basic options, allowing to select number of bombs on board.
title: Super Saper

description: Okręty is a computer version of the pen-and-paper Battleship game. The game features 2 playing board, one with hidden ships, second one for performing hits. The player must find and sink one 4 fields ship, 2 three fields ships, 3 two fields ships and 4 one field ships.
title: Okręty

description: Osar II is a single screen shooting game, where the player must hit the alien creature with a laser beam, while avoiding enemy attacks. Double enemy laser hit in the same ground spot damages the surface and form a hole. The hole is limiting the movement area, as contact with it means a loss of life.
title: Osar II

description: Skidmarx is a simplified clone of Skidmarks, released on Amiga back in 1993, for up to two players. The race takes place on a single screen track. The first car that complete designated number of laps win the race. A few types of cars are available, number of tracks and color of vehicles are fully adjustable.
title: Skidmarx

description: Zdeba Puzzle is a puzzle game with erotic pictures. The goal of the game is to rearrange the puzzle pieces in order to complete the picture, returning each piece to its proper place, introduced at the start. To move a puzzle piece the player must select two pieces that will switch places. The number of gained points depends on time and number of performed moves.
title: Zdeba Puzzle

description: Tanks is an enhanced real-time clone of classic game of the same title. The game features only two player mode designed for human players. Each player has three tanks located at the opposite ends of the map. Tanks can move around the board and perform shots by setting the direction and the power of the height of the tank lift. The winner is the first team that will destroy enemy all tanks.
title: Tanks

description:
Diamenty is a puzzle-solving game. In each level the player must push around same pattern cubes in order to connect them together. Once connected cubes of same pattern disappear from the board. The left panel shows how many same cubes are present on the board. It is very important to control the number of cubes, as there can't be only one piece left. Cubes may be connected diagonally and horizontally, two or even three simultaneously.

The game features 99 levels.
title: Diamenty

description: Niedziela Cudów is a football management game. The game allows you to choose one team from the Polish first league. The game contains very basic club's finance options, such as buying and selling players or ticket pricing. Incomes are fully connected with current league position. There is no graphic presentation of the match or text comments. During the match only three information are displayed: elapsing time, time of scoring a goal and current match score.
title: Niedziela Cudów

description:
Triple Decker 7 is a compilation of the following three games for the Commodore 64:

  • Olympic Skier
  • Pacmania as Pac Manic
  • Dizasterblaster as Blaster
title: Triple Decker 7

description:
Spekulant Europejski is a simple trade game, which consists of buying and selling 6 kinds of goods in 6 cities around the world. Players can buy and sell goods, borrow money and travel to other cities. During the trip various events may occur. Winning the game requires earning 10.000.000 dollars.

The game is played in a text mode, graphic elements are displayed only during the journey
title: Spekulant Europejski

description: Escape is a platform game. The task of the player is to find 13 crystal cubes in order to get out of the labyrinth by the magical portal. The protagonist is weaponless, so the only way to avoid enemies is a good timing and jumping ability. The maze is inhabited by numerous hostile creatures. Contact with them or with purple ladder and floor takes some amount of energy. A fall from the heights or contact with falling rocks takes life. Some useful items may be found in the maze, for example extra energy and surprise pack, with various numbers of points. Points are necessary to access local teleports, moving to another part of the labyrinth.
title: Escape

description: Toxic Adventure is a side scrolling platform game, in the style of Bobix. The aim of the player is to get all the sacks scattered around the level and get to the final exit chamber. Then escape is possible only after gathering all 180 sacks. The action takes place in a city and it's sewers, inhabited by alien creatures. The only way to avoid them is proper use of jumping skills and selecting safe paths. Access to closed areas requires finding the right lever.
title: Toxic Adventure

description: Logic Game is a single board puzzle solving, where the player must place the numbers on the board according to the digits sequence. The game is played by moving a single number to a free area. Results are determined by the time and number of transfers.
title: Logic Game

description: Gra logiczna: O i X is an adaptation of tic-tac-toe, played versus the computer on a 3 by 3 board. The goal is to arrange three O's or X's in a row. The human player starts the game. A symbol is placed by typing the number of the chosen square of the board.
title: Gra logiczna: O i X

description: Samowolka is a text adventure game set in the Polish army, with the plot based on the movie of the same title. Due to the acute vocabulary the game is intended only for adult players. The player can choose one of three soldiers of different military rank and from his perspective, learn the pathology of the army in a specially matched adventure.
title: Samowolka

description: Fliptris is is a variant of classic Tetris game. Each level requires completing designated number of puzzles rows (vertically, horizontally, diagonally) of the same pattern. The game shows an incoming block. The block can be moved to the left or to the right, while the pattern on the blocks may be moved up and down. Each completed row disappears and discovers a part of a hidden image. Discovering the entire image moves to the next level.
title: Fliptris

description: O i X is an adaptation of tic-tac-toe, played versus the computer on a 20 by 20 board. The goal is to arrange five O's or X's in a row. The human player can choose if he wants to go first. Each completed row gives a point.
title: O i X

description: Ortografia is a timed educational game. The player's task is to choose the correct spelling. The screen displays a word and the player must decide within 10 second whether it's a proper spelling or not. The game allows to select type of exercise, the number of words and time to make a decision. After finishing the task the player receives a final note, depending on the number of mistakes.
title: Ortografia

description: It's an educational program teaching Polish spelling. The player's task is to choose the correct spelling. The screen displays a word and the player must decide within a designated time whether it's the proper spelling or not. The game allows to select the type of exercise, the number of words and time to make a decision. After finishing the task, the player receives a final note, depending on the number of mistakes. In addition to tests, the program also includes a second part with theory.
title: Program Edukacyjny w Pigułce: Język Polski

description:
Ortografia is an educational game. The player's task is to write the correct spelling. The game shows a word with an empty space and the player needs to decide on what letter to write.

The game features dictionary editor, allowing to add unlimited number of words.
title: Ortografia

description: Seria edukacyjna: Matematyka kl. III-IV is an educational title, allowing to practice arithmetical operations at an elementary level. The games allow to select one of six basic mathematical operations, number of exercises and number of digits involved.
title: Seria edukacyjna: Matematyka kl. III-IV

description:
Killer is a timed word-guessing game based on Hangman. To save their life the player has to guess the password. The player may choose each of the letters (consonants and vowels), a wrong answer causes the gallows to fall one level. The letter panel shows letters which are incorrect and the last chosen one.

The game features three difficulty levels .
title: Killer

description:
Red 200 is a game similar to Robbo, a puzzle game in which the player guides a robot. The player must collect all screws scattered around the board while avoiding deadly magnets, nuclear signs and other obstacles. In order to not become attracted by a magnet it's necessary to cover it with a box. Getting to a specific part of a maze requires the use of an appropriate item. Collecting all screws opens an exit door to the next level.

The game features 200 levels.
title: Red 200

description: Hobbit czyli w te i wewte... is a game introduced by the author as first Polish text adventure title. The game is played in the world known from the Hobbit book. The task requires taking a brilliant sphere from the room of Smoug and delivering it to Gandalf. The player performs activities by using text commands. The text is very complex, there are no graphic elements in the game.
title: Hobbit czyli w te i wewte...

description: Gem Mania is a puzzle-board game. The player has to change all the red circles to the green ones. A selected circle changes the color to the opposite, along with the four adjacent circles (top, down, left, right). A black red changes color to green, and green circle to red. There is no limit of moves allowed.
title: Gem Mania

description: Negatron is a timed puzzle-board game for two players. The player has to change all the yellow squares to the blue ones. A selected square changes the color to the opposite, along with the four adjacent squares (top, down, left, right). A yellow changes color to blue, and yellow circle to blue.
title: Negatron

description: Invertus is a timed puzzle board game. The player has to change all the black squares to the white ones. A selected spot consisting of 4 (2x2) squares changes the color to the opposite. A black changes color to white, and white to black. Each level contains more inverted squares in an increasingly difficult configuration.
title: Invertus

description:
Scortia is an arcade game, a clone of Arkanoid. The gameplay features all the classic elements. The task requires clearing the play field of the blocks by hitting a ball with the paddle positioned at the bottom of the screen. Certain blocks release bonuses or unsafe surprises. Shiny bricks can't be removed from the board, causing the ball to rebound in various directions.

The game features 25 levels.
title: Scortia

description: Bombel is a Frog variant. The game requires moving around the board for a specified amount of time in order to avoid shifting horizontally rock blocks . There are 8 rows of blocks, moving in different directions with different speed and acceleration . The player may move to the left and to the right site or change the row level.
title: Bombel

description: Target is a single screen space shooter. The aim requires defending the planet from waves of enemy ships. The player controls a gun that can move to the right and to the left side. The level is completed when the cannon manages to survive for a specified period of time.
title: Target

description:
Szlak Miecza is a text adventure game set in Alhamoor country. The story starts when the forces conquered the kingdom. As a young mercenary named Sorton the player must reach the underworld headquarters of the enemy, defeat the leader and steal the magic sword, necessary to defeat the fire knights scattered across the land.

The game has a narrative character. The action takes place by selecting one of several available options.
title: Szlak Miecza

description:
An early online service that laid down the technical framework for the later Quantum Link, PlayNET featured a GUI which (among other activities) allowed for easy play of parlour games against real players in remote locations, all through the very narrow bottleneck of early '80s ~300 baud modems. Thirteen games included on the disk, distributed (in some areas) with new Commodore 64 computers, included:

  • Backgammon,
  • Boxes,
  • Capture the Flag,
  • Checkers,
  • Chess,
  • Chinese Checkers,
  • Contract Bridge,
  • Four in a Row,
  • Go,
  • Hangman,
  • Quad 64,
  • Reversi,
  • and Sea Strike
title: PlayNET

description: Luna Landa is a single screen arcade game. Moonbase 69 is under an alien attack. The task requires rescuing the stranded lunar scientists and return them to the Mothership before the fuel runs out. In order to complete the mission the player must land safely on the lander get back into orbit, avoiding numerous hostile ships moving horizontally from one side to another and performing vertical shoots. Using engine booster takes extra fuel, which can be supplemented only in the base. The lander can perform shots on the way back to the Mothership
title: Luna Landa

description: Mr. Ant is a clone of Pac-Man. The goal of the game requires collecting all the yellow dots on the board, while avoiding 4 hostile opponents moving around the maze. Contact with them means a loss of life. Unlike Pac-Man, there are no special dots in the game, allowing to eat the enemies, or the fruits giving extra points.
title: Mr. Ant

description: Guesser is a timed puzzle-board game, based on the TV show called "5 on the 5". The player's task is to guess a five letter password in five attempts. After typing each password the game shows the result. Correctly guess a letter is highlighted with white color, the letter appearing in the password in a different position is highlighted with yellow color.
title: Guesser

description:
Krzyżówka is a computer adaptation of classic crosswords. It features 26 sets of crosswords, 600 passwords, 45 selectable music tracks. Standard rules apply, passwords are vertical and horizontal. When you select the arrow, the phrase is displayed. The password is entered using the keyboard.

The game has built in password editor.
title: Krzyżówka

description: Zamczysko is a platform game set in the haunted castle. The task requires finding 5 diamonds guarded by numerous traps and hostile creatures. Contact with any of them takes some amount of energy that can't be replenished. Closed doors require finding the key. Falling from highs takes no energy.
title: Zamczysko

description: Colee is a simple puzzle-solving game. The goal requires finding all the covered pairs of pictures on the board. Discovered pairs disappear from the board. There is a time limit, the counter on the right panel indicates how many moves were done.
title: Colee

description: Jabcojada is a simple 'Light Cycle' game for two human players. Each player drives around the board leaving a solid trail behind. The collision with the trail or the board edge means a loss of the game.
title: Jabcojada

description: Memologie is a simple puzzle-solving game. The goal requires finding all the covered pairs of pictures on the 6x6 board. Discovered pairs stays on the board with the mark 'ok'. There is a moves limit, indicated by the counter on the bottom panel.
title: Memologie

description: Paddles is an arcade game for up to two players. The player should catch the ball when it comes towards his side. Catching the ball is rewarded with some amount of points, depending on ball speed. The bounced ball returns to the opponent's side. In the middle of the screen, it is a flashing bolt-figure, called an energy field. Every time the ball affects this, it will change its direction and speed, according to the shape of the field.
title: Paddles

description: Operation Proboszcz is a first person shooter. The game takes place on a single screen location. The player's task is to track down and kill all the priests. A new priest appears every few seconds in a various window of the church. The player moves viewfinder to the right, left, up or down and performs shoot. The game offers two difficulty levels - for standard players and radical Catholics. The second one causes viewfinder to move in unpredictable ways, as if the player was drunk.
title: Operation Proboszcz

description: Squash is a simplified computer adaptation of the classic sport game of the same name. It is played only as a practice mode - by one player, bouncing the ball from the wall. Each ball bounce is awarded with 10 points. Three errors mean the end of the game.
title: Squash

description: Penny is a platform game. The player's task is to find five magical swords and designated number of diamonds, while avoiding numerous creatures and obstacles. Penny has a weapon, although he may kill only enemies rising from the ground. Contact with hostile creature decreases some amount of energy. Getting access to the next level requires gathering all five parts of the sword. To finish the game, it's necessary to complete all five levels in a row.
title: Penny

description: Poszukiwacz Skarbów is a puzzle game, where the player must gather designated number of treasures in order to get access to another board. Moving around the maze requires proper pushing of boxes blocking the road, finding keys to closed doors and avoiding traps. The player has a limited amount of oxygen, which is consumed while walking and in greater amounts when moving the boxes. Oxygen may be supplemented by finding a tank.
title: Poszukiwacz Skarbów

description: Fields is a computer adaptation of puzzle-board game four-in-a-row for one up to two players. The task requires getting 10 rows of four fiches. Rows may be arranged diagonally, horizontally and obliquely. Completed row vanishes from the board.
title: Fields

description: Erotica is a turn based puzzle-board game for up to two players. The goal is to score more points by selecting higher numbers. Player one may choose a digit from horizontal raw, player two from vertical row. Selecting own color digit adds point, selecting opponents color subtracts points. The game ends when all digits disappear from the board and full background picture is revealed.
title: Erotica

description: Car-O-Matic is a turn based puzzle-board game for up to two players. The goal is to score more points by selecting higher numbers. Player one may choose a digit from horizontal raw, player two from vertical row. Selecting own color digit adds point, selecting opponents color subtracts points. The game ends when all digits disappear from the board and full background picture is revealed.
title: Car-O-Matic

description: MegaBrain is a puzzle game, where the player must memorize the position of six symbols and rearrange them in proper place before the time runs out. The game has three stages. In the first one the location of symbols is drawn. In the second one the player has a few seconds to memorize the symbols location. In the third one, it's necessary to select a symbol in the bottom line and specify the right spot at the bottom line.
title: MegaBrain

description: Kolony v4.4 is a slighty enhanced version of original game, released back in 1991. The new version improves graphic design and modifies some of the names of entities.
title: Kolony v4.4

description: Cosmos 3000 is a single screen space shooter. As a lonely spacecraft pilot the player must face the invasion of alien fleet. The control is limited to moving left and right sight, performing shoots and turning on the shields. Enemy forces appear in waves, differing directions of movement and ways of shooting.
title: Cosmos 3000

description: Biznesmen is a simple trade game, which consists of buying and selling all kinds of goods in 20 cities around Poland. Players can buy and sell goods (car market, goods market, noble metal market), invest the money in actions of companies or expand warehouses. The game allows to compete up to 4 players.
title: Biznesmen

description: Core Wars Pro is a simulation inspired by the article Computer Recreations written by A. K. Dewdney, back in May 1984, telling about the game called Core War, where hostile programs engage in a battle of bits. It is a programming game in which two programs run in a simulated computer with the goal of terminating opponent. Once the game is started the player watch the code overwriting all the memory.
title: Core Wars Pro

description:
A French compilation of the three following C64 versions of these Commodore 16, Plus/4 games:

  • Corman
  • Tic Tac Toe
  • Pancho

sample_screenshots.caption: Who will win? Tic Tac Toe (French)

title: 3 Super Jeux

description:
In Zeppelin Rescue the player is the pilot of a blimp that has to pick up stranded people and bring them to safety. The setting is Los Angeles which is made up of five side view screens which the player flies between. The blimp is moved around with joystick but the manoeuvrability is limited by its size as well as the gravity. There is no reverse so it needs to be turned around to change direction.

In total there are 48 people waiting to be rescued and they all need to be brought to the home base where a space ship is being built. It's important to pay attention to the fuel gauge and refuel before it gets too low. There are also obstacles such as clouds, bridges and buildings that have to be avoided since any crash will lead to all passengers getting killed and the player losing a life.

sample_screenshots.caption: People screaming for help when a new screen is loaded
The second screen with the home base

title: Zeppelin Rescue

description:
The main goal of this game is to recover the stolen successful slogans of Victoria-Vesta, an insurance company. For each game, one of them was cut into pieces and hidden in rooms in two houses. One of those houses is yours. They are hidden behind the different objects in the rooms. If you find one of the pieces, it will appear at the top left of the screen. Each piece is hidden twice. If you find both pieces twice, this part of the slogan will be remembered and you will receive a bonus. Later, if you have found all parts of the slogan, you must form the slogan in the second part of the game.

Looking for the slogans can be dangerous, but with a non-life insurance policy of Victoria-Vesta you run less risk. You can buy some of these insurances with a part of the budget made available for this at the start of the game. The premium will then be deducted from this budget.

You can also buy life insurance policies, depending on your playing age, for an increase in your budget. If you want to buy these, or you want more information about an insurance policy, you need to contact your insurance advisor using the telephone in the room.

The game ends when your budget falls below 0 or when you turn 110. If your age is low and your budget is high after you have found all slogans, the more time you get to compose the slogan.

The game is played with the joystick, but the controls differs per room; If you move the joystick up, you can search, make a call and use the stairs. When the fire button is pressed, you can whistle to the dog, take the baby and move the kitchen stairs. To win information about the insurance or to buy it, you have to press the fire button.

sample_screenshots.caption: Other House: Honden (Dogs); Beware of the biting dogs!
Own House: Kinder Kamer (Children's Room); Beware of the tricycles if you do not want have a crushed big toe!
Street: Car; Beware of the traffic!
Own House: Open Haard (Fire Place); Beware of the sparks!

title: All Risks

description:
Radarsoft created the educational program Maps USA for the US market and it was distributed by ACK, Inc. Maps USA teaches people in the States the geography of their own country.

There are three options to choose from, which are Search, Test and Heligame. In the Search mode the player can type in the names of the States, rivers, seas, mountains and the game will automatically go to the right place on the map. If there are several places with the similar name, then the computer will tell that the place was found, but will ask the player which one was meant.

In the Test mode the player has to name the places that has been pointed out by the computer in a certain time. In the heligame player controls a helicopter and must fly within a certain time limit to find the places indicated by the computer. Each place that have been found you'll get points. If the points are high enough, the player will get extra time and lesser known places in the next level.

sample_screenshots.caption: Find Hartford on the enlarged map

title: Maps USA

description: Knight 'n' Grail is a platformer action/adventure game for the Commodore 64 released well after the system's normal lifespan. You play as an unnamed Knight, and need to explore a castle in search of the 'Vessel of Restoration', which can remove a curse inflicted upon you and your beloved. As you explore the castle, you find additional equipment and abilities which allow you to overcome obstacles that were previously insurmountable.

sample_screenshots.caption: Heading over to the West Staircase
Grabbed the Water Armour in the Main Hall Attic.
Reaching the Main Hall, but I can't get in this way

title: Knight 'n' Grail

description: Quaptos is a puzzle board game. The goal of the game is to arrange an identical pattern in the second window. The screen is divided into two parts. First window shows a pattern, which must be repeated in the second window. Every square brick has a digit on it - initially "one". Each placed next to it brick increases the number by one point.
title: Quaptos

description: The Rebels is an arcade game where the player must defeat a designated number of enemies to acquire a key necessary to close the gate. Defeating enemy requires performing a kick from a specified distance. Each gate needs a separate key to close it. After closing all gates and defeating all remaining enemies, the player is moved to the next level.
title: The Rebels

description: Sklep is a very simplified text-based trading game, which consists of buying and selling 10 kinds of goods in order to earn 10.000. Buying cheap and selling expensive, while covering the rent, is the key to reaching the goal. Each turn takes a month, ending with the display of the current balance and costs.
title: Sklep

description: Czar Kart is a solitaire game, including 2 variants of the picks. The first variant involves placing cards into aces by seniority. The second one requires putting a red card on black (or contrariwise), always one smaller. In addition the player may select 3 difficulty options, allowing for viewing the stack every 1, 2 or 3 cards.
title: Czar Kart

description: Destiny is an arcade game, where the player must find 9 poison containers scattered around the maze, while avoiding numerous inhabitants. Contact with any of the creatures takes an energy, which can't be complemented. No weapon is available, therefore a smooth movement is the key to avoid hostile beings, blocking the transition to other parts of the labyrinth.
title: Destiny

description: Tectron is a 'Light Cycle' game for two human players. Each player drives around the board leaving a solid trail behind. The collision with the trail or the board edge means a loss of the game. The gameplay is limited to 60 seconds.
title: Tectron

description:
Diorid is a puzzle solving game. The main goal requires removing all the blocks from the board within limited time. By clicking on a single spot, the player affects central field (selected one) and all the fields placed directly diagonally next to the central block by their reversal - filled block disappears and a blank spot is replaced with filled block. Basically, each taken action reverses simultaneously 5 fields, one in the middle, and 4 around.

The game features 99 levels.
title: Dioroid

description:
Monsters is a Pac-Man variant. The player must eat all the objects on the board while avoiding constantly moving hostile creatures. Contact with any of them takes some amount of energy. There is no special dot, allowing to defeat enemies, threafore the game is all about a quick maneuvering of the character in order outwit the opponent.

The game features 40 levels.
title: Monsters

description:
Doris is a timed puzzle solving game. The goal of the game is to arrange an identical pattern in the second window within a designated time and number of moves. Arranging the pattern requires moving a full row - diagonally or horizontally by one or more fields. Each shifting process deducts one move from the allowed number. The passage of time or the use of all movements ends the game.

The game features 99 levels.
title: Doris

description:
Doris 2 is a timed puzzle solving game. The goal of the game is to arrange an identical picture in the second window within a designated time. Arranging the pattern requires moving a full row - diagonally or horizontally. The passage of time ends the game. The player has 10 trials for each picture.

The game features 3 difficulty levels.
title: Doris 2

description:
Compilation of following games:

  • Winter Supersports 92
  • Demon Blue
  • Ninja Rabbits
  • Darksyde
  • The Big KO!
  • Equinox
  • Space Vegetables
  • Summer Olympiad
title: Mega Collection

description: Shaman is a side-scrolling arcade game, where the player must collect the designated number of bottles scattered around before the time runs out in order to reach the next level. Each level is inhabited by numerous animals, which may be killed with rocks. Contact with them means a certain death and necessity to start the level from the beginning. .
title: Shaman

description: Platman Worlds is an exploration platformer game. You play as Platman, who bears a striking resemblance to Pacman, and need to find your way through four different worlds (Classic, Gothic, Ancient and Future). Each world consists of several screens, which contain some enemies (usually ghosts) to be avoided, keys to unlock doors and much food to collect. The screens are connected together in the world and can branch into alternate and optional paths, or require some backtracking after finding a suitable key.

sample_screenshots.caption: Optional screen with lots of food and a 1-up
Cleaned out most of the food at the top of this screen

title: Platman Worlds

description:
Verkeersrally (Traffic Rally) is an educational game in which the player has to look for control stations in a busy and unknown metropolis to reach the finish through the knowledge of map reading and traffic rules. But the player must locate six transmitters within one hour. However, each transmitter contains a battery that only works for ten minutes. The first transmitter works from 9:50 to 10:00. The second from 10:00 to 101.0 etc. until at 10:50 the sixth transmitter battery is exhausted and the game is over. With these means the player can find the transmitters:

  • Large blue signs with white letters on which "Signal" is displayed; These indicate an electronic arrow in the direction of the currently working transmitter.

  • District map: when the player parks there and presses the fire button, you get to see the part of the city where you are at that moment. A green rectangle represents the entire city; a small gray rectangle indicates in which part you are now. A small white dot is the first transmitter.

  • Sonar stations: if the player parks here, you will see the part of the town where you are at that moment and hear a whistle and see white dots on the screen. The faster they go, the closer you are to the transmitter.

  • The buildings with the inscription "Puzzle": if the player parks here and presses the fire button, you will see a part of the city where the transmitter is located. By means of the map that you find in the manual, you can find out which part of the city that is. From the third channel (from 10:20 onward) only pieces of the plan are shown.

During the search for the transmitters, the game is interrupted regularly to ask the player about certain traffic situations, such as identifying which of the road users has priority. The player also has to refuel regularly at one of the filling stations. Because if the player is without petrol, there will be an automatic refuel and the player will pay penalty seconds. So the player must keep an eye on the fuel gauge at the bottom of the screen.

If the player sees a black rectangle appear on the pavement, the player must stop and press the fire button; one of the transmitters has been found.

sample_screenshots.caption: This will happen if you have waited too long; the battery of the first transmitter is empty! (Dutch)
Which one of the road users has priority? (Dutch)

title: Verkeersrally

description:
The goal of this two-player game is to shoot as many ducks as possible and retrieve them with the help of your dog to score a higher score than your opponent. You and your opponent control a hunter and a dog. When the hunter aims at a duck, press the fire button to shoot the duck with one of the barrels of the shotgun. But if you miss, press the fire button again to fire with the other barrel. Steer your dog to retrieve the duck with the use of your joystick and place the duck in the basket at the hunter's feet.

Ducks can fall on land or in the water. The difficulty for the dogs to retrieve the ducks changes. This is also the reason for the different number of points awarded;

  • Duck falls on land – 10 points.
  • Duck falls in water – 40 points.
  • Duck falls on the island – 100 points.

The difficulty level increases with;

  • Floating tree trunks: The dog has to dodge them.

  • Fish: They can bite and drive the dog into the river. You then will need a new dog.

  • When swimming the river be careful of the current or you will be swept away

In level 4 you get a new obstacle; a fox will sometimes appear and steal a duck from the basket. You can chase him away with your dog, but if a duck is stolen, you lose 10 points.

sample_screenshots.caption: Hint: When the duck falls on the island and the dog bring him back to the hunter's basket, you'll get 100 points!

title: Gun Dogs

description:
Sam's Journey is a platform collect-a-thon game with 3 worlds and 30 levels to explore.

The game is very similar to the Super Mario series. There is an overworld map where the player can choose to go into the actual levels. The level are large and scroll in 8 directions. Sam collects gems, jump on enemies and also pick up, carry and throw items. Find the flashing door at the end of each level to finish the level and exit back to the map. During the level Sam must collect gems, coins and trophies. Collect all items to 100% complete the level. The game features game-play elements from various other games such as underwater sections, checkpoint flags, trampolines, transporter cannons, platforms moving on rails and end bosses. There are colored switches which turn blocks on or off. There are secret passages in the levels which only appear when Sam walks into them.

Sam can collect power-ups in the form of outfits, each giving him different abilities. The 6 different power-up outfits are a blue shirt for pirate (sword attack), green shirt for sports (aim throw), yellow shirt for astronaut (jet pack), red shirt for vampire (temporarily turn into a flying bat), purple shirt for disco (air float), black shirt for ninja (wall jump).

The game comes on floppy discs or cartridge, either with English or Spanish translated texts, there is no language select option.

sample_screenshots.caption: Got to checkpoint as a ninja

title: Sam's Journey

description:
Conflicts 2 is a collection of three strategy war games:

  • Battle for Midway
  • Iwo Jima
  • Okinawa
title: Conflicts 2

description:
Splitter is a puzzle game. The player has to complete the picture using randomly selected pieces in a given amount of time. However all the pieces are not visible at once - the game proposes one piece but the player can rotate it using up and down arrow keys selecting a different one to be placed. From the regular puzzle it is distinguished by the fact that each piece has to be slided into its place on the final picture. If it is placed wrong, then the piece goes back to the pool of pieces.

But there is also a penalty - a misplaced piece activates a bomb explosion that removes, in a horizontal or vertical line from it, several pieces that have been already correctly placed. The player has to be also aware if placing the pieces do not block others to be slid in. If such thing happens, the only possibility is to misplace a piece and wait for the explosion to remove the blocking pieces,

sample_screenshots.caption: First picture during the creation time
First picture presented before the game.
Second picture during the creation time
Second picture presented before the game.

title: Splitter

description: This is a Commodore 64 cartridge of the classic board game Checkers. This game is a single player, man vs computer version of the game. One side is filled white circles and the other are unfilled circles.
title: Checkers

description:
You are an adventurer, who has travelled into the desert in search of excitement. There, you meet an old man who tells you about the treasure located in the nearby ruined and demon infested city of Gilgamesh. He also tells you an easy way to enter the city via the underground sewer system. Leaving will be trickier...

Melee is an icon driven top-down role playing game that was distributed as part of the C64 disc magazine Loadstar (Issue 61). Actions can be selected by moving an arrow (using the joystick) to the appropriate icon and pressing fire. There are four movement icons and three others: Magic, Scrutiny and Brawn.

Your character starts in the middle of the city armed only with a dagger. Items can be found in treasure chests whose colour indicates its contents. For instance, white chests contain one of four magic spells. Items can be picked up by pressing the Brawn icon twice (or just holding the fire button) and selecting a direction. Only one item of each type can be carried at a time. Types include keys, spells, weapons, three types of armor, and two kinds of treasure. Items can be dropped by pressing Brawn once and Scrutiny once, then he direction to drop the item. The same combination can be used to give objects.

Monsters appear at fixed locations, often guarding items. They may be attacked once by pressing Brawn a single time, and then the direction to attack. The likelihood of defense and damage during attack are influenced by your armor and weapons.

The only statistic that is tracked is hit-points, which will result in your death when they reach zero. You can be healed by giving money to a priest who lives in a ruined church. The priest also knows a way out of the city, but will only tell you if you bring him all of the treasures in the city. Once this is done, the game is won.
title: Melee

description: Warp! is an arcade racing game where the player, whose country's research center has just been raided by aliens, needs to rescue kidnapped scientists and recover stolen computers, weapons and microfilms. To pick up a scientist or an item the player has to stop and leave the car and move by foot to the item without getting killed by an alien. In the same way it's necessary to pick up fuel canisters to avoid running out of gas. Hitting any object or alien leads to a life being lost. In addition to fuel it is also necessary to collect energy vapor. As the energy is filled the vehicle is upgraded, first to a turbo racer and then to a jet fighter and finally to a combat tank. With the jet fighter it is possible to fire back at the aliens while the tank can run over road hazards.
title: Warp!

description:
Twinky and his twin, Reg race the countryside competing for the affection of the sweet Twinka. Both characters can be seen at the same time on a split-screen where two human players compete against each other or human vs the computer.

Obstacles are encountered along the way that need to be cleared by jumping over them and consumables can be eaten to gain points and increase energy. Once a checkpoint is reached, players progress to the next level with different challenges.
title: Twinky Goes Hiking

description:
In this show jumping themed game, the objective is to guide Super Rider successfully through the Firebird Arena obstacle course against the clock.

Points are scored by avoiding giant pyramids, clearing yawning ravines and jumping fences. Every time the rider is thrown from the horse, there is a 5 second time penalty.
title: Super Rider

description: Balon is an arcade game where the player while flying with a balloon must avoid terrestrial enemies and birds. The game is divided into 6 stages, differing in the type of enemies and tasks to be performed. Flying birds may be avoided or killed by dropping bombs from above. After completing all levels, the game starts again with additional difficulties.
title: Balon

description: The peasant must transport a goat, wolf and cabbage to the other side of the river. Unfortunately, the boat can only accommodate him and one of three passengers (goat, wolf or cabbage) at a time. In order to solve the puzzle, following rules must be respected: a wolf with a goat (wolf eats a goat) or a goat with cabbage (goat eats cabbage) can't stay alone on the shore.
title: Wilk Koza Kapusta

description:
Samochodowy Wojownik is an arcade racing game with shooter elements. You are the driver of the police combat car - Ferrari 1200 DRX, struggling with a gang of smugglers in the suburbs. During the patrol, you will encounter the vehicles of the criminals and the criminals themselves who will try to eliminate the threat.

The car can move in any direction. A collision with a street border, another vehicle and a train, as well as an accurate shot of the opponent deprives the player of life. The shells in the vehicle are not limited.
title: Samochodowy Wojownik

description: Zone Z is a vertical shoot'em up. Your ship is flying over a smooth scrolling landscape and you can shoot at enemy ships. The ship can be controlled left and right and also up and down to a certain degree is possible. After a miniboss you face the end boss of the level. If you defeat him, you can fly through a bonus stage that lets you collect extra points as a reward. Then the game repeats itself with a different graphic tile set.
title: Zone Z

description: Zone 7 is a shoot'em up that reminds a bit of Asteroids, but is played different. Like Asteroids, you spawn in the middle of the screen. Unlike Asteroids, your shots do not travel through the border of the screen and come back on the other side, but they bounce of the edge of the playing area and then keep flying until they hit the border again. Three shots can be flying around at a time. And the biggest difference is: your enemies don't split up.
title: Zone 7: Part II - The Battle Continues

description: Zone 7 is a shoot'em up that reminds a bit of Asteroids, but is played different. Like Asteroids, you spawn in the middle of the screen. Unlike Asteroids, your shots do not travel through the border of the screen and come back on the other side, but they bounce of the edge of the playing area and then keep flying until they hit the border again. Three shots can be flying around at a time. And the biggest difference is: your enemies don't split up.
title: Zone 7

description:
One night Kate wakes up to find that all her toys have come alive. So she dons her bike helmet and off she goes to save them all!

Bounce through 12 levels, flip the right switches, and help Kate rescue 6 of her cuddly friends

Counterweight Kate is a platform puzzle game where the player takes on the role of Kate who has to rescue six of her toys using well timed dodging and jumping to the top of the full screen scrolling game area.

Every level contains a puzzle that will need to solved to be able to reach Kate's toy.
title: Counterweight Kate

description:
A re-release compilation of three games that include:

  • Chopper
  • Kayak
  • Merlin
title: Trio

description: The Attack of the Phantom Karate Devils is a fighting game where the player has to defeat an army of shadow-like creatures who have murdered the player's master. The game is played from a side view and the joystick is used to control the hero. Different kicks and punches (high or low) can be used with points being earned for each hit. There are also thrown knifes and stars that have to be avoided or blocked. Upon reaching certain scores doors are opened that takes the player to new levels. Strength points are lost when getting struck but also when attacking. If the strength reaches zero the player dies but it is recharged when moving through a door.

sample_screenshots.caption: Getting a thrown star in he face
The door opens after reaching 50 points

title: The Attack of the Phantom Karate Devils

description:
Space Moguls is a worldwide competition to select four finalists to travel to a new world for the ultimate reality TV show. The goal is to become the wealthiest partcipant and return to earth in glory.

The game starts when the finalists land on a new planet. Each finalist is given a certain amount of cash and items to survive the seasons until the game concludes.

Each season is a round in the game, which begins with the Land Grant phase where players can pick one free Land Cell each round. After the first round there is a chance for a Land Auction to bid for an extra Land Cell and get an advantage over the other players.

After the Land assignments are complete each player takes a turn in the Development Phase. During the Development each player can enter the town to purchase and equip a Droid for extracting various items. With the equipped Droid in tow the player can leave the town and install the Droid on any owned Land Cell. While on the map players may encounter Grumplings, alien life forms that can provide additional items.

When each player has completed their Development phase Item Production begins. Depending on how well the equipped Droids match the Land Type a certain number of Items will be produced in each Land Cell. During production Global Events may occur that modify the production in some way or cause trouble for one of the players or disables the Market.

When all Production is complete the Trading Phase begins. Each player can trade items with other players or buy and sell with the Market. The Market price for each Item depends on the stock of Items in the Market, except for Rare Materials which has a slight random element to its price.

At the end of each round the current results are presented and the next round begins.

The game continues until a set number of rounds have concluded and the finalists are flown back for the award ceremony.

The game is a homage to the classic strategy game M.U.L.E. and was completed 35 years after M.U.L.E.
title: Space Moguls

description: Portal is an adaptation of the 2010 Valve puzzle-platform game of the same name. It was changed from first-person into a fixed-screen side view, but the main concept is identical. It consists of twenty chambers in the Aperture Science Enrichment Center the character Chell needs to complete by using blue and orange portals to solve puzzles. She is controlled through the keyboard while a mouse or a joystick is used to aim the portals and launch them. Portals allow her to get past hazards or to trick turrets. Next to launching portals and movement Chell is able to jump, and carry and drop objects such as the companion cube. Between chambers the A.I. construct called GlaDOS often appears.
title: Portal

description: Familiada is a puzzle-board game for two players, based on the TV show. The player's task is to guess six answers to a question, with the possibility of making two mistakes. Third mistake passes the question to the other player. Every correct answer is scored. The winner of more points wins the turn. The round starts with a duel who first presses the button and gives a correct answer. Reaching the final stage requires gaining 300 points. The final stage has two rounds, where two team members answer six questions and must reach 200 points all together to win the main prize.
title: Familiada

description:
In Lunar Outpost, you're the commander of the Lunar Assault Vehicle assigned to defend Earth's lonely lunar outpost against a never-ending attack of Zytrons. Spaced throughout the lunar outpost are a number of supply buildings. These must be defended at all costs, but how many days can you hold off the Zytron assault?

Game play consists of 2 different screens. There is a lunar map, where you can see the different structures of the Lunar base, and the incoming Zytron assault vessels. Each day, 4 waves of 1 - 6 Zytron vessels approach, trying to destroy your outpost, and you must move to intercept these invaders. The map also hosts power strips which allow the player to move without using energy, power stations which recharge its batteries, repair stations, munition buildings which restock your vehicle's missiles, and pulsars which if activated destroy an enemy wave.

When you intercept a Zytron wave, you enter the combat zone. Here, you have a 3D portrayal of your assault vehicle, and the goal is to position your vessel beneath the enemy ships and destroy them by firing missiles. While you are battling an individual wave, the other Zytron ships will continue to wreck havoc on your lunar base, and you may have to break off combat to defend other areas.

There are 3 difficulty levels: Level 1 Alpha Base, Level 2 Lunar Command, and Level 3 Farside Station. Points are awarded based upon the number of enemy ships destroyed, and the total number of days the player 's base survives. The game will end when a player has survived a whole lunar month of 28 days, or all of their buildings have been destroyed.
title: Lunar Outpost

description:
Kempelen is a 1-player versus computer chess game for the Commodore 64.

Standard chess game that has 10 separate difficulty levels. Pieces are graphically displayed on the screen, and moves are inputted via text prompt. Only legitimate moves are allowed.
title: Kempelen

description:
Stunt Flyer is a stunt-flying simulation for the Commodore 64.

Gameplay puts the player in control of a small prop-plane at an airshow, where they attempt to perform a number of airplane-based stunts. There are two display modes, a 1st-person 3D mode where the player can attempt to fly their plane and perform stunts, and a side-scrolling 2D mode where the player can review the stunts they have performed.

The player can attempt to recreate a total of 20 stunts, and are awarded a score based upon how closely they adhere to them, or can review an expert stunt flyer perform the stunts for tips. The player can also freestyle their own performance, and review this performance. While in 3D mode, the player can either use the keyboard or joystick to guide their flight, and the cockpit has a variety of gauges to help safely control stunts.
title: Stunt Flyer

description: Daffy Duck and the Great Paint Caper is a 2D platformer following the adventures of Daffy Duck and other Looney Tunes characters as they solve puzzles and collect objects in order to progress.
title: Daffy Duck and the Great Paint Caper

description:
Mission Asteroid & Wizard and the Princess is a compilation package of two Sierra Hi-Res Adventures released by Impulse Software.

The compilation contains:

  • Hi-Res Adventure #0: Mission Asteroid
  • Hi-Res Adventure #2: The Wizard and the Princess
title: Mission Asteroid & Wizard and the Princess

description: Snoopy is a platform game with twenty single-screen levels. The player takes on the role of Snoopy , the dog from the comic series Peanuts. In each level the player must walk from left to right with Snoopy, while avoiding various dangers. After all twenty levels have been played, the game starts again, but now with a higher playing speed.

sample_screenshots.caption: Crossing a water obstacle requires jumping on to a moving platform.
Jumps require pixel perfect precision or you'll end up losing a life.
Jumping over moving bumps on the ground.
You must traverse each screen from left to right while avoiding obstacles.

title: Snoopy

description:
The Mojon Twins: 2 Games in 1 is a compilation of two C64 games by the Spanish development group The Mojon Twins brought together on a single cartridge. Both games were previously released as homebrew downloads free of charge. The included games are:

  • Nanako in Classic Japanese Monster Castle
  • Sir Ababol

The cartridge has a transparent purple cartridge shell illuminated by an internal LED. It also comes with a printed manual in colour and a vinyl Mojon Twins sticker. There are two packaging types: either as a standard card carton box or a deluxe version that comes in a plastic universal game case with a cut foam insert to hold the cartridge. Upon ordering a digital version is also sent out.
title: The Mojon Twins: 2 Games in 1

description:
The Mojon Twins: 3 Games in 1 is a compilation of three C64 games by the Spanish development group The Mojon Twins brought together on a single tape or a single disk. All games were previously released as homebrew downloads free of charge. The included games are:

  • Nanako in Classic Japanese Monster Castle
  • Sir Ababol
  • Uwol: Quest for Money

The game comes in a box that also contains a printed manual in colour and two stickers. The games are NTSC/PAL compatible.
title: The Mojon Twins: 3 Games in 1

description:
A compilation of:

  • Air Support
  • New York City
title: N.Y.C.: The Big Apple / Air Support

description: Time Traveller is a text adventure with graphics. Someone has broken Father Time's magic hourglass and you eventually have to restore it. But first things first - as the game starts you wake up in 1990 with no idea who, where, or when you are, or how you got there. You need to figure out how to time travel in order to set things right.

sample_screenshots.caption: Back in time to the year 1890. (French)
Tijdreiziger - The name on the identeitskaart is: DRJ! And that stands for Doctor John! He is better known as John Vanderaart! (Dutch)
Tijdreiziger - Your start in the "Slaapzaal". Like any graphical text adventures you have to use text commands (now in Dutch) to control characters and influence the environment. (Dutch)
Introduction with some explanation about some verbs that you can use! (English)

title: Time Traveller

description:
El Hobbit (Vah-ka's Cut) is a game made for the 2012 Bytemaníacos competition where the goal was to create a 48K game based on the J. R. R. Tolkien's book The Hobbit. The game won third place. The overall story interprets the source material with some liberties and twists. Bilbo the Hobbit receives a visit from the Gandalf the wizard. He tells the hobbit about a big treasure in a cave guarded by the pink dragon Smaug. Gandalf does not know how to open the cave, but he tells there is a bald, grumpy man called Gollum in the forest who has a ring that turns you invisible when you wear it. That could be the only way to get to the treasure.

Once outside the house players guide Bilbo through different environments. They consist of single-screen rooms connected both horizontally and vertically using the flip-screen mechanic to offer an amount of freedom. Bilbo has no means to attack, so enemies such as snakes need to be avoided. He starts with five lives (represented as apples) and every enemy collision removes one. Tasks Bilbo needs to include finding Gandalf, gathering thirteen dwarves, locating the ring, avoiding and sneaking past Gollum and finally stealing the treasure. Bilbo can wear the ring, turning him both invisible and invincible, but he gets dizzy when he wears it too long.
title: El Hobbit (Vah-ka's Cut)

description:
This is a compilation of the two games:

Tag Team Wrestling and Karate Champ.
title: Tag-Team Wrestling Plus Karate Champ

description:
Phase 4 is a space themed shoot-em-up. You control a fighter craft which must blast its way through four levels of alien ships. Each level has a unique background and set of re-spawning opponents, and the aim is to reach a target number of aliens destroyed before moving onto the next level. The first three levels are vertical shoot-em-ups with a landscape of alien pyramids, the darkness of space, and an alien city as backgrounds. The final level is a horizontal shooter over a built-up area. After the four levels are completed, the game loops back to the beginning with a larger quota of enemy to be destroyed.

The game comes with several difficulty options. One option allows use of a shield which gives you invulnerability for a short period of time. Another allows guided missiles, which follow the horizontal (or vertical for phase 4) position of your ship after firing. The final option allows the use of a limited number of smart bombs to destroy all of the on-screen opponents.

sample_screenshots.caption: I think the game might be over.

title: Phase 4

description:
ABC Caterpillar is an educational game for the Commodore 64.

The player controls a small caterpillar which must spell words by eating the correct letters of the alphabet. The letters are displayed alphabetically in vertical columns on the right and left of the screen, while an image of the item to spell is displayed in the top center of the screen. Gameplay options include single letter recognition, as well as spelling 3 and 4 letter words. The game tells the player if they are spelling a word correctly or incorrectly. Contains an additional game called Butterfly Draw, where the player makes designs by moving a butterfly around the screen.
title: ABC Caterpillar

description:
Combots is a 1 - 2 player strategy war game for the Commodore 64/128.

In 2005, aliens landed and launched a world-wide campaign of domination. Their Pulse Signal destroyed and neutralized nuclear stockpiles and eliminated most forms of communication between the continents and nations. We were isolated, but we fought back. The aliens came in armored machines that walked and flew, but humans built their own from scrap iron and spare parts. From captured alien robots, we have learned their technological secrets, to wage war against the aliens.

This is a strategy based combat game involving large robots. Combat occurs on a hexagonal map containing a variety of terrains. Gameplay is turn-based with the player and computer forces taking turns moving troops. The player controls shield powers and defensive capabilities of their fort. A tactical vector display shows location and threat of enemy troops. Combat can occur at long range involving cannon and missile fire, but there are also options for close combat between troops involving hand-to-hand combat. Vehicles can be temporarily deactivated to enact repairs. Destroyed enemy vehicles can be salvaged, at risk of self-destruction damaging the player's base.

The player can make custom robots to pilot. The player chooses from several different head, torso, and legs, as well as chooses the means of locomotion of the vehicle. The player can choose the armor capacity of individual sections, and must place the location and strength of the vehicle's command center. The player can then create custom ammunition for the robot, and place it on their vehicle.
title: Combots

description: A more simplified version of Lethal Weapon. In this version Riggs or Murtaugh can only be selected at the beginning, the game is linear instead of allowing players to select their missions, and most importantly the levels were redesigned.
title: Lethal Weapon

description: The Commodore 64 version of Robbo plays similar to the original version, however it consists of 76 original levels and also contains some additional types of objects not found in the original game.

sample_screenshots.caption: Teleport to next level on site
Need to use the bomb to get access to the next chamber

title: Robbo

description: King's Valley is a homebrew puzzle game based on the 1985 Konami game of the same name. You need to collect all the treasure by drilling and cutting your way through the pyramids. But beware of the mummies that haunt the pyramids. If you use the limited available cutting and drilling equipment in the wrong order you'll eventually get stuck. You'll then have to play the whole level over again.
title: King's Valley

description:
Expeditions consists of three different educational games for the Commodore 64:

  • Furs: You are leading a fur trading expedition as an Ottawa native american. Choose between three different routes to travel across North America in the mid- to late 1600's.
  • Voyageur: Set between 1770 and 1830, you play as a fur trader who travels from Grand Portage into the fur trading area west of Lake Superior.
  • Oregon: a port of The Oregon Trail

This game set was offered as a software pack-in for Commodore 64s in 1984.
title: Expeditions

description:
No Mercy is a military themed crosshair shooting game, very similar to Operation Wolf. Players shoot their way through levels by moving the crosshair across the screen and firing. Pressing space shoots rockets.

There are seven levels in total, starting in a desert camp, then by the river side, jungle plains, an airport, a prison yard, train yards and finally the escape helicopter. The levels are left-to-right scrolling screens, except the third and final level that are stationary. Enemies include foot soldiers, soldiers with bazookas, helicopters, tanks, boats, gunships and jet skis.

Players have limited health and ammo, and a maximum of three rockets. Bonus items scattered thoughout the levels can be shot to replenish ammo, rockets or health.

Most likely the game was not available separately and only through the Golden Disk 64 magazine.
