sample_screenshots.caption: Level 2: a large gunship and jet skis
Level 4: at the airport, the jets move fast and are hard hit.
Level 1: another helicopter arrives, the backgrounds are not destructible.
Level 1: shoot enemies while scrolling to the right

title: No Mercy

description: This version of Alien³ has the same overall game concept as Alien³, but the levels have an unique layout and there are only 15 levels instead of 20.
title: Alien³

description: Wet Paint is a Tron-like game featuring paint brushes instead of light cycles. They race each other using a top-down view on a fixed single-screen with a white background. The game supports up to four players in local multiplayer matches.
title: Wet Paint

description:
While the screenshots on the back of the box may get players hopes up that they are getting a home port of Hat-Trick Hero, what they actually get may be a bit more humbling.

European Football Champ is a soccer game viewed from a top down perspective with the pitch aligned horizontally. Players can choose the length of the game from 2 to 90 minutes.

Unlike the Amiga / Atari ST game with the same title that only focused on European teams, this version of European Football Champ features 9 international teams: The 5 teams that were in both Football Champ / Hat-Trick Hero arcade games:

Argentina, Brazil. England, , Germany, Italy

The 2 Football Champ exclusive teams:

France and Spain

The 2 Hat Trick Hero exclusive teams:

Japan and USA

However this game lacks the Netherlands team which was in both of those Arcade games.
title: European Football Champ

description: Dungeon Paranoids is a text adventure and a public domain fangame based on the board game Dungeon!. You traverse the map fighting different leveled enemies using weapons and magic. You have different classes to choose from, each having different stats. You have to eat to stay alive and you lose HP by fighting enemies and by moving around the map. The goal is to stay alive long enough to gather enough gold and escape.
title: Dungeon Paranoids

description: Alloyrun is a 2D side-scrolling shooter in which the player controls a futuristic ship and has to shoot enemies as they approach from the right, in order to gain points. The ships is always facing the same direction, meaning it can only shoot to the right, but it can be freely moved around the screen. There are also hazards and barriers in the environment that needed to be avoided. The game keeps track of the highscore.
title: Alloyrun

description:
Assembloids is a fast paced reaction puzzler based on the 2010 game Quartet. The playfield consists of 5 windows, arranged in a plus shape. Parts of creatures in different colours appear in the central one, and then have to be moved to one of the four other windows using the joystick. If a window already has the space of that part occupied the player will lose a life. A life is also lost if the player takes too long to move the part. When a full creature is assembled the player is awarded points. The more uniformly coloured the creature is the higher the point gain. If the player manages to clear all the windows and extra life is awarded.

The game gets faster as it goes on, losing a life will slow it down a bit, but upon doing well again it goes back to getting faster pretty quick. There are a number of difficulty settings available, which have an impact on how fast the game gets and how quickly the speed picks up.
title: Assembloids

description:
Radarsoft created the educational program Maps Britain for the British market and it teaches people in the UK the geography of their own country.

There are three options to choose from, which are Search, Quiz and Heligame. In the Search mode the player can type in any cities, counties, seas etc. and the game will automatically go to the right place on the map. In the Quiz mode the player can choose from; large cities, cities, islands/countries or water/areas and needs to name them that has been pointed out by the computer in a certain time. In the heligame player can first change the start level from 1 (easy) to 4 (difficult) and then controls a helicopter and must fly within a certain time limit to find the places indicated by the computer. Each place that has been found provides points.

sample_screenshots.caption: Quiz - What is the name of this city/town?
Quiz - Do you know the name of this island?

title: Maps Britain

description: In California Goldrush, you control a miner who navigates a goldfield laying down fences as he goes. There are plots everywhere; and when a fence completely surrounds a plot, it is filled with sacks of gold. The larger the surrounded plot, the greater is the score given. Two Indians give chase to you, but they can be dealt with by laying down dynamite. The dynamite gives off gunpowder residue, making it impossible for anyone to pass through. If one of the Indians touches the miner, a life is lost. When you have completely surrounded all the plots, you will move onto the next goldfield. Future goldfields are inhabited by more Indians who shoot arrows at you. The game ends when you have exhausted all your lives.

sample_screenshots.caption: The gunpowder residue blocks your progress

title: California Goldrush

description:
In Herby the titular character needs to be guided through a maze that consists of more than 100 single-screen rooms, connected horizontally and vertically, to find the exit. He starts with five lives and needs to avoid hazards and enemies, while solving a number of puzzles. He can be moved around freely in eight directions using a joystick. The screen shows the total score, remaining number of lives, the room number, the percentage of the game that has been solved, and the amount of keys he carries.

Typical hazards are barriers that disappear briefly, moving enemies and moving blocks. A single collision is immediately deadly. Puzzles involve keys to open doors and items that need to be picked up. Some items have an effect right away, while others only reveal their purpose later on.

sample_screenshots.caption: Oops. Lost one of Herby's lives, because I could not dodge the block!
Beware of the big blocks that are moving around.
Now the timing has to be perfect to dodge the barrier AND you need to pass through a small passage.
There are some blocks here now. (the walls are deadly too)

title: Herby

description:
Herby: Thriller is the second Herby game following the original Herby released in the same year. The titular character needs to be guided through ten single-screen rooms. While the game borrows some elements from the original title, the concept is different. Instead of quickly moving between many rooms in a maze usually requiring a single action to progress, each screen is now a single level and a busy environment with traps, enemies, barriers and items.

A level is won when the exit is reached, but this usually requires a lot of actions such as moving past barriers, avoiding enemies, collecting keys and picking up items to watch their effects as a small amount of puzzles need to be solved. Herby stars with three lives and a single collision is immediately fatal. Other elements on the screen are the current score, the high score and the remaining of lives. Herby can be steered freely in eight directions using a joystick.
title: Herby: Thriller

description:
Zim Sala Bim is a text adventure with graphics set in Arabia. The village of Zim Sala Bim has been raided and pillaged by the Sultan, leaving the people with no money and no food. You are the last able-bodied man left in your village and it is your objective to sneak into the Sultan's fortress and to recover back the gold he has taken. Then you need to bring the gold to the secret cave where the village elders are waiting.

Movement to the left and right can be controlled by either the keyboard or joystick. The controls for the keyboard are "." and ",". Moving forwards and back are command-based like GO FORWARD and GO BACK. The text input of Zim Sala Bim are two-word commands made up by a verb/action and an object: example OPEN DOOR. "LOOK" which describes your surroundings and "INVENTORY" which tells you what you are carrying. It is possible to shorten sentences such as GO FO for GO FORWARD and GO BA for GO BACK. There is no save or load feature and RESTORE will return you to the title screen.

sample_screenshots.caption: Finding a dried up well in the desert and using the command "LOOK" to get a description of the immediate surroundings.
Phew. I made it to the entrance hall of the Palace.
The entrance gate of the palace
Starting location: outside the Palace walls

title: Zim Sala Bim

description:
Game of the Maccabees is a religious themed arcade game.

The player takes on the role of the Maccabees as they attempt their revolt against the Seleucid king. The player controls a spear thrower on the left who must defeat enemy spear throwers on the right of the screen. The player can move vertically up and down. The player starts with three lives, but can earn extra characters by correctly answering religious themed questions. Each enemy character is guarded by a shield, which can be destroyed. There are a total of ten enemies in four locations, and the enemies respawn until all are destroyed. Intermittently an elephant moves across the far right of the screen, which can be destroyed for bonus points.
title: Game of the Maccabees

description:
Anonimus is a graphical text adventure in Dutch where the player is looking for the riches of the very aggressive dwarf Ghnomus. The objective of the game is to gather twenty keys while facing many dangers such as electric walls, lasers, spring blocks, conveyor belts, drop doors, crocodiles and scorpions.

The game is a mix of an adventure and platform game, where instead of using a joystick, you have to enter text commands to move your character. Movement to the left and right can be done with typing 'links' (left) or 'rechts' (right). If you want to climb up the ladders you need to type 'klim' and if you want to go down again, type 'daal' (descend). With 'klim links' (climb left) or 'klim rechts' (climb right) you can walk up the stairs and 'daal links' (descend left) or 'daal rechts' (descend right) if you want to go down the stairs.

To go through narrow corridors, you have to type 'kruip(en)' (crawl), followed by a direction like 'links' (left) or 'rechts' (right). Type 'staan' if you want to stand up again. If you cannot reach a rope then you need to type first "spring" (jump) and then 'klim' (climb). There are also places where you have to jump over things, so you need to type "spring" followed by a direction like 'links' (left) or 'rechts' (right).When you are in reach of one of the keys, you can type 'pak sleutel' (take key).
title: Anonimus

description: Nick Hardy Adventures is a set of three pure text adventures, all starring the same character. In The Temple Curse, Nick Hardy is searching for a hidden treasure in South America. In The Last Planet, Nick crashes a ship on an alien planet, and must recapture the ship from aliens, fix it, and get away. In The Island of Spies, Nick crash lands on a tropical island crawling with enemy spies and must escape.
title: Nick Hardy Adventures

description:
Kingsoft's Sextett compilation for the Commodore 64 includes the following:

  • Abyss
  • Demolition
  • Fire Galaxy
  • Fortress Underground
  • Space Pilot Compendium (includes Space Pilot and Space Pilot 2)
  • Zyron
title: Sextett

description: Hired Sword 2 is a slightly erotic role-playing game. Inspired by the Leisure Suit Larry series with visuals evoking Ultima IV, you are a broke mercenary trying to find the seductive elf who stole your heart. This comedic game offers the lands of Kadazanos and Glammorill to explore, with almost thirty different locations. Equipment in the game is randomly generated, with over 1,000 different combinations of weapons and armour available.
title: Hired Sword 2

description:
This two-disk compilation pack for the US market contains two games:

  • Sabre Wulf
  • Underwurlde
title: Underwurlde / Sabre Wulf

description: Super Dogfight is a two-player-only game. Two planes are doing battle among the clouds, doing their best to be the first one to reach ten points before their opponent does. The scores for each plane are recorded at the top of the screen. The planes can go in all direction, and they can even crash into each other. The game ends when one of the planes achieve its objective.

sample_screenshots.caption: A couple of points ahead of my opponent

title: Super Dogfight

description:
You are escorting an interplanetary supply transport in a space-ship equipped with a pulse laser. Hostile alien vessels, belonging to the so-called Triad, are amassing nearby waiting to attack. It is your task to destroy the Triad formation, and then you must make a path through a meteor field, so that the cargo can arrive safely at its destination.

Triad plays like a 3D version of Galaxian, where you control the positioning of the gun sight and when to fire your laser. In the first screen, aliens of the Triad assemble in the distance, and you must shoot at them before they get too close or launch antimatter fields. Each hit by an enemy may deplete your shield energy. After the aliens have been dispatched, the second screen displays incoming meteors which must also be shot before striking your ship's shield. After both screens have been completed, you are shown a cut-scene of the transport arriving at the target planet, and you qualify for the next level of difficulty which is much like the earlier levels.

Each game starts with three lives, which may be lost when your shield energy reaches zero. After each life lost, you are required to start the screen you are on from the beginning.
title: Triad

description:
ROX begins with a Lunar Lander sequence, where the player is to land the lunar module on the planet's surface by applying vertical thrusters. Once there the objective is to protect your base from falling meteors or "ROX" from space. Your module has rockets that shoot in a straight line, in three different directions to defend itself.

You also have three "panics" which will destroy any incoming meteors and a mothership will appear every few levels that needs to be disposed of. If a meteor hits your base or causes enough damage to the planet's surface to cause an earthquake, the game is lost.
title: ROX

description:
The ZZAP! Sampler is a covermount tape from the June 1987 issue of ZZAP! magazine, containing some game demos and one original game from Jeff Minter called Made in France II. Originally intended to be the pause mode for Return of the Mutant Camels, but was dropped because of memory constraints.

The game is a simple two player Breakout clone where the bricks are in the centre and behind each player. The player's bats are at the upper and lower half of the screen. If a player lets the ball leave the screen, the round is lost.

The original Made in France, was a Deflex clone used as the pause mode of Iridis Alpha.

The included demos and programs on Side A are:* Two levels (0 and 12) of Gribbly's Special Day Out

  • A rolling demo of an unnamed and since unreleased 3D space trading Sensible Software game, provisionally called "The Day The Universe Died"
  • A single level of Return of the Mutant Camels, there titled "Revenge II"
  • Mix-E-Load, the loader from Delta where you can play with the loading music using the joystick, altering the lead voice, bass, drums and FX.
  • Screens from The Last Ninja with music.

Side B consists of a remix of "Thalamusic", the loading music from Sanxion by Rob Hubbard performed on a Yamaha CX5M synthesizer using authentic Fairlight samples.
title: The ZZAP! Sampler

description:
Whirlybird is an arcade style game which puts you in control a military helicopter. Each level has two goals. Firstly, you must destroy an enemy naval vessel by travelling to an island to load your copter with a bomb, and then dropping it on the battleship. While you are thus engaged, you are beset by two fast moving motor-boats armed with diagonally firing guns whose bullets you must dodge. Once the ship has been destroyed, the next stage starts with black planes that rapidly moving from the left to the right of the screen. You must shoot down three of these planes and capture the crew after they bail out of the plane into the water. After three have been captured, you have a limited amount of time to return the prisoners to the island. If this time runs out, it is game over, regardless of how many of your five starting helicopters remain.

Each level is pretty much the same, except that odd levels are in daylight while even levels are at night time. The only way this affects game-play is that the black planes are only possible to spot at night if they pass in front of a white cloud. Later levels are made more difficult by the addition of a grey fighter plane which attacks you with increasing levels of ferocity as you are trying to destroy the black plane.

sample_screenshots.caption: The bomb has been retrieved from the island below.
Somebody has jumped from the doomed plane.
In pursuit of a black plane.

title: Whirlybird

description:
Gortek and the Microchips is an edutainment software package designed to teach children about BASIC programming, while having fun at the same time. Designed by three English schoolteachers, the package consists of two cassettes consisting of three games each. The games revolve around two characters - The Zitrons and the Microchips - and are as follows:

  • Annihilation - The Zitrons are passing by the planet Syntax in their ships, duplicating passwords in an attempt to land. They are having trouble with spelling, however, and it is up to you to zap any incorrect words that pass by. Occasionally flying by will be a word spelled correctly. Zapping these will end the game.
  • Boxes - A sorting area consists of sixteen boxes. These contain letters, numbers, and dollar signs. You must make your way to the end box, but can only move to specific spots according to a piece of information that will only be displayed for five seconds. Letters can only go in the boxes containing dollar signs, but not numbers. You can move up or down, but not diagonally.
  • Flog - A golf game with no graphics, the computer will give you two sets of numbers - club number and hitting strength - and you need to multiply two of these together. You are given the opportunity to tell the computer if you want to move the ball forwards or backwards. There may be times when you need to go past the hole before sinking the ball.
  • Place Value - A game of chance and skill, this game pits you against another Microchip which control their respective lines. You are given a random number by the computer, in which you place in any of your five squares. Your opponent does the same. The one whose line totals the highest number wins.
  • Splat - Gortek has constructed a security system designed to splat Zitrons if they happen to appear underground, and left you in charge of it. Move the Microchip to the same square the Zitron is in to kill him.
  • Zitrack - A letter will fall down from the sky, and your job is to press a letter on the keyboard corresponding to the letter shown on the screen before it crashes to the surface. Press the right letter ten times in a row, and you win the game. Three difficulty settings determine the speed in which the letters fall.

The package also includes a Training Manual, in which children are encouraged to read between games. This manual teaches them about things that are essential to BASIC programming such as correct syntax, variables, and keyboard layout.

The two cassettes also allow you to view your status report, have a conversation with the computer, display some computer art, and participate in a micro-quiz.

sample_screenshots.caption: Annihilation - Accidentally shot the correct word, and now the game has ended

title: Gortek and the Microchips

description:
Highland Games is a series of 1-2 player Scottish themed mini-games for the Commodore 64.

Players compete in a series of 5 athletic events based upon timing and quick movement:

  • Hammer Throw - Spin as fast as possible and achieve maximum hammer throw distance
  • Long Jump - Longest jump wins
  • Caber Toss - Try to flip over a large caber as many times as possible
  • Weight Toss - Set the height of a bar, and attempt to throw a heavy weight over this
  • Discus - Spin quickly and attempt to throw a heavy discus the maximum distance

Players receive a score for each event, and the player with the highest score at the end of all 5 events is deemed the winner. All-time highest score for each event is recorded.
title: Highland Games

description:
Police Cadet is a arcade shooting game for the Commodore 64.

The player takes on the role of a police cadet training to become an officer. On the screen, numerous people run back and forth between doors at what appears to be a busy subway station. The player controls cross-hairs, and must quickly shoot any criminals wielding a gun before they disappear into another doorway. The player must take care to avoid shooting innocents. On the bottom of the screen, a police scanner tracks recent criminal events, and the time remaining in the training session. At the end of each session, the player receives a score based upon criminals and innocents shot.

sample_screenshots.caption: Demonstration Mode - A Criminal is in the Bottom Center of the Screen
Innocents Naively Walk Across the Screen

title: Police Cadet

description:
Steve Garvey vs. Jose Canseco in Grand Slam Baseball is a 1 - 2 player baseball game for the Commodore 64.

Following basic Major League Baseball rules, there are a total of two teams, and the player can define the names and positions of their teammates. Individual players do not have unique stats, and all characters are identical. The game is player from the perspective of behind the behind the batter. The game relied upon the star power of Steve Garvey who retired the same year the game was published, and the at the time young star Jose Canseco for sales.
title: Steve Garvey vs. Jose Canseco in Grand Slam Baseball

description:
Delta Man is an action adventure game for the Commodore 64.

It's the year 2027, and you are a newspaper reporter, and one of possibly only a handful of humans left alive following a nuclear holocaust which has reduced the city of Chicago to a smoldering poisonous ruin. You have survived because you discovered an experimental, high-tech robotic space suit which, at least for the time being, protects you from the terminally toxic atmosphere and lets you move freely about the city.

Played from a 1st person perspective via the helmet of the suit, the player can move via different rooms. The player must make their base in the partially destroyed O'Hare airport, while trying to stay alive by gathering items from the wrecked city. Dangers including radiation, extreme temperatures, and toxins are a constant risk to the player. The player must find weapons to defend themselves from the mutated remnants of Chicago's population. The ultimate goal is to amass enough supplies and fuel to escape Chicago and reach the Mount Mitchell broadcasting station in North Carolina where humans are still broadcasting live.

sample_screenshots.caption: Awakening in the Argonne National Laboratory

title: Delta Man

description: Monopole is an unofficial game based on the well-known property trading board game Monopoly, for two human players. All 40 squares of the board are mapped as normal, with the properties joined by railways and utilities to buy. Chance and Community Chest cards are as standard, as is Jail and Just Visiting, while the Free Parking jackpot system (which official licenses never feature) and auction-style purchases are both optional. Moves are made by rolling the two simulated dice, then using the transactions menu to offer to buy an opponent's properties, buy houses or hotels, mortgage one of your properties, or check who owns which addresses.
title: Monopole

description: In this ski simulator from Abacus Software, the object of the game is to navigate your skier down a slope to the finish line. Three courses are offered. In "Slalom", you must touch each flag on the way down. "Giant Slalom" is the same, but you are competing for the best time possible. Finally, in "Alps", you must avoid making any contact with trees. You are disqualified for missing a flag, going off the course, or crashing into a tree. Three difficulty levels are offered.

sample_screenshots.caption: In the Slalom section, you need to touch the flags

title: Ski-er 64

description:
A ship has sunk, and the survivors have become stranded on an unstable chunk of arctic ice. The effect of the weight of the people and the howling arctic wind may capsize the iceberg at any minute, or at least cause the survivors to slide into the ocean. You play as a large mammoth, and your goal is to save these people by shifting your weight about to counter-act the weight imbalances of the iceberg. If you can manage to keep some of the fragile humans alive until the rescue ship arrives, then you complete the level and are ready to start the next.

On each level, points are gained at regular time intervals just by surviving. A bonus is awarded when the rescue ship, which is slowly making its way from right to left at the top of the screen, eventually arrives. The bonus score is awarded for each rescued survivor. So you will get a lower score if people have been tipped into the sea, or carried away by ravenous sea birds. The birds can be discouraged if you chase them away, but that may cause the ice to tip out of control, leading to disaster. If everyone dies before the boat arrives, then you lose a life and have to re-start the level. Also, humans may not be the only victims of the unstable ice. If you fall into the water yourself, then it is also game over.

sample_screenshots.caption: Different levels have different coloured backgrounds.
The last survivors about to be tipped off the iceberg.
Celebratory fireworks as the rescue boat arrives.

title: Arctic Shipwreck

description: Block Frenzy is remake of a popular flash game of the same name. You are in control of a square block starting in the center of the screen. Four other blocks of different shape are moving along the screen. The goal is to move around the play area avoiding collisions with other blocks for as long as possible. Once you collide with any of the other blocks, the game comes to an end.
title: Block Frenzy

description:
Botticelli is a 1 - 9 player logic learning and guessing game for multiple systems.

The computer attempts to guess what object the player is thinking of, or vice versa, by asking a number of yes or no questions. There are multiple categories, and the player must teach the computer a variety of objects by teaching yes or no questions for differing objects. The player can define the number of guesses they have to name an object.

sample_screenshots.caption: At the Beginning the Computer Gives up Easily
Teaching the Difference Between Scissors and a Refrigerator

title: Botticelli

description: Speed Racer is a top-down racing game where the player controls a car on a vertically-scrolling never-ending road. A timer ticks down from 100, and when it reaches zero, one of the player's three cars is removed. A car is also lost when it crashes into a road obstacle or a parked car. There are also people on the road - policemen, grannies, children on bikes and more. The game is played for high score in three categories: miles driven, heavenly and devilish points. Heavenly and devilish points are awarded for avoiding and driving over people, respectively. An extra car is awarded for every 100 miles driven.

sample_screenshots.caption: Entering name in high score list

title: Speed Racer

description: Forced Encounter is an arcade shoot-em-up. In each level you have a single enemy: a UFO who is trying to capture a biological specimen (you) for their research. You need to shoot the UFO to end the level. However the alien craft has surrounded itself with a moving shield of red and blue walls, and while it is protected can rain down a hail of gas-bombs and a capture net. The bombs may be shot as they fall, but the nets are invulnerable to your bullets, and can only be avoided. Your goal is to shoot through the shield wall, and get the UFO before it gets you. Once you have been hit three times, you become incapacitated and the UFO is able to beam you up to perform unspeakable experiments.

sample_screenshots.caption: You have been captured, and about to be beamed up.
As the shield depletes, the UFO shoot faster.
The UFO appears at the start of the level.

title: Forced Encounter

description: Word Feud is a puzzle game for one or two players. A three- or four-letter word is displayed at the top of the screen, and players need to find the same word among the eight rows of jumbled letters. Three humans are displayed on a line at the bottom of the screen. If the player manages to find the given word, another human is added to the line. If the chosen word does not match the given word, then its location is revealed and a human is destroyed. If players get thirteen humans on the line, the game ends and a new game begins as soon as a key is pressed. There are two variations to the game: one where the given word is hidden to the player, plus another where either a butterfly or frog will eventually eat all the letters if the player does not hurry up and finds the word.
title: Word Feud

description:
In Tropical Fever you are a zookeeper who is tasked to catch wild animals for the zoo. The job is not going to be smooth as the animals are not willing to get caught. You have to lure them to a cage with a banana, by firing a water pistol or using gates.

As if that wasn't enough, a mischievous monkey will do anything to waste your time by jumping on your head and slowing down your speed, while a hostile red rhino hunts you down trying to kill you.

Once all animals (a panther, two gorillas and a phoenix) are caught, you must try to keep them in their cages. This is a difficult task as the cages will catch fire, the animals will escape and become lethal to touch.

The game can be played by one player or two players alternately and each level is displayed as a single screen where you must catch an animal. Completing a level will get you an extra life.

sample_screenshots.caption: The panther is caught in the cage!
Introduction screen telling what animal to catch.
Having grabbed a banana, I move it to the cage. Hopefully it will attract the gorilla.
You have to lure a gorilla with a waterpistol to the cage.
Having caught all the animals, the worst is yet still to come.

title: Tropical Fever

description:
Ghost Hunt is a supernatural themed shooting game. Your task is to capture all of the ghosts haunting a castle within a certain time limit.

There are five different colours of ghosts, and three of each colour. Every ghost has its own distinct movement pattern which can include sudden appearances and disappearances. The player maneuvers a cross-hair around the screen and if they press the button on the ghost while it is visible, it becomes stuck to the cursor. Once a ghost is captured, it must be moved to the side screen out of harm's way, before the next ghost appears.

In the first part of the game, each ghost appears in order. Capturing all 15 ghosts results in a cut-scene showing the ghosts dancing. The game then continues with the ghosts appearing in random order, and you must try to increase your score by catching as many of them as possible before your time runs out.

sample_screenshots.caption: The last ghosts to catch are purple.
The first ghost to catch is white.

title: Ghost Hunt

description: In Blindganger you play a blind person who is stuck in a sewer system. You have to find the exit by listening to the environment sounds. "Ssshh" stands for no obstacle, "Kunk" for sewer wall, "Beep" for deep well and "Tink" for the exit. Every couple of minutes, a wave flushes you through the sewer and you have to make your way back. When the time expires or you make it to the exit, an overview of the map is shown. Blindganger was published in the dutch magazine "Commodore Dossier" issue 17 in 1988. It was written in BASIC with some assembler routines.

sample_screenshots.caption: Game over screen with bug. In line 3670 it should say 255 not 244.
Game over screen with the line 3670 bug fixed.

title: Blindganger

description:
Mind Benders is a compilation containing the following games:

  • Confuzion
  • Snare
  • Split Personalities
  • Trivial Pursuit
title: Mind Benders

description:
Triple Tournament is a collection of three games not available separately, only through this release.

  • The first game is a cowboy duel shown from a side view.
  • The second game is Space Race. It involves keeping your spaceship on a path and collecting points as you go.
  • The last game is Kamikazi, on the high seas. The object is to shoot and destroy various planes which tend to crash into your ship.
title: Triple Tournament

description: In Laser Strike, you commandeer a space fighter that is trying to navigate through an asteroid field and ice caverns. Approaching you are asteroids that must be avoided. Space debris that float by are usually harmless until they turn orange. Occasionally, a missile will rise up from the ground and make its way toward you, and this too must be avoided. The distance to the next section is indicated by the blue bar next to the number of lives; as you progress through each section, the bar will get shorter. You start with two lives and lose one of them if you hit an asteroid, lethal space debris, and missile. An extra life is awarded by shooting the control center near the ice cavern. If you complete both sections, you start again from the first, but the difficulty will be ramped up.

sample_screenshots.caption: Blew up one of the bases
A missile rises up from the surface and makes its way toward you

title: Laser Strike

description:
In Sting 64 Bertie Bee must defend his hive in this action game, taking place across three distinct single-screen parts. You play each of them three times in sequence in amassing a score, but they become harder each time.

First, you are presented with a garden of three hives, which are being attacked by other bees. Move around the screen hitting them to stop them reaching their target hive and turning part of it black.

Once one of the three hives has been completely turned black, part B begins. Here the enemy bees are trying to steal the honey from inside the hive, and you must guide your swarm of six bees (which are vulnerable to contact) to make contact with the attackers.

Part C features defending the Queen Bee from attackers, whose contact with the Queen turns it black. Complete this and the game returns to part one.
title: Sting 64

description:
The Triple Decker collections combine three previously-released games, with different lineups on each system, and one game taking precedence over the other two. This set contains:

  • Metranaut
  • Merlin
  • Strike Force
title: Triple Decker 2

description: Star Trooper sets you as a lone space soldier with a jet pack, with aliens to face. The first task is to successfully dock with your mother ship, in order to refuel. Then the battle beings, against 3 alien waves with different patterns and strategies, followed by a meteor storm, before successfully docking again. There are 6 levels, each with four new aliens to be faced. The action is viewed from the side, and the player fires in the direction they are facing.

sample_screenshots.caption: Battling the first alien wave in sector one.
Each sector has multiple different alien attack waves.
The aliens in sector two have new attack patterns.

title: Star Trooper

description: Showjumping is a horse riding simulation that features three courses, each available at five difficulty levels. Controlling a horse, the player must guide it over gates, bars and water hazards, with approach angles and timing critical to success. Scoring can be either on time, or on faults, or both. Crowd reactions give the player an idea how they're doing. The appearance of both rider and horse can be customised.
title: Showjumping

sample_screenshots.caption: Battling the aliens over the city.
Back over the city skyline and a large park.

description: in Vortex Raider the player is riding a Jet bike with lights, cooling and oxygen. They must dodge between columns and shoot 5 of each creature by lining up your laser cannons. The journey takes in across forest, temple and sea. The final goal is to reach the Golden Treasure Chest, dodge the attacks from the guardians you face, and creep up to the treasure. Make contact with a guardian and you can only escape without treasure, ready for another loop of the game.

sample_screenshots.caption: If the bird gets too close, you lose a life.
Level two has a desert theme. Hunt the cobra!
Level one starts with hunting a rabbit through the forest.
Level three is an underwater level, first try to hunt the fish.

title: Vortex Raider

description:
Mind Warp is a space strategy action game suggesting that 3 hours of play are required to gain proficienncy with all functions, with obvious Star Trek influences. Ceta Major is under attack from Romulans and Klingons, and as the commander on board spaceship Excellence, it is your job to repel them.

Ceta Major is split into an 8x8 grid, and your scanners tell you how many Klingon and Super Klingon ships, Star Bases and Stars are in each neably sector (central areas of the block thus yield more info, but give enemies more chances to attack), while the Romulans only show on your short-range scanner. Klingons take 2 hits to be destroyed (and can destroy you with two shots - keep an eye on the damage report), Super Klingons 3 hits, and Romulan ships 5 hits (but have less powerful weaponry). Your phasers are more powerful than your torpedos, but their use takes up energy. Visit star bases to charge up your power and reload weapons - planets do the same but can only be visited once.

sample_screenshots.caption: Starting a new game. Mind Warp is a derivative of classic Star Trek games.
The Klingon war fleet moves in for attack.
The short range scanner is inoperable, which disables the map in the bottom right of the screen.

title: Mind Warp

description: Flappy Bird is a demake of Flappy Bird. You let your bird flap its wings by touching the joystick, making sure you stay in the air without colliding with the pipes entering the screen from above and below. If the bird falls or touches something, the game is over.
title: Flappy Bird

description:
This compilation contains ten previously released games:

  • Fairlight
  • K.R.I.S.
  • Quo Vadis
  • Shadow Skimmer
  • Firequest
  • Almazz
  • Inside Outing (a.k.a. Raffles / Devon Aire in the Hidden Diamond Caper)
  • Brian Bloodaxe
  • Bobby Bearing
  • Wizardry (a.k.a. Spell of Destruction)
title: All-Stars

description:
Bubble Burst is a 1 - 2 player educational game for the Commodore 64.

Stop the Zeboingers from bursting all the bubbles in Soapie's bathtub. The player controls a target, and must shoot bubbles at bird-like Zeboingers as they fly towards the bubblebath. If the Zeboingers reach the bubbles, the bubbles pop, and the bath gets less bubbly. The player has limited bubble juice each round, after which they can no longer defend themselves. The Zeboingers can open the window or turn on the shower, which further reduces bubbles. Each game, the player can choose to start on round 1 or 11.
title: Bubble Burst

description:
Coney Island is a 1 - 2 player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

The player controls a penguin who works an ice-cream stand in the Antarctic. Customers approach the stand, and the penguin must swim to the corresponding ice floes to make the correct ice-cream come in the correct order. The penguin can move quickly while in the water, but moves slowly while on land. Ice floes move from the left to right, and if the penguin moves off the right of the screen, a life is lost. Further, jumping fish can steal the penguin's cone, causing a loss of life. At higher levels, there is more variety to ice cream types, but the reward for a successful order is greater. The player starts with 3 lives, and it's game over when all are lost.
title: Coney Island

description:
Shape Shop is a 1 - 2 player educational game for the Commodore 64.

The player controls a construction robot, that can move in all directions, pick up items, and press buttons. Items come down the conveyor belt, but they are missing a shape. The player must create the correct shape, make it the correct color, and place it on the unfinished object, to complete the finished model. There are 3 levels of difficulty, which control the missing shapes and speed. If the player misses 3 pictures, it's game over.

sample_screenshots.caption: I Made the Ear Too Big
I Have the Correct Shape For the Skate

title: Shape Shop

description:
Foto Fitter is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

The player character runs horizontally, and can jump as well as use his tie to attack. The goal is to run from one side to the other of a side-scrolling level, while avoiding enemies including cars, camels, and construction equipment. A map in the bottom right shows the player's progression on the level. Each time the player crosses the level, they receive 1/6th of a picture of a person, and after completing the picture, they go to the next of 4 levels with different geography and animals. The player has limited health which is restored each level. If the player loses all health, it's game over.
title: Foto Fitter

description:
Soldier of Fortune is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

The player must explore a series of undergrounds caverns to kill the monsters within. The player's character can move horizontally, jump, and use the weapons they find throughout the labyrinth. Each individual monster requires a specific weapon or stronger to destroy, and stronger monsters require strong weapons. The player must travel through the catacombs and destroy as many monsters as possible in a limited time span. The player starts with 5 lives, and it's game over when all are lost.
title: Soldier of Fortune

description:
Warriors of Zypar is a 1 - 2 player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

Set in a futuristic arena, you and your opponent hover about on aero disks doing combat. The player can make short jumps, and knock their opponent off of their aero disk if they land on them. When a player is knocked off their aero disk, and are hit by an enemy, they will become temporarily stunned on the ground. Game play is divided into 3 components. An alien creatures runs rapidly about the screen, and each player tries to knock it into the electrical field in the center of the screen after tagging it. There is also an alien creature that flies about, and the player gains points by holding onto it longer that their opponent. A third section allows the player to pick up similar colored items from the ground while avoiding flying enemies. Energy powerups appear on the field that the player must pick up. A life is lost when all energy or health is lost. There are 3 levels of opponent difficulty.

sample_screenshots.caption: Trying to Knock the Creatures Into the Field

title: The Warriors of Zypar

description:
Thunder Mountain: Action Pack Vol.2 is a compilation containing the following ten games:

  • Army Moves
  • Bad Street Brawler
  • Cyrus Chess
  • Demolition Mission: The Alleykat Space Racer
  • Doc the Destroyerl
  • Fist: The Legend Continues
  • Mutants
  • Tai-Pan
  • Tau Ceti
  • Uridium
title: Thunder Mountain: Action Pack Vol. 2

description: Revelation is a sideview shooter scrolling in multiple directions, taking its cue from Revelations, the final book of the Bible. The player is trapped in the caverns of Hell, attempting to locate the Monster of the Apocalypse, with over 40 caverns to pass first. You are constantly dropping downwards without applying thrust to your vehicle, and must avoid any contact with lava pits or other hazards. Foes include the Falcon Fiend, Gorson (The Demon Lord of the Imps) and Belial (The Demon Lord of the Bats). The game can be started from waves 1, 4, 9, 14.

sample_screenshots.caption: Strange bats and bugs will try to stop you.
Shoot the towers until they change into upside down pentagrams.

title: Revelation

description:
Red Alert is an espionage strategy game for up to four players, each playing a secret agent. Gameplay largely comprises of random set-piece situations, with a decision to be made which will influence later situations.

The ultimate goal is to break into a secret enemy base, however you start with only £1000 and no equipment or assistance. The aim is to gradually obtain these, by negotiating to buy or sell information, weaponry and other items. Money can be gambled at the casino or dog track. Potential employees come to you with a wage demand, and sometimes a specific skill. The police occasionally put you under surveillance, which can cause a need to dump documents.

sample_screenshots.caption: With enough men and equipment, you can start your mission.
Earn money by selling secret documents.
Gamble on roulette to earn more money.
Millions killed in a rocket strike. God bless the U.S.A.

title: Red Alert

description: Ekim the Giant Ant lives on a hut, on one of a group of islands favoured by Pirates. They have trained him to move their treasure for them, and the player controls Ekim in this action game. Treasure will randomly appear on the islands, and Ekim must reach it and return it to his hut. A treasure chest contains existing treasure to grab, but opens and closes at random - Ekim must not be trapped inside it when it closes. Some islands are linked by bridges and logs, but to reach others you must cross on either turtles or crocodiles, who are moving around the screen. When riding a turtle you must keep moving in the same direction as it, to account for its slipperiness, while the appearance of a croc causes the turtles to dive underwater, causing Ekim to drown and lose one of five lives). Energy is limited, but can be topped up by eating.
title: Turtle Jump

description:
Early Learning Friends is a compilation of three games from Spinnaker:

  • Alf in the Color Caves
  • Coney Island
  • Shape Shop
title: Early Learning Friends

description:
Spitball is a 1 - 2 player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

Two worm-like characters can move clockwise or counterclockwise around two tracks. The characters can move between tracks, and if they touch their opponent, they lose a life. The player can shoot balls into the center of the screen, which bounce off the deflections within the center, and bounce out the side of the level. There are teleporters, which can move the computer opponent around the level. The goal is to strike the opponent to pass the level. Each level is timed, and the player has to hit their opponent to move to the next challenge. The player has 3 lives, and it's game over when all are lost.

sample_screenshots.caption: I Got Hit by my Own Ball

title: Spitball

description:
Bumblebee is a 1-player educational game for the Commodore 64.

You control Bart the Bumblebee, by giving him instructions to travel from his beehive, and then go from flower to flower and return to his bumblebee. The player inputs movement commands for the bumblebee, while trying to avoid dangers including Olga the Spider and Phineas the Frog. Commands include direction, waiting periods, and loops. The bumblebee has a limited time to complete the level, and there are 10 increasingly difficult puzzle levels.
title: Bumblebee

alternate_titles.title: Roll Call USA: Challenge Your Knowledge of the 50 States.

description:
Roll Call USA is a multiplayer trivia game for the Commodore 64.

The player creates quizzes related to the 50 American states. Topics include: state capitals, major industries, large cities, statehood date, and other trivia.
title: Roll Call USA

description:
Crossfire Canyon is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

The player controls a small character who can move horizontally about the center of the level. On either side is an erupting volcano, from which creatures appear, and stack on top of each other. The creatures will shoot rocks at the character. If the character is hit, they lose a life. Otherwise, the player can pick up the missed rock, and throw it back at the creature. The strength of the thow is dependent upon how long the throw button is pressed. If a creature is struck, they are removed from the level. The player wins by clearing a level of creatures. The player starts with 3 lives, and it's game over when all are lost.
title: Crossfire Canyon

description:
Space Sentinel is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

A small space ship continuously orbits the Earth, able to fire in 8 separate directions, but unable to change its course. Alien ships approach from multiple directions, and fire upon the Earth. As the Earth is hit, pieces of the Northern Hemisphere begin to disappear into the sea. The player must defend the Earth from alien assault for as long as possible.
title: Space Sentinel

description:
Candy Bandit is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

The player controls the bandit, who can move in all directions, while trying to avoid the sheriff. The player tries to navigate between moving walls and collect all the candy on the screen. If the player touches a wall, they can't move until a new gap in the wall appears. If the player collects all the candy, they move onto a more challenging level. The sheriff moves continuously towards the bandit, and if he catches him, the player loses a life. The player starts with 5 lives, and it's game over when all are lost.
title: Candy Bandit

description:
South Pacific Task Force is a 1-player wargame for the Commodore 64.

You are in control of the White Fleet. Your job is to liberate a South Pacific island that has been captured by the Black Fleet. In order to win the encounter, the player must place a number of landing ships, depending on the difficulty level, onto the island. The player selects and issues orders for individual ships, and each vessel has a course, speed, damage rating. The player controls aircraft carriers, patrol aircraft, bomber aircraft, destroyers, battleships, patrol ships, and landing ships.
title: South Pacific Task Force

description:
Hydrax is a 1-player side scrolling arcade/adventure game.

You have entered a large cavern rumored to host an ancient dragon on the lowest levels. The dragon is believed to guard a great treasure, and will stop at nothing to protect it.

The player controls a character who can walk, duck, jump, and swing a sword. The player explores numerous rooms, but can also type commands to move and control their character. The player can pick up and drop items, and has a limited inventory capacity. The player must solve puzzles, and also defeat enemies.

sample_screenshots.caption: Starting by  an Old Suit of Armor

title: Hydrax

description:
Computer Trivia is a 1 - 6 player trivia game for the Commodore 64.

Players answer a variety of trivia questions. There are 3 levels of difficulty. Game length is to 50, 100, or 150 points, and the players can choose the length of time available per question.
title: Computer Trivia

description:
3 For All is a compilation of games for the Commodore 64.

Contains the following games:

  • Brig Battle
  • Enchanted Forest
  • Houdini Escape
title: 3 For All

description:
Houdini Escape is a 1-player number guessing game for the Commodore 64.

The player must help Houdini escape from a series of 3 death traps, with 2, 3, or 4 locks respectively. To solve a lock, the player must guess a number between 1 and 75. Each guess, the player is told whether the number is too high or too low. The player has 60 seconds to solve all the locks, or they succumb to their trap.
title: Houdini Escape

description:
Brig Battle is a 2-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

Each player controls a sailing vessel, and can fire in any direction except for the bow or stern. Each ship can take a limited number of hits, defined by the player at the beginning of each match. Players must avoid fire from nearby forts. Continuously changing wind conditions affect boat movement. Ships cannot move directly upwind, and vessels must take several seconds to reload. Players receive a score based upon the amount of damage they have remaining at the end of each battle.
title: Brig Battle

description:
Enchanted Forest is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

The player controls a small character who moves about a forest trying to collect trees. They must avoid 3 creatures that move continuously towards the player, and occasionally disappear behind the foliage. The player loses a life if caught, 3 lives lost and it's game over.
title: Enchanted Forest

description:
Fire Trap is a 1-player science fiction themed arcade game for the Commodore 64.

The player controls a spaceship that moves horizontally at the bottom of the screen, and can fire forwards. Three alien vessels move about the screen, and fire vertically downwards. As an alien vessel is destroyed, a new one immediately takes its place. If the player is hit, they lose a spaceship. The player starts with 3 vessels, and it's game over when all are lost.
title: Fire Trap

description:
Monster Tribe is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

The player controls a small spaceship that can move in all directions, and fires vertically forwards. The player finds 3 large alien creatures that move about the screen. When an alien is shot, they begin to return fire towards the player. The player receives points for hitting an enemy, but they cannot be destroyed. They player starts with 5 lives, and loses a life if hit.
title: Monster Tribe

description:
War Lord of Atlantis is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

The player controls a scuba diver who moves continuously from the left of the screen, and can fire directly forwards. Enemy scuba divers move about the screen and fire back. The player can shoot the enemies for points, but they don't disappear from the screen. It's game over when the player is hit 3 times.
title: War Lord of Atlantis

description:
Ricochet Muncher is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

The player controls a turret on the bottom of the screen which moves horizontally and fires vertically. A small character bounces about the screen, and the player tries to shoot it. If the player hits the character before the timer on the top of the screen runs out, the player gains 100 points. Otherwise, the computer gains 200 points. Every few hits, another row of objects for the character to bounce off appears.
title: Ricochet Muncher

description:
Bomb Ace is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

The player controls a small plane that continuously scrolls from and reappears on the left side of the screen. The player controls the height of the plane, and tries to drop bombs on tanks that continuously scroll from the right of the screen. The player has 100 time units, and gains 10 points per tank destroyed, but loses 10 for each building hit.
title: Bomb Ace

description:
Elevator Ride (To Danger) is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

The player tries to climb down a 10 floor elevator shaft, while trying to avoid being hit by the descending elevator. When the player stops descending, the elevator picks up speed. When the player climbs quickly, the elevator slows down. If the player touches the top or the bottom of the elevator, they fall to their doom. There are 3 levels of difficulty.
title: Elevator Ride (To Danger)

description:
Space Freeze is a 1-player arcade game fr the Commodore 64.

The player controls a small vessel that can move horizontally, and is able to deploy a shield that moves horizontally across the screen. The player can deploy the shield a set number of times per game, and the goal is to deploy the shield at the right time to destroy the incoming alien vessel. The player gains 100 points per vessel destroyed.
title: Space Freeze

description:
Heart Attack! is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

The player tries to gather all the diamonds in a randomly generated maze, while avoiding the guard. The guard will always turn right at an intersection. Every 8 mazes the player is awarded an additional man, and the guard moves faster. There are 2 possible gameplay options: allowing for invisible diamonds, or allowing the guard to follow the player's trail once discovered. The player starts with 3 lives, and it's game over when all are lost.
title: Heart Attack!

description:
Quizardry is a 1 or more player quiz game for the Commodore 64.

The Quizard knows all, but do you? The player must answer trivia questions to escape from the Quizard's minions deep within his dungeon. The player needs to collect the 6 Keys of Knowledge to escape the dungeon.
title: Quizardry

description:
Duel is a 1 - 2 player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

You are lost on an icy planet astride a mutant bird. The bird can run along flat terrain, but can also fly up into the air. Your opponents carry energy nodules. To defeat them, and retrieve the energy nodules, the player must strike the enemy from above or behind. If an energy nodule is not collected and falls into the deadly water at the bottom of the screen, then the evil warlords will use their energy to melt their icy prison at the center of the screen. If the player clears all enemies on the screen, they proceed to the next stage. The player starts with 5 lives, and there is a tournament mode where 2 players can compete.
title: Duel

description:
Towering Inferno is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

The player controls firemen with a net at the bottom of a burning building. The player moves laterally to catch falling residents, but residents often bounce, so must be caught several times before being safety caught. Obese residents can not be safely caught, and must be allowed to fall to their death. The player receives bonus points for catching furniture. Some residents burn up in mid-air. If the player misses too many residents, or accidentally catches an obese resident, they lose a life. There are 2 levels of difficulty, and 5 stages.
title: Towering Inferno

description:
Power Play Classics is a compilation of five games, all of which were well reviewed in Germany's Power Play magazine.

  • California Games
  • Solomon's Key
  • Impossible Mission II
  • Street Sports Basketball
  • Hawkeye
title: Power Play Classics

description:
Rebel Force is a graphic adventure game with RPG elements.

For numerous years in the Kingdom of Acritym, ruled by his majesty Lord Cybala, a distinct group has formed, a rebellion attempting to overthrow Acritym's government. This rebellion has left the majority famished and defenseless. His majesty has hired you, a mercenary, to locate the rebel meeting place and eliminate this threat within the walls of palace.

The player moves throughout the palace by typing forwards, backwards, left and right. The player is created by a random roll of intelligence, strength, constitution, dexterity, luck, and gold, and must buy weapons and armor before the game begins. As they move, the player is often attacked by rebels, and must defend themselves in combat. Combat involves choosing how many and which weapon to attack with. The player can rest between combats, and can die 3 times per adventure.

They are able to pick up and use items they find, and commands are via VERB NOUN entry. The player must solve numerous puzzles during their adventure, and there is a save/restore feature.
title: Rebel Force

description:
Who Dun-It is a text adventure for the Commodore 64.

You are a down on his luck detective, who just got called to investigate a robbery at the Carr estate. The lights went out during a party to show off the new necklace, and when they came back on, the necklace was gone. The player must explore the Carr estate, and look for clues as to who stole the necklace and where it was hidden. The player can talk to the party guests, and explore the different rooms of the estate. After determining the culprit, the player must return to the paddywagon and say "case closed". All commands are via VERB NOUN entry. There is a save/restore feature available.

sample_screenshots.caption: Exploring In Front of the House
Fired for Drinking on the Job

title: Who Dun-It

description:
Jot-a-Word Genie is a 1-player word game for the Commodore 64.

The player and computer take turns trying to guess 5 letter words. Each turn, the player must guess a 5-letter word, and are told how many of the letter in their word are correct, and how many are in the correct position. Only real words are accepted, and the program understands approximately 5,000 words. The first player to guess correctly is the winner.
title: Jot-a-Word Genie

description:
Voyage of the Mayflower is a 1-player strategy game for the Commodore 64.

The player must retrace the original route of The Pilgrims from Plymouth, England to the New World. At the start of he game, the player must choose their supplies for the journey. On easier levels, they only need to choose food and water, but on higher levels, they must choose food (preserved and fresh), water, spirits, animals, animal feed, and more. During the trip, the player must choose their ship heading, while navigating with winds, and on higher levels the prevailing currents. The player must set their supply levels, and can view their progress on a map of the Atlantic. Bad weather can slow the voyage. The player must have sufficient supplies to start a new colony upon their arrival.
title: Voyage of the Mayflower

description:
Flower Power is a 1-player educational game for the Commodore 64.

The player can work with whole numbers, fractions, or decimals, and can do addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. When the player answers a questions correctly they are rewarded a flower, and a weed for an incorrect answer. When a player answers correctly, the difficulty increases, and decreases with an incorrect answer. Each game goes for 10 questions.
title: Flower Power

description:
Rubicon is a side-scrolling run-and-gun shooter in which the goal is to traverse five levels in order to reach a cache of nuclear weapons and check on their integrity. Standing in the player's way are various creatures mutated by radiation as well as military hardware like tanks, helicopters and walkers. The player's gun cannot be upgraded, but one level offers a jetpack power-up and another the possibility to ride a captured creature. To unlock the weapons vault, the player must collect four "SW units" found in the levels.

The 16-bit version of Rubicon, despite being billed as a port, has nothing in common with the C64 version besides the basic premise.

sample_screenshots.caption: A sea monster, and some small green nuisances.
A boulder, just like in the first Indiana Jones movie...
When you die, you turn into a pile of grey bones.
A spider jumped out from that egg over there, and attached itself to me. Just like in the movie Alien.

title: Rubicon

description:
Falconian Invaders is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

You are at the console of a space fighter attempting to ward off the attacking fleet in a never ending battle to stay alive. Controlled from a viewpoint behind the ship, the player can move in all directions as alien vessels approach. The player receives more points for shooting an alien vessel further away. The player has limited fuel, but receives a bonus for every enemy hit.

There is a regular and advanced mode. In regular mode, the player automatically tracks enemy vessels, and merely needs to position their ship near an alien and fire. In advanced mode, the player must precisely align their ship with the enemy before firing.
title: Falconian Invaders

description:
TSI Cycles is a 1 - 2 player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

Each player controls a blue or red light cycle. As the vehicles drive, they leave behind a string of light. If either player runs into the trail left by a light cycle, the opponent gains a point. Game options include 1 - 2 players and solid or no border. The game tracks score over multiple rounds.
title: TSI Cycles

description:
Turbo Maze Man is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

The player controls a Pac-Man like creature in a maze trying to eat all the pellets. Four ghosts are released from their homes, and will chase the player if approached too close. Power pellets in the corners of the screen will temporarily send the ghosts back to their homes. If the player clears a level, they advance to a more difficult challenge. The player starts with 5 lives, and it's game over when all are lost.
title: Turbo Maze Man

description:
Ultrex Quadro Maze is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

Each level contains 4 small mazes displayed in the corners of the screen. The player moves through each maze, trying to gather all the pellets while avoiding a monster. After completing a maze, the player jumps to the next one. Maze design is randomized between each level, and there is an animated sequence accompanying each jump. The player starts with 5 lives, and it's game over when all are lost.
title: Ultrex Quadro Maze

description:
Word Factory is a 1-player educational game for the Commodore 64.

The word factory can make lots of words, but it hasn't been working to well. It can make many mistakes. As words come down the chute, the player must decide whether it is spelled correctly or incorrectly, and must move the chute to put words in the correct bin.
title: Word Factory

description:
Black is a 2-player board game for the Commodore 64.

Played on a 4 x 4 - 8 x 8 board, players take turns placing movement pieces on the board. This can make a marker dropped from the top left corner of the screen move straight, bend left, or bend right. Players take turns dropping a piece at the ending location of the marker. If the player allows the marker to roll off the board or land in the bottom right square, they lose.
title: Black

description:
Jigsaw is a puzzle game for the Commodore 64.

The player puts together jigsaw puzzles by choosing square pieces and placing them on a grid.
title: Jigsaw

description:
Kayles is a 2-player action/strategy game for Commodore 64.

Players take turns throwing a ball at a series of bottles. This is represented by a ball that scrolls along the bottom of the screen, and the player can hit 1 or 2 adjacent bottles. The player who hits the last bottle is the winner. There are 2 levels of difficulty which influence the bottle setup.
title: Kayles

description:
Letter Games is a 1-player educational game for the Commodore 64.

Game designed to help children with letter discrimination. Children try to find the letter that is different, or match letters from a list.
title: Letter Games

description:
Traffic Jam is a 2-player board game for the Commodore 64.

Four cars are placed on a 5 x 5 triangular board. There are a total of 15 cities, with a 1-way route between each city. Players move cars between cities, and there is always 1 city that has no exit route. The game ends when all cars are stuck in this city, and the player who made the last move is the loser. If each player repeats the same move 10 times in row, the game is declared a draw.
title: Traffic Jam

description:
Dungeon of the Algebra Dragons is an educational game for the Commodore 64.

You have been imprisoned within a multi-layered dungeon, and must collect keys and escape to the surface. Played from a 3rd person perspective game, the player must move from room to room searching for the keys while attempting to avoid spiders, dragons, and ghosts. In each room, you are presented with three numbered doors and you have the option of jumping or moving through a door. Players are told if there are and what type of dangers are nearby.

Ghosts will move the player to another part of the tomb, and dragons ask the player an algebra question. Dragons award the player with gold if questions are answered correctly, and take it away if incorrect. The player can jump on spiders, or be bitten by them. Some rooms have pits, which drop the player to lower levels. There are 4 levels of question difficulty.

sample_screenshots.caption: The Ghost Moves me to Anther Room

title: Dungeon of the Algebra Dragons

description:
Programming Kit 1: Lunar Lander is an educational arcade program for the Commodore 64.

This program allows young programmers to create their own Lunar Lander game. With this, the player tries to land a lander on a flat surface of the moon below. The player has limited fuel, and must control their vertical and horizontal velocity prior to landing, while contending with gravity.
title: Programming Kit 1: Lunar Lander

description:
Presidential Campaign is a 1 - 4 player strategy game for the Commodore 64.

Each player takes control of their own American presidential campaign 124 days before election day. Each turn, the player can choose to visit a state by land or air in order to campaign and explain your platform. By doing this, the player can try to shore up votes for election night. Random events happen each turn, and the player must carefully monitor their campaign finances. The player must choose their campaign platform based upon a number of options, and can perform campaign research to poll states, determine state voter history, and votes remaining in states.
title: Presidential Campaign

description:
Programming Kit 2: Slot Machine is a educational gambling game for the Commodore 64.

This program allows young programmers to create their own casino slots game with an animated slot machine. The player starts with $15, and it's $1/pull on the slot machine.
title: Programming Kit 2: Slot Machine

description:
Spellbound is an educational game for the Commodore 64.

The player tries to move about a board collecting the letters to spell the displayed word. Words must be spelled in correct order, and they can't touch the border.
title: Spellbound

description:
Star Battle is a 1 player space fighting game for the Commodore 64.

Seated in the command center of the Starship Columbia as its captain, you attempt to save Earth from the infamous Scyons. The player explores an 8 x 8 quadrant universe containing alien vessels. The player warps between sectors, and fights alien vessels from a 1st person perspective, armed with phasers, photon torpedoes, and the OBNAC 3000 on board computer. The player has short and long ranged sensors to find Sycon Battle Cruisers, and track the health of their Starbase. The player ship takes systems damage when hit by alien fire, and must monitor their ship status, returning to base for repairs. There are 4 levels of difficulty.
title: Star Battle

description:
Wall Street is a 1 - 4 player stock trading game for the Commodore 64.

Players take turns buying and selling shares to try to maximize their profits. They can also invest in real estate and money markets. Game time is divided into individual quarters.
title: Wall Street

description:
Entertainment Tonight is a 1 - 6 player trivia game for the Commodore 64.

Players answer a variety of general knowledge trivia, and must correctly type the answer. As the players answer questions, they fill in sections of the letters of the word TRIVIA. If a letter is already filled, and the player answers a question in that section, they get to repeat a question. There are 3 levels of question difficulty, and players can chose 20, 40, or 60 seconds to answer questions.
title: Entertainment Tonight

description:
The Game of Trivia is a 1 - 6 player trivia game for the Commodore 64.

Players answer a variety of general knowledge trivia, and must correctly type the answer. Questions can be worth 3, 5, or 10 points. Players can chose 10, 15, or 20 seconds to answer questions. Games can go to 50, 100, or 150 points.
title: The Game of Trivia

description:
Ski-Devil! is a 1-player arcade skiing game for the Commodore 64.

The player guides a downhill skier down a hill, trying to direct him through a series of flags. Dangers include trees, flag poles, rabbits, and icy patches. The player can steer left and right, and must avoid dangers. The goal is to minimize time down the hill.
title: Ski-Devil!

description:
The Argos Expedition is a 2 - 4 player strategy game for the Commodore 64.

In the early years of interstellar travel, Earth's brave explorers discovered the remains of an alien culture eons old and incredibly complex. Human progress leapt forward at an astonishing rate as the secrets of alien artifacts were brought back from the stars. You have been selected as the most qualified team to write the next chapter in this exciting saga. You have been assigned to the ship's artifact chamber, a position critical for mission success. You will be rewarded with royalty shares for important discoveries, and a salary which can be used to buy tests in the artifact chamber.

Each player is assigned a secret goal at the beginning of the mission, which other players are not aware. Success is based upon reaching this goal. The player travels to different locations in space where artifacts are located. During expeditions, the player must monitor life support, temperature, radiation hazards, and finite ship energy.

As the ship travels between locations, it may encounter dangers including meteors, gravity warps, space sickness, and wormholes. Meteors must be shot with the onboard lasers using crosshairs. In a gravity warp, the player must position their ship within a series of moving boxes to avoid losing energy. Worm holes involve the player matching tones to survive the singularity.

Upon encountering an artifact, the player launces a probe to collect it. They must coordinate a tone and rotation to collect the probe. The player performs tests upon the artifact to determine its value and function. Artifacts can also be burned to increase a ship's energy if not valuable to the player. Artifacts can be returned to mission control for extra credits.

There are 3 levels of difficulty and 3 mission lengths.
title: The Argos Expedition

description:
Fleet Feet is a 1 - 2 player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

Beyond the stars, in a galaxy much like outs, the Spirits of Sportsdom have decreed a need for an intergalactic marathon. They named it Fleet Feet, for it was to be more of a race of swift thinking and fancy footwork. For eons, the best and brightest from every galaxy have met its unique challenge. Now it's your turn.

Players control a pair of sneakers that can move horizontally to 4 positions while also moving forwards and backwards on a never-ending conveyor belt of positions. Players try to pick up items on the screen as they approach. Players can compete by themselves, or in 2-player competitive games. There are 12 levels of difficulty, and the player can set track speed, laps per race, steps per lap, and track density.
title: Fleet Feet

description:
Light-Waves is a 1-player game for the Commodore 64.

Only you can control the energy flow of the network and return the light-rider to its energy source. The network is made up of energy beams. Energy flows through these beams, and the light-rider always follows the direction of energy. Some beams are red, and the player can flip the direction of the red beams to control the movement of the light-rider. The player moves a controller, and can flip all the beams in a specified row. The light-rider has a limited pool of energy, and each time an energy beam is flipper, energy is depleted.

The player can play randomized levels or selected designs.
title: Light-Waves

description:
Weather Tamers is a 1 - 4 player educational game for the Commodore 64.

The player is given a map of the United States and Southern Canada, and current atmospheric weather conditions. The player can chose to start during any time of the year. The player has limited credits, which are used to manipulate atmospheric conditions, including the location of high and low pressure zones, as well as the temperature, humidity, and pressure in specific zones. Each day, the player receives calls from clients asking for specific weather conditions over the next few days. The player must manipulate the weather for the clients, and receives additional credits if they achieve the correct weather.

There are 3 levels of difficulty, games can be 8, 16, or 30 days, and there can be 1 - 3 clients per rounds.

sample_screenshots.caption: At Least It's Cold in Winnipeg

title: Weather Tamers

description: Squash a Frog is a clone of Frogger for the C64. As in the original, it is the player's goal to guide a frog to his home across a busy street avoiding cars, followed by a river, hopping on turtles and tree logs to cross, taking care not to drown while also avoiding alligators. Five homes must be reached to complete a level. The game then restarts at a higher difficulty level.
title: Squash a Frog

description:
Six Sizzlers is a compilation of 6 games for the Commodore 64:

  • Big Trouble in Little China
  • Firetrap
  • Galactic Games
  • Labyrinth
  • Ninja
  • X-15 Alpha Mission
title: Six Sizzlers

description:
Trudie is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

Help a loin-cloth clad caveman save his girlfriend from a number of phallic-shaped monsters. The player controls a caveman who can move in all directions and fire forwards. The player moves between screens avoiding dancing fruit, giant mouths, and anthropomorphic penises. The player starts with 9 lives.
title: Trudie

description:
Night Moves is a compilation of 4 action games for the Commodore 64.

  • Midnight Resistance
  • Shadow Warriors
  • Sly Spy: Secret Agent
  • The Night Breed
title: Night Moves

description:
Hit Pak 5 is a compilation of the following games:

  • Airwolf
  • Bomb Jack
  • Commando
  • Frank Bruno's Boxing
  • Hazzard
title: Hit Pak 5

description:
Mario's Brewery is a 1-player clone of Donkey Kong for the Commodore 64.

Instead of trying to defeat Donkey Kong and rescue their girlfriend, the player instead must evade a rampaging drink machine. The player controls Mario, who can move laterally, climb ladders, and jump over dangers. The player has 3 lives, and loses a life when colliding with any danger.
title: Mario's Brewery

description:
Racing Simulation Games is a compilation of 2 racing games

  • Aqua Racer
  • Max Torque
title: Racing Simulation Games

description: A compilation title for the Commodore 64 containing Sargon II and Championship Golf.
title: Sargon II / Championship Golf

description:
Top Flight is a compilation of flight games for the Commodore 64.

Includes:

  • Infiltrator
  • Parallax
  • Top Gun
  • Trailblazer
  • Uridium
title: Top Flight

description:
Kick... Butt... & Slam! is a compilation of 5 action games for the Commodore 64.

Includes:

  • Bop 'n Wrestle
  • Fist: The Legend Continues
  • Rambo: First Blood Part II
  • Uchi Mata
  • Usagi Yojimbo
title: Kick... Butt... & Slam!

description:
Nautilus is an action game where the player controls a diver who is searching for gold that lies somewhere on the bottom of the ocean.
