description: 5x5 is a puzzle-board game, based on the TV show called "5 on the 5". The player's task is to guess a five letter password in five attempts. After typing each password, the game shows the result. A correctly guessed letter is highlighted with a dark background, the letter appearing in the password in a different position is highlighted in a green color.
title: 5x5

description: Achmed Caligula is a text-based adventure game. The control is done using a text menu, with the possibility of writing sentences manually. The player's health is described by the energy coefficient. The player can talk to the characters he meets, perform assigned tasks, buy and give items. Each chapter has a main quest, the completion of which determines the passage to the next stage of the adventure.
title: Achmed Caligula

description: Minotaur is a labyrinth game. The player can choose from 5 visual maze types and 5 character icons. Each maze is created based on the coefficients of the horizontal (5-19) and vertical (5-12) lines and is always different from each other. The game features a one or two player mode. In the two-player mode, there is an alternating and opposing mode. In the first mode, players alternately complete another maze; in the second mode, players complete the same maze - the shorter time score wins.
title: Minotaur

description: Kalambur is a quiz game. The player's task is to guess the words. The computer draws a word and mixes the letters in it. The player must arrange the letters before time runs out. The game has 5 stages, differing in the time of solving the task (120, 100, 80, 60, 30), the number of words (15, 15, 15, 10, 8) and the length of the words (from 4 to 10 letters).
title: Kalambur

description:
Cloud Strike is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

The player controls a small plane that moves in all directions, and can fire laterally left and right. The player can shoot incoming enemy vehicles, and tries to pick up falling pilots. The player must pick up 9 pilots to move to the next level with faster moving enemies. The player starts with 5 lives, and it's game over when all are lost.
title: Cloud Strike

description:
Math Magic is an educational math game for the Commodore 64.

Contains two educational math games:

  • Peter Piper Problems: Peter Piper is working in the pickle field, and the player must help solve questions involving his daily production and earnings. There are 3 levels of difficulty.

  • Weight Wizardry: Solve problems involving metric or standard English weights and measures.
title: Math Magic

description:
Krptar is a 1-player side-scrolling arcade game for the Commodore 64.

Endangered friends and neighbors in your land above the equator have had a tough time finding the secluded lair of some drug dealers living and working deep in the tropical jungle to the south. They have been raising forbidden plant life and concocting illegal brews. These terrible suppliers must be caught, and their deadly deeds stopped. As Principata of the cities in your country, you decide to man a "search and fight" helicopter. You quickly find the fields and manufacturing plants, but are besieged by protector ships.

Played from a side perspective, the player controls a helicopter than can move in all directions. The helicopter can fire straight to the right. Enemy vessels approach from the front and behind, and the player must destroy 8 enemy radar ships to advance to the next level. The player starts with 3 lives.
title: Krptar

description: Literax is a speed typing game. The rules of the game are simple. When a letter falls down, press its key before it reaches the floor. Every caught letter gives one point. The level of difficulty increases over time, speeding up the letters.
title: Literax

description: Battle Khaos is a strategic wargame for up to 4 players, based on Julian Gollop's "Chaos - the battle of wizards". The game allows to choose the number of players, sides of the conflict and the type of alliance. It is possible to play alone against other players or create alliances. The gameplay itself is turn-based, divided into spell choice and move phase. The only wizard or alliance left on the board wins the game.
title: Battle Khaos

description: Battle Khaos II is a multiplayer strategic wargame inspired by the games like Magic: The Gathering, Dark Legions and also Julian Gollop's Chaos - The Battle of Wizards. The goal is to kill the enemy wizards. It is done mainly by casting sorceries and also by summoning various creatures and sending them off to fight.
title: Battle Khaos II

description: 1917 is an arcade game set in Lenin's time. The player's task is to perform a series of tasks that will eventually lead to a communist revolution. As Lenin, the player must avoid or kill numerous assassins (with a gun with unlimited ammo) and mechanical traps.

Atak Sapera is a clone of Dyna Blaster. The player's task is to make a way through obstacles in order to eliminate the opponent before time runs out. The only weapons are bombs that explode vertically and horizontally from the point of explosion, destroying everything in their path.
title: Atak Sapera

description: Baffle is a puzzle game. The player's task is to recreate the arrangement of the numbers, letters or picture shown on the right. The board is 6x4 in size, with one empty window. An empty window is used to move a block one position. The time to solve the task is 3 minutes.
title: Baffle

description: Tajemniczy Zamek is a simple adventure game. In each location, a description of the situation is displayed with two choices. The player's selection is displayed on the screen. Depending on the choice, the player is moved to the next location. To learn the secrets of the castle, the player will travel through the lake, dungeon, chamber, encounter the devil Boruta and Basilisk.
title: Tajemniczy Zamek

description:
Wilk, Koza, Kapusta i Inne is a set of 4 games and demos. The games included are:

  • Wilk, Koza i Kapusta
  • Pole Minowe
  • Symulator Atari
  • Piętnastka
title: Wilk, Koza, Kapusta i Inne

description:
Balon, Kangur i Inne is a set of 5 logic games and 1 program (C64 Tester). The games included are:

  • Balon
  • Kangur
  • Omnibus
  • Polowanie na Litery
  • Super Penetrator
title: Balon, Kangur i Inne

description: bluBria is a puzzle game based on the idea of the game Memory. It allows to play up to 2 players on 3 sets of picture sets. The game consists of 56 pictures that need to be paired. Each pair gives a 5 point bonus. Guessing to pairs one after another gives access to the left bonus board, allowing extra points. No action at a designated time deducts half of the points.
title: bluBria

description: It's a modern conversion of Amaurote, released back in 1987. The game features enhanced graphics, audio and uses the 2MHz mode of the processor (off-screen), which provides a 30% increase in-game speed.
title: Amaurote

description: Captain Cactus is a side scrolling cave shooter. The player controls a helicopter and must avoid or destroy all incoming enemy vessels as well as cave top and bottom obstacles. One low range weapon is available. Enemies move in a similar wave pattern. The helicopter can move in each direction.
title: Captain Cactus

description: Catch me is a simple game for two players. Each player controls one ball. The task of the first player is to catch the second player in the allotted time. If he does, he gets a point. If player two manages to successfully escape for the specified amount of time, he wins.
title: Catch me

description: Asterocrash is a single screen simulation game, where the player controls asteroids in order to keep them on the board and avoid collisions. Controlling constantly moving asteroids requires changing the x and y coordinates, which are responsible for the direction of movement. If there are asteroids left on the board after the allotted time, money is awarded.
title: Asterocrash

description: Artris it a Tetris clone. The rules remain unchanged. Each time a line is laid, a part of the picture is revealed. With each complete unveiling, we move to the next level. The right panel shows the next brick, left one current score and number of lines to complete the task.
title: Artris

description: Arytmetyka is an educational program, allowing to learn basic math operations, such as addition, multiplication, subtraction or division. The game allows selecting the range of mathematical operations, displays the correct result and shows the current rating by moving the stick figure from 2 to 5.
title: Arytmetyka

description: Cheeseburger is an arcade game. The player's task is to drop the cheese on the burger insert. To do this, it is necessary to walk over the entire slice of cheese. Dropping cheese on burger inserts gives you points and extra power. Power is used to grant the character temporary invulnerability.
title: Cheeseburger

description: Cloux is a clone of Mine Sweeper. The player can set the number of mines - from 1 to 12 and the size of the board - from 3 to 20 fields horizontally and from 3 to 25 fields vertically. The rest of the rules remain the same. After pressing the field, a number with the number of bombs in the vicinity is displayed. Hitting the bomb ends the game.
title: Cloux

description: Łapacz Liter: Gra dla Szybkich is a speed typing game. The rules of the game are simple. When a letter breaks off, press its key as quickly as possible. The faster you react, the more points. The level of difficulty increases over time.
title: Łapacz Liter: Gra dla Szybkich

description: Piratek is a text based adventure game. As a pirate wanted by the authorities, the player travels the sea, fighting the ships and visiting cities. The ship is described by three coefficients: cargo, resistance, and speed. Resistance and speed are factors that determine the outcome of duels with other ships, cargo is intended for storing goods and cannons. In the city, the player can sell goods and cannons and upgrade the ship (additional sails, hull enlargement, hull reinforcement) by paying gold. Upgrades affect ship stats. When leaving the city, the captain chooses one of the four nearest cities as the destination for his further journey.
title: Piratek

description: Dreptacz is a game where the player must cover all the squares using the indicated number of moves (number) before time runs out (red indicator). Moving the character requires speed and precision, going off track means game over.
title: Dreptacz

description: Core Wars: Warriors Editor is a simulation inspired by the article Computer Recreations written by A. K. Dewdney, back in May 1984, telling about the game called Core War, where hostile programs engage in a battle of bits. It is a programming game in which two programs run in a simulated computer with the goal of terminating opponent. Once the game is started the player watch the code overwriting all the memory.
title: Core Wars: Warriors Editor

description: Egzamin na Prawo Jazdy is an educational game, examining traffic rules. The game features 13 sets of tests. Each set requires solving 30 questions, with 3 multiple answer possibilities. The answer to each question must be validated before time runs out. After completing the test, a final score is issued.
title: Egzamin na Prawo Jazdy

description: Extend is a Snake variant. The player has to guide a snake through a board. The player must feed the snake with the randomly appearing digits to score points, however feeding the snake makes it grow longer. The higher number, the more points he receives. Number decreasing with time, vanishing after reaching 0.
title: Extend

description:
Interview is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

Dear Applicant: You are requested to attend an interview with "Front Runner" for the position of chief programmer. Please be at our head office within 15 minutes.

Gameplay is divided into 2 arcade sequences. In the first section the player must reach the bank to withdraw money to purchase a suit. During this sequence the player walks along a sidewalk, and moves left and right, accelerates, or decelerates, to avoid manhole covers, banana peels, dogs crossing the road, trash cans, and falling flower pots. Every obstacle they hit costs the interviewee time.

After reaching the bank, gameplay enters an overhead perspective in a large scrolling city map. The player must find their way to the tailor to buy a suit, the cleaners to get it cleaned, and finally arrive at the interview at the office. The player must avoid cars, dogs, other pedestrians, and open sewers. Every obstacle hit costs time. If the player reaches the interview within 15 minutes clean and presentable they get the job.
title: Interview

description: Koło Fortuny is a simplified game loosely based on the TV show Wheel of Fortune. The players take turns guessing letters to form a word or a saying. The game can be played with up to three human players. During their turn, the players guess a letter until the password is completed. The game has build in password editor.
title: Koło Fortuny

description: Kółko i Krzyżyk: O i X is an adaptation of tic-tac-toe, played versus the computer. The rules remain unchanged. At the beginning, the player chooses the starting side of the match. On their turn, players choose the location of their symbol using a number from 1 to 9. The winner is the one who places 3 symbols in a row.
title: Kółko i Krzyżyk: O i X

description: Starchock is a text-based managerial game, where the player's task is an oil baron and his goal is to earn the indicated amount of money in the shortest possible time. The game takes place in monthly turns, during which the player makes decisions, pays the costs of extracting the shaft, faces random events, looks for new deposits and opens or closes gas wells.
title: Starchock

description: Game #23 is a simple duel space shooter game. The game is designed for two players who stand opposite each other and start a stellar duel. Fighters are equipped with an anti-gravity engine and rocket launchers. The engine is used to stop the descent caused by gravity. The first hit of an opponent or a collision with the ground ends the duel.
title: Game #23

description:
Murder on the Waterfront is a text adventure with graphics for the Commodore 64.

The sweet young daughter of Edward Harrington Mountford III had been kidnapped. A note demanding $500,000 has been received. A deadline of midnight has been set for the ransom to be delivered to a deserted warehouse on the docks of 52nd street. It was signed by the infamous Mad Murphy, head of the Irish Gang. You, Basil Byron, have been hired to rescue sweet young Mary. If you are successful the ransom is yours.

All commands are via VERB NOUN input, and locations are graphically displayed on the screen. The player must explore the seedy underworld near the docks, and can enter a number of local establishments. Most mistakes are fatal. Games can be saved in progress.

sample_screenshots.caption: On the Roof of a Factory

title: Murder on the Waterfront

description:
Ninja is a text adventure with graphics for the Commodore 64.

Many centuries ago, the Grey Ninja stole the Statue of Jozen away from their arch enemies, the Kabuto Ninjas, and installed in the Temple of Sharloon. Over the years many attempts were made to return the statue, but to no avail. Now, you have been chose to try where all others have failed. Your only assistance is a clue said to be hidden in a poem written in the fifth century by the poet Shimoto. Now, as you enter the dark Dragon Head Forest deep within Grey Ninja territory, you wonder if you made the correct decision.

All commands are via VERB NOUN input, and locations are graphically displayed on the screen. The player must explore the nearby forests and the Grey Ninja temple. Games can be saved in progress.
title: Ninja

description:
Alien is a text adventure with graphics for the Commodore 64.

Sir Roderick Lotabucks has offered a reward for substantial proof that UFOs are in fact a reality. The offer is open for thirty days.

You as Dr. Jason Stargazer, famed astronomer, have decided to take up the offer. After all, a man of your background, training, and scientific knowledge should easily be able to prove UFOs exist. Besides, you need the money. Following your research, you have discovered a center of UFO activity around the Little Wolf Crater in the Arizona desert.

All commands are via VERB NOUN input, and locations are graphically displayed on the screen. The player must explore the Arizona desert in search of proof of aliens. Games can be saved in progress.
title: Alien

description:
The Search for King Solomon's Mines: Part 1 is an adventure game with graphics for the Commodore 64.

Africa 1903: A dying adventurer staggers from the jungle raving about 7 foot tall natives, ice and snow, a searing volcano and... a cache of treasure fit for a king.

At the start of the adventure, the player can pick 5 supplies from: a rifle, torch, compass, pick, binoculars, rations, knife, beads, medicines, canteen, matches, and rope.

There are 3 levels of puzzle difficulty and danger. All commands are via VERB NOUN input, and locations are graphically displayed on the screen. The player must explore the jungle in search of King Solomon's treasure. Games can be saved in progress.
title: The Search for King Solomon's Mines: Part 1

description:
Cyberworld is an adventure game with arcade elements for the Commodore 64.

Welcome to the year 2814. The development of vessels capable of traveling faster than the speed of light has enabled man to begin the exploration and colonization of the near galaxies. Earth, the ancient home planet, her blue seas poisoned and the green forests ravaged in the long ago Andromedan Wards, has been abandoned. Human leaders, with the help of friendly aliens, have united the various peoples into a new one-council league, the Cyberleague, to defend them.

The player controls a small character that can move in all directions to explore a number of rooms, and move between areas. The player must avoid enemies or fire at them if the player is armed with a laser.

In each room, the player can examine the area, take or pick up objects, search the room, or use an item from their inventory. Items are displayed as numbers, and the player must move towards items to pick them up.

A map of explored areas is displayed at the top of the screen. The player can choose 10 levels of difficulty, and game play is divided into several different missions.
title: Cyberworld

description:
Star League Baseball and On-Field Football is a compilation of 2 previously released Commodore 64 sports titles. It contains:

  • On-Field Football
  • Star League Baseball
title: Star League Baseball and On-Field Football

description:
Perplexian Challenger is a 1 - 4 player arcade space shooter for the Commodore 64.

Played from a 1st person perspective, the player controls a star fighter and has to destroy incoming alien vessels. Alien ships appear two at a time, and the player controls the direction of their fire to destroy incoming vessels. As the player takes damage and fights enemies their shields, lasers, and fuel are depleted. Destroyed vessels may leave pods which help recharge the player's energy if collected.

Each player begins with a fleet of four fighters. After every 1000 points, an additional fighter and eight points are awarded. There are 4 levels of difficulty.
title: Perplexian Challenger

description: It's an educational program for learning English, where the player can choose one of two tasks to solve. In the first, one you have to choose one of the four words that are equivalent in the second language before the time runs out. In the second, it is necessary to write the correct translation by hand. After completing the entire set of tasks, a grade is issued. The player can choose the number of questions, the time to answer and which language will be translated.
title: Program Edukacyjny w Pigułce: Język Angielski

description: It is an educational program in which the player must solve tests in various fields of geography by indicating one of the 3 or 8 available answers - depending on the field of geography. After doing all the tasks, a grade is issued. In addition to tests, the program also includes a second part with theory.
title: Program Edukacyjny w Pigułce: Geografia

description: This is an educational program that teaches basic mathematical operations and operations with fractions. The test contains 3 levels of difficulty, and each task is evaluated according to the speed of its solution. After solving all tasks, the final grade is displayed. In the case of more advanced operations, the program shows how to calculate them using several examples.
title: Program Edukacyjny w Pigułce: Matematyka

description: Życie Maklera is a text based economic game. As a mine owner the player must keep as long as possible owned assets. The player may trade mines, sell ore and pay miners wages. Each mine requires ten employed miners. Miners payment affects the level of life and therefore the size of ore extraction. Every year the price of mine, ore and food is changing. Proper use of price trends is the key to wealth multiplication.
title: Życie Maklera

description: Mini-Penetrator is a side-scrolling shooter. Using missiles and bombs, the player must destroy air and ground objects on the way to the main base of the enemy. The fuel may be supplemented by hitting the ground containers. Controlled fighter may be moved in any direction.
title: Mini-Penetrator

description: Księżyc 2097 is a text adventure game. A spacecraft orbiting the planet Uranus' moon Karel crashed and crashed to the surface. The player is the only survivor of the crash. His task is to find the ship and save secret documents.The control is done by selecting one of several available options. Each location contains a description and several possibilities. The player must also remember about food so as not to die of hunger during the adventure.
title: Księżyc 2097

description: Section Pi is a side scrolling sci-fi shooter. The player moves the ship to the right and has the task of shooting down or avoiding enemy units, avoiding hitting the upper and lower limits of the tunnel. At the end of each stage there is a final boss.
title: Section Pi

description: The Exel’s Kirby is a simple platform game consisting 3 levels. The player's task is to collect all the balls from the board, avoiding monsters that move in a predetermined way.
title: The Exel’s Kirby

description:
It is a turn-based strategy game based on decision-making, where our task is to play the role of Rudolf Höss and supervise the construction of the title concentration camp. The currency in the game is German marks, which the player can spend on the construction of barracks, crematoria or gas chambers, or on the recruitment of prisoners. At the end of the turn, the player determines how much food the workers will receive. For too many dead prisoners and the need to bury corpses in the forest, high fines must be paid. The game contains numerous random events. The game includes numerous random events.

The game is unwinnable - it ends with a slightly alternative version of history - the camp is liberated on January 27, 1945, and Rudolf Höss is hanged for his crimes without waiting for the Nuremberg trials.
title: Oświęcim

description: ABC Wiedzy is an educational game that tests knowledge in several fields of science. Each field has a different number of questions, some are answered by selecting one of several options, some have to be answered manually. After the last question, the final grade is displayed.
title: ABC Wiedzy

description: Lemon-Man is a business game where the player's goal is to earn money by selling lemonade. Each turn, the player decides how much lemonade powder, sugar and cups to buy. After reading the current weather information in the newspaper, determine the selling price. Sale takes place in weekly cycles and depends on the weather and the price of lemonade.
title: Lemon-Man

description: Wojny Rdzeniowe is a simulation inspired by the article Computer Recreations written by A. K. Dewdney, back in May 1984, telling about the game called Core War, where hostile programs engage in a battle of bits. It is a programming game in which two programs run in a simulated computer with the goal of terminating opponent. Once the game is started the player watch the code overwriting all the memory.
title: Wojny Rdzeniowe

description:
It's Year 2048. Pollution of Earth caused by people is still increasing. The World Environment Federation decided to start scientific research to save the planet. A huge laboratory was built on the Moon. However, the computer system failed. The Oxygen left just for a few days. The best pilot must rescue all scientists.

The player controls the rescue ship. Movement is carried out using gravitational motors. Starting the engines causes the ship to constantly move at the speed set by the pilot. It is necessary to efficiently maneuver or slow down the ship in turns, because hitting the wall of the base means breaking the ship. When releasing the ship, the player must remember about the passing of time.
title: Lost

description: This is another clone of the classic Tetris. The rules remain the same. The player must place a full line of blocks to remove them from the well. The game has a built-in single player mode and two players - cooperation and competition. It is also possible to play in an inverted well, where the blocks move from bottom to top.
title: Powertris

description: This is another clone of the classic Tetris. The rules have been modified. The player's task is to prevent the well from filling up by combining blocks of the same color and pattern. The player must stack the blocks until the number on the information panel drops to zero. Points are deducted for the number of blocks falling and blocks removed from the well.
title: Orbits

description: This is a logic game, where the player must arrange the same cube pattern as in the second picture by moving the horizontal and vertical columns accordingly. Columns move in their entirety one space. The pattern must be completed within the allotted time.
title: Logic

description: Fuitmania is an arcade game. The player's task is to collect all the fruits from the board and reach the exit before time runs out. Monsters move only on a beaten path. You can drop heavy objects on them or shoot them. The remaining time on the counter is converted into bonus points.
title: Fruitmania

description: The Birds is a 2D side scrolling arcade game. The player controls the bird and is tasked with reaching the end of the board. The bird can move in any direction and shoot at incoming enemies. The game contains 3 levels.
title: The Birds

description: Bussines is a text-based strategy game where the player commands a country. Management includes trade, production, resource extraction and army building. The game contains random events. After building the appropriate army, the player must conquer 10 neighboring countries.
title: Bussines

description: Komputerowe Koło Fortuny is a game loosely based on the TV show Wheel of Fortune. The players take turns guessing letters to form a word or a saying. The game can be played with up to three players. During their turn the players can spin the wheel, guess a consonant, buy a vowel or guess the password.
title: Komputerowe Koło Fortuny

description: Fajowa Gra is a text adventure game. The story starts in a sewers, where the player was imprisoned for killing the king. After getting out of seclusion, a crazy adventure begins, which consists of many well-known, mixed-up stories.
title: Fajowa Gra

description: Miasto is a strategic text game where the player is tasked with managing a city. Management includes building houses, workshops, parks, gas stations, shops, trading currencies, providing food to residents, and collecting rent. The game includes a graphic element in the form of city visualization.
title: Miasto

description: Makler is a text based economy game. The player's task is to trade on the stock exchange, combined with the production and sale of products of various quality, in order to shape supply and demand, affecting the exchange rates.
title: Makler

description: Magazine is a logic game. As a warehouseman, the player's task is to place all the crates in the designated place. Chests can only be moved forward, so you have to be careful not to block access to them. Each level has a certain amount of time to complete the mission.
title: Magazine

description: Nodule is an arcade game set in 2519 Year. Nodule, the guardian of the Galaxy, was on duty when an unknown strange power transported him to another time. While warping, his patrol ship was damaged and crashed on the unknown planet Alpha-X. Pilot must reach a mysterious magical place where there are olo runes that take him back to his reality. The way to the goal leads through a maze of obstacles that must be avoided, being careful of moving hostile creatures that can be shot.
title: Nodule

description: Rolnik is a strategy game where the player takes on the role of a farmer. The player's task is to run a farm, including the cultivation of cereals and vegetables, animal husbandry, the purchase of land for cultivation, pastures and stables for animals, and agricultural equipment. Produced goods can be sold at the end of each turn.
title: Rolnik

description: Vin Tim is a words guessing game. Player have five attempts to guess a five-letter word. The first letter is revealed, the guessed letter remains on the board. Each attempt lasts 10 seconds.
title: Vin Tim

description: Tetrisack is a clone of Tetris. The rules of the game remain the same - the player's task is to arrange the blocks in the well. A full row of blocks removes them from the board. The screen is divided into two windows for two players. When playing against the computer, you can choose one of three difficulty levels.
title: Tetrisack

description: Rex is a platform game.
title: Rex

description: Just a Game 1 is a simple Saper variant. The game allows to select size of the board (up to 38x20) and number of bombs (up to 255). Depending on the choice made, the player has a certain number of bomb markers on the board. After selecting a field, the number of bombs in the vicinity is marked. One mistake ends the game.
title: Just a Game 1

description: Seria Edukacyjna: Chemia is an educational game that tests knowledge in several fields of chemistry. Each field has a different number of questions, some are answered by selecting one of several options, some have to be answered manually. After the last question, the final grade is displayed. The program also contains a large amount of theories and curiosities in the field of chemistry.
title: Seria Edukacyjna: Chemia

description: Seria Edukacyjna: Matematyka is an educational program for learning the basics of mathematics. It contains theory, examples and tests in several basic areas of mathematics from the early years of primary school.
title: Seria Edukacyjna: Matematyka

description: Seria Edukacyjna: Język Polski is an educational program that teaches the basics of reading and writing. The program includes various tasks, both graphical and textual, such as writing by ear, spelling test, pointing to the right letters. The author also included many elements of reading and writing theory, including sentence construction and spelling rules.

sample_screenshots.caption: The car ran over the dog

title: Seria Edukacyjna: Język Polski

description: Seria Edukacyjna: Historia is an educational program for learning history. The program is divided into parts containing theory and tests. The tests have a different number of questions, their solution requires choosing one of several answers or entering the answers manually. After completing the test, a grade is issued.
title: Seria Edukacyjna: Historia

description: Aviator is a side-scrolling shooter. The player flies a fighter in an open area and must shoot at all enemies that appear. Outside of planes, the pilot should be careful of bunkers on land. At the end of each level, a mothership awaits.
title: Aviator

description: Sześciany is a puzzle game based on the correct arrangement of cubes. The player's task is to arrange the cube in such a way that the three visible faces have the same color. The cube moves in the same way as the Rubik's cube - the whole column or row moves at the same time.
title: Sześciany

description: Fortuna kołem się toczy is a game based on the TV show Wheel of Fortune. The players take turns guessing letters to form a word or a saying. The game can be played with up to three human players. During their turn the players can spin the wheel, guess a consonant, buy a vowel or guess the password. Each turn lasts 10 seconds. In the final, after drawing an envelope and providing additional letters, the player has 20 seconds to guess the password.
title: Fortuna kołem się toczy

description: Odgadywanka is a simple game where the player's task is to guess the number drawn by the computer. At the beginning, the player indicates the upper numerical range, and the computer, after indicating the number, informs whether it is too high or too low.
title: Odgadywanka

description: Powietrzny Pojedynek is a text mode game featuring a duel between Polish and German pilots. In each mission, the player has three portions of ammunition at his disposal. The first player to shoot down the enemy plane wins. At the end of the duel, the player receives points and a military rank.
title: Powietrzny Pojedynek

description: Zapy is a puzzle game designed for two players. The player who loses the coin toss starts the game. There are 16 matches on the table - 7 in the first row, 5, 3, 1 in the next rows. The task of the players is to collect matches from the table in such a way that the last one is left for the opponent.
title: Zapy

description: Zgadywanka is a puzzle game where the task of the computer is to guess the number indicated by the player. The player sets the maximum number range and indicates whether the number is too high or too low.
title: Zgadywanka

description: Plaga Pająków is a simple screen action game. A spider descends from the ceiling on a cobweb. The player's task is to catch it in the container before it reaches the floor. After catching a spider, another one appears in a different place, if you don't catch it, you lose some energy.
title: Plaga Pająków

description: Sumowanka is a simple logic game. The computer creates an 8x8 board and fills it with numbers from 1 to 99. The player chooses a number in the column and the computer in the same row. The object of the game is to select numbers in such a way that you end up having more of them than your opponent. The game ends if any player can no longer choose any number or the last number on the board is selected.
title: Sumowanka

description: There is a small ship at the bottom of the screen. Diamonds appear at the top of the screen. The player must position the ship so that it destroys the diamonds when fired. Simultaneously with the execution of the shot, a new diamond appears on the board in a random place.

sample_screenshots.caption: every time you missed, 1 extra diamond on the board

title: Game No Name

description: Magiczne Pole is a turn-based puzzle game against the computer. Opponents take turns entering numbers in a selected place on the 3x3 board to reach a sum of 15 in a column or in a row. The player first gives the position, then the number, separated by a comma.
title: Magiczne Pole

description: Podmianka is a puzzle game. The computer gives 7 numbers in random order, which should be arranged from the smallest to the largest. The player indicates the number to be replaced with the number in the first position. The goal is to line up the numbers in as few moves as possible.
title: Podmianka

description: Labirynt is a simple game, where the computer generates a maze of size 2 to 19 in width and 2 to 12 in length. After passing the maze, the passage time is displayed.
title: Labirynt

description: Ferma is a text-based game. The player manages a farm and owns chickens, pigs, rabbits and eggs. Each turn must decide whether to sell some animals, buy food and sell eggs. With the money earned, the player can buy more animals or food. The game contains random events.
title: Ferma

description: Wisielec is a word-guessing game based on Hangman. To save the life the player has to guess the password. The player may choose each of the letters (consonants and vowels), wrong answer means the loss of one point and ends up drawing a part of a hanged man. Good answer gives one point. .
title: Wisielec

description: Helikopter is a game where luck is the deciding factor. The player moves in a helicopter on a 10x10 board. At the same time, the computer shoots at a randomly selected field. For each missed shot, the player scores a point. A hit means the end of the game.
title: Helikopter

description: Sumowanka Bis is a simple logic game. The computer creates an 8x8 board and fills it with numbers from 1 to 99. The player chooses a number in the column and the computer in the same row. The object of the game is to select numbers in such a way that you end up having more of them than your opponent. The game ends if any player can no longer choose any number or the last number on the board is selected. The game includes match and tournament modes and allows you to choose the difficulty level.
title: Sumowanka Bis

description: Saper is a clone of classic Minesweeper. The gameplay rules remain unchanged. Selected spot shows the number of bombs in the neighborhood. The detected mine may be marked. The game allows to select one of three available difficulty levels.
title: Saper

description:
Computer Mastermind is a 2-player strategy board game for the Commodore 64.

The player tries to guess a hidden password. Each turn they are told the number of pieces that are correct, and the number that are in the correct position. Codes can be 3 - 6 characters long, and each position can have 3 - 9 different possible characters. Duplication can be permitted or forbidden in the code, and timed games are available. Each player gets up to 8 guesses to solve the puzzle.
title: Computer Mastermind

description: Test czytania teaches the basics of reading/writing. After turning on the program, a word appears on the screen for a short time, which the player must remember and rewrite on the keyboard. Completing the task correctly means extra points.
title: Test Czytania

description: Mikołaj it's an arcade game. The player's task is to deliver as many gifts as possible to the children. Children waiting in apartments are very impatient. The color displayed in the windows determines the waiting time for gifts. When a child loses hope of receiving a gift, the yellow color lights up, which means the end of the game. Presents are thrown down the chimney.
title: Mikołaj

description: Życie simulates the emergence and disappearance of population organisms. Any organism surrounded by two or three other organisms will survive. Four or more organisms nearby, or the absence of them, degrades the organism. In an empty cell surrounded by three organisms, a new life arises.
title: Życie

description: Life is life simulates the growth of bacterial colonies. At the beginning, the player establishes a colony of bacteria, and then watches them multiply and die. Different colors of bacteria mean different species. While observing the simulation, the player can go to the editing stage at any time and make any changes to the bacterial colony.
title: Life is life

description: Life v1.0 simulates the growth of bacterial colonies. At the beginning, the player establishes a colony of bacteria, and then watches them multiply and die. While observing the simulation, the player can go to the editing stage at any time and make any changes to the bacterial colony.
title: Life v1.0

description: Mastermind is a puzzle game. The player must place 3 missing rectangles with missing numbers on the board. The board is divided into 24 fields. There is a time limit for providing the correct solution. The player can only make 3 adjustments to the alignment.
title: Mastermind

description: Ping is another Pong conversion. Players have paddles that bounce the ball. The game ends when one of the players reaches 15 points.
title: Ping

description: Mountainraid is a simple arcade game. The player's task is to drive the vehicle along the winding mountain roads. Going downhill causes a constant increase in speed. The best result is saved as High Score.
title: Mountainraid

description: This is a game for two players. The task of each of them is to select the moment of the shot in such a way as to shoot down the passing object of the opponent - an airplane, a helicopter or a rocket. Only one projectile can be fired at a time. The first player to score 21 points wins.
title: Nalot

description: The game consists of two rounds. At the beginning, the player gives the amount of time to make each move. If the player does not make a move within the allotted time, the computer makes 10 random moves that make it difficult to solve the cube. In the first round, the screen is divided into 24 white squares. The computer turns the white squares colored. By changing colors in a row or column, the player must turn all squares white. In the second round, the rules are more complicated by different rules for changing colors on the board.
title: Kolorowa Zabawa

description: This is a kind of C64 programmer's prank on Atari users. The author wanted to show what Atari games will look like in 2043. In fact, the game contains four variants of Pong: tennis, wall, hockey, football.
title: Symulator Atari

description: Gemmania is a puzzle-board game. The player has to change all the green circles to the red ones. A selected circle changes the color to the opposite, along with the four adjacent circles (top, down, left, right). A black red changes color to green, and green circle to red. There is no limit of moves allowed
title: Gemmania

description:
Silly 64 contains several bizarre programs for the Commodore 64.

  • Annoying Repetitious Message: Repeatedly displays the users message on the screen, filling the entire page.
  • Reality: Leaves the program
  • Silly Crisis: The Commodore 64 begins to regret its life decisions.
  • Silly Data: The program creates a number of different graphs to display completely frivolous data.
  • Silly Poem: The program takes the player's choices to a number of questions and creates a number of randomized poems.
title: Silly 64

description:
First Strike is a 1-player strategy game for the Commodore 64.

A game of political and strategic warfare, the player acts as the President of the United States, and has complete control over military decisions, as well as domestic and international affairs. The President must choose between the difficult path of stabilizing a nuclear arms race, or wining a full-scale nuclear war.

Played in 3 month turns, the player will serve a 4 year term in office plus an additional term if they win reelection. Reelection is based upon factors including campaign funds and national support.
title: First Strike

description:
Galactic Frontier is an adventure game for the Commodore 64.

The explorer searches for life forms among the 200 billions stars in the Milky Way. Blasting off from Earth, the player can visit numerous star systems, which include randomly generated star types. Star data including spectral class, luminosity, type, diameter, temperature, and age can be explored. These star systems may have planets, and planet data including color, chemical analysis, length of year, length of day, and more can be investigated. Ultimately, the goal is to find habitable planets that may contain types of life. Stars and planets are graphically displayed on the screen as they are discovered.
title: Galactic Frontier

description:
Micro Painter is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

The player moves along the lines of a 6 x 5 graph, and tries to color in all of the squares by moving around the 4 sides of a square. The player can only highlight a single square at a time, and can not backtrack. The player must avoid 4 enemies that randomly follow along the lines of the graph. The goal is the color all squares in the minimal amount of time. If they run out of time or are attacked by an enemy, it's game over.
title: Micro Painter

description:
Ronald Rubberduck is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

The player controls Ronald, a bubble shooting duck, who tries to navigate a number of dangerous stages to reach the exit door. Ronald can swim in all directions and fire horizontally while underwater. While flying, gravity constantly pulls Ronald down, and he must flap to stay airborn. Ronald can fire directly downwards while flying, and he has a total of 9 bubbles per level. The player must shoot the switch on each level to open the exit door. Dangers include jumping frogs, swimming octopi, and flying birds. If the player touches any obstacle they lose a life and must restart the stage. The player starts with 5 lives.
title: Ronald Rubberduck

description:
Operation Anoria is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

It seems an act of interstellar piracy has gone wrong, and the player finds themselves stranded on the surface of a dangerous alien planet. The player controls a character who can jump vertically and at 45 degree angles with the help of their jetpack, and can fire straight forwards. The player travels through different rooms, and can take, drop, use, or wear the items they discover. The player has limited energy, which is drained by contacting enemies, and slowly drains away with time. Enemies appear rapidly from the edges of the screen, and can be shot or avoided. Energy can be restored, but the player has a limited number of days to complete their escape.
title: Operation Anoria

description:
Base 3 is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64

The player controls a spaceship that moves in all directions, and fires two streams of lasers directly forwards. Enemy ships and structures fly towards the player from the top of the screen. Some enemy vessels are stationary and fire in multiple directions, while others rapidly race towards the player. There is a single large level with multiple enemies that scrolls past, at which point the player receives a congratulations message and restarts the level. If the ship is hit by enemy fire or vessels it's lost, and the player starts with 5 ships.
title: Base 3

description: Dark Tower / Invaders of the Lost Tomb is a compilation of two previously released games for the Commodore 64.
title: Dark Tower / Invaders of the Lost Tomb

description:
Duel Attack is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

The player controls a plane that moves in all directions, and fires two streams of bullets directly forwards. Enemy planes and helicopters take off and launch towards the player. Tanks drive across fields and fire, while ships move along ocean sections firing directly forwards. Immobile anti-aircraft also pose danger. There is a single large level divided into two sections with multiple enemies that scrolls past, at which point the level restarts. If the ship is hit by enemy fire or vessels it's lost, and the player starts with 3 ships.

sample_screenshots.caption: Nearing the End of the Mission

title: Duel Attack

description:
KGB Agent is a horizontal scrolling arcade game for the Commodore 64.

Ilya Ilyavanovik, the renowned agent of the KGB, has been tasked by his superior Farenov Gherkinski to track down their arch enemy supper yuppie Alexander Sharamski. Sharamski has made off with millions of rubles worth of Eastern Block armaments, and plans to sell the to Mad Martinov, the Western arms dealer. They plan to launch a budget range of tactical weapons, hence undercutting world profits and harming Soviet profits. Ilya will be landed on the roof of their arms depot, and must descend through levels of dangerous guards and automated security.
title: KGB Agent

description:
SS Panzer is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

The player controls a tank that moves in all directions, and fires a stream of bullets directly forwards. The tank can move and fire straight forwards, sideways, and at 45 degree angles. Enemy turrets, planes, tanks, helicopters, and battleships pose dangers to the tank. Terrain includes enemy bases, bridges, grasslands, islands, and even minefields. There is a single large level that loops after being completed. There are also large boss helicopters, which prevent the tank from moving forwards until destroyed. If the ship is hit by enemy fire or vessels it's lost, and the player starts with 3 ships.
title: SS Panzer

description:
Broderbund Games Pack 3 is a compilation of 2 previously released Broderbund games for the Commodore 64.

  • Championship Lode Runner
  • The Mask of the Sun
title: Broderbund Games Pack 3

description:
Stargate is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

The player controls a lander that has been released from the mothership for a special mission. The mission is to land at a fuel stop on a deserted planet, to see if the beings who used to live there have left any automated defence systems behind. Unfortunately, before the player can land they have to pass through a stargate to make the fuel stop appear. To make sure that there are no automated defense systems, the player will have to go through the stargate 10 times before the mothership appears. When the mothership appears, the player will have to land in the docking bay to allow the crew to rest.
title: Stargate

description: Penetrator / Star Trooper is a compilation of two previously released games for the Commodore 64.
title: Penetrator / Star Trooper

description: Imagination / Seabase Delta is a two disk pack containing the games Imagination and Seabase Delta from Firebird Software.
title: Imagination / Seabase Delta

description:
Maze-Raze!!! is a 1 - 2 player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

The object of this game is to race the computer, or another player, to the center of a symmetrical maze.
title: Maze-Raze!!!

description: Booty/ Harvey Headbanger is a compilation of two previously released games for the Commodore 64.
title: Booty / Harvey Headbanger

description:
You control a helicopter in order to find 30 keys scattered in the vast maze and rescue the captives from the caches your enemies have imprisoned them. There are four types of characters who will be helpful on a way to accomplish the mission. Each character has its own color and the player needs to pick them up and deliver to correct houses with a corresponding flag waving on the roof. The characters will reward the player for bringing them home: pink ones will provide a key, eight yellow ones will give an extra life, blinking ones will give assist in order to recover unreachable keys.

The helicopter can have up to four characters on board.

sample_screenshots.caption: The captives are often on a very secluded places.
This is the house where the player is supposed to deliver the captives.
This is where the game starts.

title: Heli Rescue

description:
Starace is a 1-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

The player controls a spaceship that moves in all directions and fires directly forwards. The player starts with 5 lives. Game play is divided into 5 separate galaxies, each with a different challenge: Galaxy 1: There are 3 alien space ships that are protected by Federations rules, and the player's quark lazer is disabled. The player must navigate their ship to avoid the 3 aliens vessels which continuously chase the player. Galaxy 2: The galaxy is filled with asteroids and stray fireballs, and the player must avoid these. The ship's lazers will not destroy these. Galaxy 3: This galaxy has a high gravitational pull, and the player's mothership has been called to transport the player. The player must navigate their ship into a tractor beam, which slowly pulls the player's ship vertically, but the ship descends when not in the beam. Galaxy 4: The player confronts the alien mothership, which shoots a stream of missiles vertically downwards. The player must shoot it 20 times, and the enemy ship speeds up each time it's hit.
*Galaxy 5: The player's ship must land on the alien planet. Gravity pulls the ship downwards, and thrusters can be used to assist against gravity. The player must avoid horizontally moving obstacles.
title: Starace

description:
Aqua is a 2-player arcade game for the Commodore 64.

Each player controls a diver that tries to collect pearls from the bottom of the ocean. The divers move laterally, can drop down between platforms, and can jump up to higher platforms above. Platforms move laterally across the screen, and the player has limited oxygen, and must return to their starting vessel when oxygen runs low. Various denizens of the deep provide additional danger. When all pearls are collected the screen refills. Each player has 3 lives, and when all lives are lost the game ends, and the player with the highest score wins.
title: Aqua

description:
Hopto / Ice Palace is a compilation title including the previously released Ice Palace and Hopto, a rebranding of Quari, which is an adaptation of the arcade game Bongo.

In Hopto, the player aims to capture the dinosaur of Alvima, whose lair is deep within the bowels of a huge mountain. The player can move laterally and jump, and must move through a series of 27 dark and dangerous caverns. On each level the player must collect a bonus item and reach the right side of the screen from the left. They must stay ahead of the purple dinosaur that chases them, jump over bubbling pits, avoid falling rocks, and evade venomous bats and deadly spiders. On the final level, the player must trap the dinosaur with a cage.

In Ice Palace, the player is on a quest to retrieve their dead Father's crown to help destroy the evil Ice Queen and remove eternal darkness from the land. The player must navigate around the Ice Palace to find the seven pieces of the crown over seven levels. The player must use objects to solve puzzles. The game is an arcade adventure and contains two screens, the Action Screen and the Adventure Screen.
title: Hopto / Ice Palace

description:
Starforce Fighter is a horizontally scrolling space shooter for the Commodore 64.

The player controls a space fighter that moves in all directions and fires to the right. Each level is divided into 3 sections. First, the player encounters multiple waves of enemy vessels that approach from the right. These must be eliminated or avoided. Powerups can be collected, which temporarily speed up or slow down enemy movement, make the player invisible, or boost firepower. After clearing numerous waves, the player enters a second section that involves avoiding incoming asteroids. Finally, the player enters a bonus stage where they try to collect power ups. After each level, the player enters a more challenging area with faster moving enemies and addition structures and dangers to avoid. The player starts with 9 ships.

sample_screenshots.caption: Barriers to Avoid in the Bonus Zone

title: Starforce Fighter

description: Gerry the Germ / Microcosm is a compilation title containg the two previously released titles.
title: Gerry the Germ / Microcosm

description:
40 Educational Games for the Commodore 64 is a collection of type in BASIC games for the Commodore 64.

  • Addition and Subtraction: Answer randomized addition and subtraction questions.
  • Anagram: Correctly spell a word from letters scattered on the screen.
  • Area Estimation: Guess how many small boxes can fit within the displayed larger box.
  • Areas: Work out the total area of a rectangle and triangle.
  • Balance: Create a balancing weight using specific sizes.
  • Bar Chart: Creates a bar chart based upon values inputted.
  • Chemist: Work out the ratio of fluid required to make a solution stable.
  • Compass: The player must describe which direction they are moving.
  • Constellations: Type the name of a constellation based upon its shape.
  • Counties: Identify 10 random counties on a map of the United Kingdom.
  • Duck Shoot: Solve a multiplication question to shoot a duck.
  • English/French: Correctly type the translation of the displayed word.
  • Fizz/Buzz: The player must type Fizz for numbers divisible by 3 and Buzz for numbers divisible by 5.
  • Guess the Number: Guess a number between 1 and 100. Each guess is told if the answer is higher or lower.
  • Hangman: Spell out a word correctly in as few moves as possible.
  • Highway Code: Multiple choice quiz on road safety.
  • History Quiz: Multiple choice quiz based upon British History.
  • Masterbrain: Correctly guess a sequence of 4 random colors with information on number correct.
  • Missing Letter: Spot the missing letter in a word.
  • Missing Numbers: Fill in the missing number in an addition or subtraction question.
  • Morse Code: A program to teach the player morse code.
  • Multiplication and Division: Answer 20 random multiplication or division questions.
  • Noughts and Crosses: Answer math questions to gain spaces on the board.
  • Number Series: Determine the next number to appear in a sequence.
  • Odd Word Out: Find the word in a group different than the others.
  • Organ: Play a song on a computer organ.
  • Parachute: Safely land a man on the ground by calculating when to open the chute.
  • Proverbs: Fix the jumbled up proverbs.
  • Racer: Answer math questions to power a race car against the opponent.
  • Science Quiz: Multiple choice science quiz.
  • Simon: Memory game requiring memorizing a sequence.
  • Speed Reading: Retype a sentence that is briefly displayed on the screen.
  • Spelling Tests: A word is briefly displayed on the screen, and the player must spell it correctly.
  • Submarine: Sink submarines on a grid using depth charges.
  • Sum Difference: Try to correctly guess two numbers between 1 and 20 by knowing only their sum and difference.
  • Towns: Guess the location of towns on a map of the United Kingdom.
  • Village: Manage the crops of a small village to keep the people fed.
  • Vowel Chase Chomp the vowels on a large word board.
  • Word Mix: Correctly unscramble 2 words mixed together.
  • Word Search: Find words in a large scrambled mass of letters.
title: 40 Educational Games for the Commodore 64

description: Ghosttown is a side-scrolling 3rd perspective shooter. The player's task is to quickly kill bandits that appear suddenly in various places and avoid hitting civilians. If you won't sgot the bad guys fast enought, they will shot you and reduce the amount of ammo you have. To kill the walking guys, aim your shots around their belts.
title: Ghosttown

description: Army Days is a 3rd person perspective single screen shooter. The game is divided into 3 days practice. On the first day, shooting exercises take place at the shooting range. The player must shoot down as many targets as possible while missing as few as possible. On the second day, the player shoots darts and has to watch out for flying birds. On the third day, the player shoots targets at a field shooting range.
title: Army Days

description: Time Traveler is a single screen 3rd person perspective shooter. The player's task is to shoot down as many enemy objects as possible before they reach the target and weaken the shield level.
title: Time Traveller

description:
De Prijsvraag: Mr. Chip Nibble / Dr. J is a Dutch compilation on the occasion of the one-year anniversary of Microcomputer Club Nederland (MCN) that features the following two programs:

  • Meneer Chip Nibbel - is a Dutch graphic text adventure that takes place in and around your CBM-64, where(in) you, the hero Chip Nibbel, are looking for an unloaded program line. This was caused by the criminal computer illiterate "Bugs Bijt". After that, you have to let the computer interpret this line. This is to get one half of a slogan. You write this half down, and then you can play "DRJ" to find the second half. The player inputs all actions via verb-noun commands with the keyboard to interact with the surroundings, such as "PLAATS FLOPPY". To navigate your way through the locations in the game you use the open lines 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6. When you type 'K(IJK)' (LOOK) you get a description of your location. However, if you want to know what the visible items are in your location, possible exits and description of your location you need to type "KIJK GOED". 'R(ICHTING)' (DIRECTION) will give you information about possible exits. 'H(ELP)' is to get hints and 'HELP LOKATIE' (HELP LOCATION) explains the location in the CBM-64 where you are now, such as the I/O Port. If you want to know what you have in your possession you need to type 'B(EZIT)' (POSSESSION). With 'KIJK' (LOOK) + noun you can look at an object that is in your possession.

  • DRJ - In this action game you, DRJ, are looking for the second part (the first part of the slogan must be obtained in 'Meneer Chip Nibbel') of the solution of an MCN contest "De Prijsvraag" in a maze. However, in order to play 'DRJ' you will have an access code which can only be obtained by playing 'Meneer Chip Nibbel'. By following the arrows you will find the letters that make up the second part of the slogan. Many creatures move around the maze and these have to be avoided or destroyed because if you touch one then you lose part of your 'Zuurstof' (Oxygen) and 'Brandstof' (Fuel) The 'Zuurstof' (Oxygen), 'Brandstof' (Fuel) for the flamethrower and the 'Supa' Bommen' (Supa'Bombs)​​ can be filled in some places in the maze.

sample_screenshots.caption: Meneer Chip Nibbel: If you want to know what you have in your possession you need to type 'B(EZIT)' *(POSSESSION)*. With 'KIJK' *(LOOK)* + noun you can look at an object that is in your possession.
Meneer Chip Nibbel: 'R(ICHTING)' (DIRECTION) will give you information about possible exits.
Drj: Overview of the hero and the creatures.

title: De Prijsvraag: Mr. Chip Nibble / Dr. J

description:
In den Beginne, Doe mee aan de wedstrijd is a Dutch graphic text adventure where you are about to buy a Commodore 64 in order to solve the adventure.

The player inputs all actions via verb-noun commands with the keyboard to interact with the surroundings, such as "(OPE)N DEUR". To navigate your way through the locations in the game you use "(N)OORD", "(Z)UID", "(O)OST", "(W)EST", "(H)OOG", "(L)AAG", "(VOO)RUIT" (FORWARDS), "(ACH)TERUIT" (BACK), "(LIN)KS" (LEFT) and "(RECH)TS" (RIGHT).

If you want to know which visible items are in your location, possible exits and description of your location you need to type "(K)IJK" (LOOK). "(R)ICHTING" (DIRECTION) will give you information about possible exits. "(H)ELP" is to get hints. Type "(B)EZIT" (POSSESSION) or "(I)NVENTARIS" (INVENTORY) if you want to know what is in your possession. With 'KIJK' (LOOK) or "(BEK)IJK" + noun you can look at an object. "(S)CORE" indicates how many points you have now earned. By typing "(T)IJD" (TIME) you know how many steps you can still take. To start over again, type "(NIE)UW". If you want to quit the game, type "(STO)P".

sample_screenshots.caption: Starting location: In your own room.

title: In den Beginne, Doe mee aan de wedstrijd

description:
Leerwereld is a Dutch educational game for children, and consists of two games:

  • Hoofdrekenen - In this game you will learn mental arithmetic. You own a spaceship and find yourself in a universe in which, in addition to the usual stars and planets, there are also a number of numbers. The sum to be solved appears in the center of the screen. You must solve the sum by looking up the individual numbers in the universe with the spaceship. Once you've found a number, make sure it's right under your spaceship, then press the fire button. If it is correct, the number will appear on the screen in the next free space after the = sign. You can remove a wrong number with the DEL key. If the answer was wrong, the correct answer will appear and you lose a life.

The type of sums can be set (addition, subtraction, multiplication and division or combinations thereof) in the main menu. With the HOME key you can determine the difficulty level and with the DEL key you can determine whether or not the "Vernietigers" show up. These are hostile, explosive-loaded starships that will explode your spaceship at the slightest touch.

  • Taaloefeningen - In this game you practice the Dutch language exercises by solving the problem that appears on the left. While you are trying to solve it, some objects will fall down. The amount and speed depends on the level. As soon as one of the objects falls to the ground, it will cost you 5 penalty seconds. You can prevent this by using a truck (if you have chosen the "Vrachtwagenoptie" in the main menu) to collect the objects. This is worth 2 points per object captured.

The type of language exercises can be set (Present simple), such as BADEN/BAADT, Degrees of comparison, such as BLIJKT/BLEEK, AU or OU, such as VERH..DING and EI OR IJ, such as VERM..DEN or combinations thereof)

With the HOME key you determine the difficulty level and with the DEL key you determine whether or not you want to use the "Vrachtwagenoptie" to collect the objects. You can also set the time with the + key.

sample_screenshots.caption: Taal: Solve the problem that appears on the left while preventing that the objects fall on the ground. Use truck (if you've chosen the "Vrachtwagenoptie" in the main menu) to collect the objects.

title: Leerwereld

description:
Letterstress is a Dutch spelling educational game, and consists of two games:

  • Word Zepplin - You are in a Zepplin and you have to 'flatten' a letter intertwined in the orange landscape. If this letter occurs in the word that will form at the top left of the screen, you will receive the released projectile back. If the letter is incorrect, you lose the bomb. There will also be an enemy zepplins that you have to avoid.

  • Ladders and Monsters - In this game you have to run through the floors, 'picking up' the letters in the correct order, in order to make a word that will appear on the top left of the screen. If the letter is not the right one, the monsters will come to attack you. These must be dodged.

You can change the difficulty of these games in the game options.

sample_screenshots.caption: Woord-Zepplin: You've to 'flatten' a letter intertwined in the orange landscape. If this letter occurs in the word that will form at the top left of the screen, you will receive the released projectile back.
Ladders en Monsters: 'Pick up' the letters in the correct order, in order to make a word that will appear on the top left of the screen.

title: Letterstress

description:
Railroad is a puzzle and arcade game for the C64.

The aim of the game is to prevent moving trains from colliding or derailing due to the rails being interrupted in some places on a railway network. This is by changing the rails. To move the rails you use a cursor step by step over the field. This will redirect rails at intersections in the directions of movement. Pressing the fire button of your joystick you can turn the trains. This can only be done three times. At the beginning only one train runs on the rails, but after awhile a second train will come into motion. The speed increases as you progress in the game.

sample_screenshots.caption: Oops.....one of the trains is derailed.
At first, one train is moving on the rails, but after awhile a second train will come into motion.
Game over! It is much harder than you think.

Start of the game. Prevent the moving trains from colliding or derailing due to the rails being interrupted in some places on a railway network. This is by changing the rails. To move the rails you use a cursor step by step over the field.

title: Railroad

description: Tanks is a two-player game, similar to the tank mode in Combat from Atari 2600, where the players attempt to shoot each other's tanks. Hitting the enemy vehicle will destroy it and gives the player one point. At the start of the game you can choose whether there are guided or non-guided missiles, whether it is day or night, limited or unlimited ammunition, whether or not you want mines or obstacles in the field.

sample_screenshots.caption: You can also choose if you want any obstacles.
Normal start of the game. The players attempt to shoot each other's tanks. Hitting the enemy vehicle will destroy it and gives the player one point.
The game options. Here you can choose whether there are guided or non-guided missiles, whether it is day or night, limited or unlimited ammunition, whether or not you want mines or obstacles in
When the player shoots, it will light up.
In the field are now obstacles and mines.

title: Tanks

description: Seawar is a two-player game in which the players try to destroy their opponent who is piloting a submarine or an aeroplane without damaging the neutral ships. Both vehicles move constantly from left to right or right to left. They can also move up, down or change speed. The submarine can hit its opponent with missiles and the plane can drop bombs. Whoever hits his opponent scores one point. If instead one of the ships crossing the sea is hit, the opponent gets a point. Whoever scores 20 first wins.

sample_screenshots.caption: Start of the game. The players try to destroy their opponent who is piloting a submarine or an aeroplane without damaging the neutral ships.

title: Seawar

description: Rescue 17 is an arcade action game in which the player's task, as the commander of Rescue 17, is to get as many wandering astronauts as possible out of their hostile surroundings. To that end, you go on different missions and when you have saved a number of people (depending on the damage you took), you go on the next mission. The ship controls in a rather Asteroids -like way, in that you can turn around and thrust into the direction you want to go. To stop sooner, you have to face away from the direction you are traveling and thrust. Unlike Astroids, your ship is equipped with no weapons at all.

sample_screenshots.caption: Starting Mission 1. Trying to save the astronauts without getting hit by those asteroids. Hint: Do not thrust TOO hard, otherwise you will fly out of the screen and getting hit!
Mission 2: In this mission you have to save the astronauts without hitting the satellites AND the planet.

title: Rescue 17

description:
Hollanditis is a Dutch graphic text adventure about the controversial decision to deploy nuclear missiles in the Netherlands. The player takes the role of private detective Heinrich Glühwein from Basel, who has to investigate the worldwide stationing of 24 nuclear missiles and either prevent or promote them. To this end, Heinrich is sent all over the world, from Moscow to London, Rotterdam to New York, in search of hidden data. This data can speed up or prevent the final deployment of 48 cruise missiles in the Netherlands. He has 1,000 hours before the nuclear missiles are deployed and a budget of 25,000 Guilders for expenses.

The player inputs all actions via verb-noun commands with the keyboard to interact with the surroundings, such as "PAK FOTO". Moving between the locations can only be done by taxi or plane.

Type 'K(IJK)' (LOOK) to get a full description of the current location. "O(BJECT)" indicates which objects can be found at the current location. Type 'A(LLES)' and it will not only give the description of the location, but also the items that can be found at the current location. Heinrich Glühwein inventory can be accessed with by typing 'B(EZIT)' or 'I(NVENTARIS)', and it currently shows what object he is holding. With 'KIJK' + noun it is possible to look at an object currently in his possession. When stuck type 'H(ELP)' to get a hint.

There is also a bonus program on the tape:

  • Radeloos: The aim of this game is to obtain 48 cruise missiles, which are scattered in a maze full of monsters. Heinrich can defend himself by shooting them. Keys can also be found in some places. Heinrich Glühwein can use these keys to open a door where there is a keyhole. This door leads to another part of the maze. There are also "exclamation marks" here and there. Like the game Endless, the last exclamation mark is where Heinrich can reboot if he should die. "Question marks" can give extra points or power, but they can also be taken away. On the radar the player can see where Heinrich is at that moment.

sample_screenshots.caption: DRJ says that Radeloos is loading...
Hollanditis: Starting in a bar in Basel.
Hollanditis: With 'KIJK' (LOOK) + noun you can look at an object that is in your possession. It is also possible to use 'LEES' (READ)
Hollanditis: If you want to know what you have in your possession you need to type 'B(EZIT)' or 'I(VENTARIS)'.

title: Hollanditis

description:
...In the year of our Lord 1639, the magic sword 'Excalibur' once the property of King Arthur, (Round Table, Camelot, Merlin) was broken in two pieces by the evil 'Graf Schwarzeherzen', during one of his sentimental (?) journeys... He hid the two pieces in a labyrinth on a mystical island in the Aegean Sea...There is a legend claiming that the twelve signs of the Zodiac can be found here! The (Broken) sword and these Signs of the Zodiac inter-react in such a terrible way that an enormous colony of Vampire Bats has come to existence! These Vampire Bats have a preference for Human flesh!! Until recently it was still possible to keep the Vampire Bat population at an acceptable level, by using artificial methods to decimate them... However, the situation has got out of hand lately, due to their ability to build up immunity to poisons at a rate faster than that new poisons could be concocted... There is only one thing left that can be done now to eliminate this threat, and that is to enter the labyrinth, and to place the Zodiac Signs on the Wheel of Fortune, to turn the Wheel and to find the hidden part of 'Excalibur'.

Co & Co is a two-player co-op platformer set in a Lode Runner-type labyrinth. The object of the game is to find the twelve pieces of the Zodiac and the hidden part of the magic sword 'Excalibur'. In each room you may encounter disappearing ladders, bits of rope, missing bars, Vampire Bats, tractor beams, moving walls, exploding walls, time locks, two-way doors, self-thinking doors and countdown clocks.

To exit each room the players have to place both of their men in front of one of the 'Arrow' icons. To obtain a Zodiac piece or the hidden part of 'Excalibur', that can be found in the room where you are now, both players need to be in front of the 'Skull' icon and press the 'Fire' button of the joystick. The "Question Mark" icon teleports you to a random location. Sometimes a part of the room is inaccessible because the ladders, ropes or bars are not finished. To finish them you must first stand in front of the 'Rope' or 'Bar' or 'Ladder' icon, then push the joystick down and press the 'Fire' button at the same time. Then you walk to the relevant object, climb on it until you are on the other side and it gets build up. You keep doing this until it is long enough to access the other part of the room.

The timer at the top of the screen indicates how many time you have left. This only counts for the particular room that you are in. There are also the countdown clocks in certain rooms that ends the game if run down.

sample_screenshots.caption: Instructions: How to use the joystick.
Start location. IMPORTANT: IF the timer in the middle runs out it's game over! The 'Question Mark' icon teleports you to a random location.

title: Co & Co

description:
Supermorf... is a Dutch educational word quiz for children aged eight or older.

In the game the player controls the cutest computer being, Supermorf. This Supermorf must answer questions about joining together two nouns to one correctly (example: den/bos = dennenbos). In Dutch this is also called “Tussenklanken”.

If the question is answered correctly, Supermorf can kill one of the spiders. But if the answer is wrong, the spiders take revenge and grab one of the butterflies. In the settings menu you can change the speed of the game by pressing F1 (slow/normal/fast). Using F5 you can change the questions. (Semi random, random or targeted). By pressing F3 you can chose from 11 game variations;

  • Natypen – Retype the appearing words.

  • Onthouden – You must remember the appearing words and write them down next.

  • Invullen – You must fill in the blanks in the appearing words, like K.ARK.AAR.

  • Eerste deel – Indicate what the first part of a combination is, like BERGkloof.

  • Tweede deel – Indicate what the second part of a combination is, like windMOLEN.

  • Tussenklanken – Combine two words correctly, like BRUID/MEISJE.

  • Klinkers – Fill in the missing vowels, like WNDMLN.

*Ontcijferen – Decipher the combination, like SOHSIOKUP.

  • Gemengd – The game will ask a random question.

  • Opeenvolgend – Consecutive questions from Natypen to Ontcijferen.

  • Opbouwend – Questions getting more and more difficult.

sample_screenshots.caption: Klinkers: Fill in the missing vowels.

title: Supermorf...

description:
You are a good patriot and the old king needs your help. His sword has been missing for some time. And it is precisely the magical powers of that sword that have always saved the land from disaster. Your quest takes you through the four provinces of the kingdom: Bosland, Kaalland, Lalland and Iceland. The king is destitute, and can give you little more than his seal.

Het Zwaard van de Koning is a Dutch interactive fiction (with graphics) where you input all actions via verb-noun commands with the keyboard to interact with the surroundings, such as 'OPEN DOOR' (OPEN DOOR). To navigate your way through the locations in the game you use 'N(OORD)', 'Z(UID)', 'O(OST)', 'W(EST)'. When you type '?' and it will repeat the description of the location you are in. If you want to know what your possessions are you need to type 'BAGAGE'. "STOP" brings up a menu where you can choose to end the game, save the situation to tape or continue playing.
